plugins.readme_text:
# DeepSeek Harness · Remote SSH

在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面侧边栏中连接 SSH 服务器，**浏览并选择远程项目目录**，直接打开远程工作区。

![远程工作区面板](docs/remote-workspace.png)

## 目录选择

选择服务器 → 点击「选择服务器上的文件夹…」→ 打开项目文件夹 →「选择此目录」→「连接并打开」。

连接时可填写「工作区名称」，留空默认使用项目文件夹名。绿点标识远程工作区。

![远程目录选择器](docs/directory-picker.png)

## 环境要求

本地支持 macOS 和 Linux，需要系统 OpenSSH。远端需要 POSIX `sh`、GNU/BSD `stat`、`readlink`、`mktemp` 等常见命令；执行远程终端命令还需要 `bash`。目前不支持 Windows/Pwsh。

先在终端确认可以登录服务器。示例 `~/.ssh/config`：

```sshconfig
Host dev-server
  HostName dev.example.com
  User demo
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
```

```sh
ssh dev-server
```

上面的服务器地址是示例，请替换为自己的配置。

## 安装

### 从 GitHub 安装（推荐）

先启动一次 Harness，使 `desktop` 配置目录存在。然后将插件克隆到希望长期保留的位置：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/chenqaq123/dsh-remote-ssh.git
cd dsh-remote-ssh
git checkout v0.4.3
node scripts/profile.mjs install desktop
```

**完全退出并重新打开 DeepSeek Harness**，侧边栏会出现「远程工作区」。

### 作为 npm 包安装

仓库包含完整 npm 包元数据和命令入口，可直接从 GitHub tag 安装，无需等待 npm registry 发布：

```sh
npm install -g --install-links git+https://github.com/chenqaq123/dsh-remote-ssh.git#v0.4.3
dsh-ssh-remote install desktop
```

### 更新与卸载

更新源码或全局 npm 包后，重新运行安装命令并重启 Harness。卸载 GitHub 源码安装：

```sh
node scripts/profile.mjs uninstall desktop
```

全局包安装可运行 `dsh-ssh-remote uninstall desktop`，然后再卸载 npm 包。卸载只移除配置区块与插件链接，不删除远程文件或已保存的挂载数据。

## 移除远程工作区

「移除工作区」会归档相关会话并移除分组和远程映射，保留历史记录及服务器文件。有任务运行时，请先结束任务。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE)。社区插件，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。

plugins.description: A touch key bar for the DSH Web terminal.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-terminal-keybar

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

A **touch key bar for the DSH Web terminal**. A phone's soft keyboard has no Escape,
Tab, Ctrl or arrow keys, which makes the terminal unusable. This plugin floats a
translucent column of those keys on the right edge of the screen and writes them
straight into the terminal that is on screen.

- Vertical, translucent, so it does not cover the bottom of the terminal
- Appears only on **touch devices** and only while a **terminal tab is active**; desktop is untouched
- Centres itself in the **visible** area when the soft keyboard opens, so iOS does not hide it
- A browser-only plugin: it copies no terminal code and does not modify DSH itself

![Key column](icon.svg)

## Keys

| Button | Sends | Typical use |
|---|---|---|
| `Esc` | `\x1b` | leave vim insert mode, close less/pagers |
| `Tab` | `\t` | path and command completion |
| `↵` | `\r` | run the command |
| `^C` | `\x03` | interrupt the running command |
| `↑` `↓` | `ESC [ A` / `ESC [ B` | history, menu navigation, vim movement |
| `←` `→` | `ESC [ D` / `ESC [ C` | move within the line |

Presses use `pointerdown` + `preventDefault()`, so the terminal keeps focus and the
soft keyboard stays open: you can type and tap arrows in the same session.

## Install

### 1. Through the Host's `installBundle` (installs **and** enables)

Ask the agent in a conversation:

> install the plugin `github:miiy/dsh-terminal-keybar`

or paste the same spec into the install field on the **Settings → Plugins** page.

Both call the Host's `installBundle`, which installs the package, adds it to
`dsh.profile.bundles`, and hot-applies it — one step.

### 2. From the CLI (`dsh plugin`, installs only)

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:miiy/dsh-terminal-keybar
```

`dsh plugin` forwards its arguments to pnpm inside the profile directory, so this step
installs the package but does **not** compose it. The row then shows up on
**Settings → Plugins** as installed and switched **off**; turn it on to add it to
`dsh.profile.bundles`. If the switch does not take effect live, restart `dsh web`.

A plain-JavaScript bundle has no build script, so a git install needs no `allowBuilds`
approval.

Accepted spec forms are the usual pnpm/DSH ones: `github:user/repo`, `git+https://…`,
an absolute local path, or an npm package name.

### 3. From a local checkout (development)

```sh
plugin_manager install_bundle /absolute/path/to/dsh-terminal-keybar
```

## Usage

1. Open DSH Web on your phone.
2. Open a terminal tab in the right sidebar.
3. The key column appears on the right edge; tap it. It also works with the keyboard closed.

## Known limitations

- **DECCKM (application cursor keys)**: the plugin writes bytes through the public
  `webTerminals` service and has no access to the xterm instance, so the arrows always
  send the CSI form (`ESC [ A`). bash/readline, vim and less accept it; programs that
  strictly require SS3 (`ESC O A`) may not.
- **Floating panels**: visibility is decided from the active pane's active tab, so a
  terminal floated into a floating panel does not show the bar.
- The column covers roughly the rightmost 46px of the terminal; it is translucent, and
  `styles.bar` in `client.js` exposes `opacity` / `right` if you want it smaller.
- Web only (`platform: web`); the Desktop native window is unaffected.

## Maintenance

See [MAINTENANCE.md](MAINTENANCE.md) for the upstream API table (what breaks when DSH
changes what) and the post-upgrade diff procedure. The `DEBUG` switch at the top of
`client.js` paints an on-screen diagnosis badge when the bar does not appear.

```sh
node --check client.js && node --check index.js   # syntax self-check
```

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sidebar-account

侧栏底部多一行：**余额** + **充值**。

```
┌──────────────────────────────┐
│ ↑  2.0.16 → 2.0.17   [更新]   │   ← dsh-desktop-updater
├──────────────────────────────┤
│ 👛 余额  ¥1.96       [充值]   │   ← 本插件
├──────────────────────────────┤
│ (头像) token 患者              │   ← 宿主自带
└──────────────────────────────┘
```

- 左边显示**充值余额**（和「设置 → 账号与余额」里那个 ¥1.96 是同一条数据）；
  只有赠金时显示赠金；鼠标悬停可以看到「充值余额 / 赠金余额」的完整拆分。
- 右边「充值」按钮点了**直接打开充值页**（系统浏览器），链接就是账号接口
  `getState().links.topUpUrl` —— 和设置页「充值」按钮用的是同一个地址。
- 未登录时显示「未登录」，按钮依然可用（充值页那边会让你登录）。
- 收起成窄栏时变成一个钱包图标按钮，点了同样去充值。

## 数据来源与刷新

数据全部来自宿主已经生成好的远端命名空间 `ctx.remote.account`（本插件没有自己的 Host 服务）：

| 调用 | 用到什么 |
| --- | --- |
| `ctx.remote.account.getState()` | `status`（是否登录）、`links.topUpUrl`（充值地址） |
| `ctx.remote.account.getBalance({ version, locale, timezoneOffsetSeconds })` | `value`（充值余额钱包）、`bonusWallets`（赠金） |

刷新时机：挂载时、窗口重新获得焦点 / 页面重新可见时（30 秒节流）、每 10 分钟一次。

金额按设置页同样的规则格式化：**向下截到两位小数**、小于 0.01 显示 `<¥0.01`、千分位分组；
全程走字符串截断，不经过浮点数，避免 `1.005` 这类舍入坑。

## 备注

- 只读：本插件不写任何账号状态，也不发起登录/登出，只读余额 + 给一个充值链接。
- 不 import 任何 Harness 客户端包，样式只用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题变量，深浅色自动跟随。
- 排序：`sidebar.footer.action` 里 `order: 110`，排在更新行（100）下面、账号行上面。

plugins.description: Config-only DeepSeek Harness bundle that mounts the in-box MCP client bridge against CursorTouch/Windows-MCP: no plugin code, 16 of the 21 upstream tools by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-windows-mcp-lite

**Config-only bridge from [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) to [CursorTouch/Windows-MCP](https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP).**

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

It mounts the MCP client bridge that already ships inside DeepSeek Harness and points it at the upstream Windows-MCP server over stdio. The whole integration is [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) — about 25 lines, no JavaScript, and you can read it to the end before you install it.

```text
DSH agent
  └─ mcp__windows__Snapshot / Click / Type / ...
       └─ @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client        (ships with DeepSeek Harness)
            └─ uvx windows-mcp@0.8.8 serve   (stdio child process)
                 └─ your desktop: UI Automation tree, Win32 input, screen capture
```

## What this deliberately does not do

These are the design decisions, not a missing-feature list:

- **No Host plugin.** There is no `index.js`. Nothing of ours runs inside your harness process.
- **No web routes.** This plugin adds no HTTP endpoint, so it adds no unauthenticated attack surface and no reason to keep your web host on loopback beyond what you already chose.
- **No state file.** No `~/.dsh/...state.json`, no browser storage keys.
- **No installer that writes to your profile.** `npm run prewarm` installs and verifies the upstream server *in your own terminal*, and never edits a profile patch for you.
- **No runtime dependency and no build step.** `dependencies` is empty; there is nothing to compile and no `allowBuilds` approval to grant.
- **No absolute path for your machine.** The bridge invokes `uvx` from `PATH`; a test in this repo fails the build if a machine-specific path appears in a published file.
- **No `peerDependencies`.** The row *names* `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`; it never imports it, and DSH resolves shipped packages from its own installation. This follows DSH's own `templates/mcp` bundle shape, which declares none. A peer range would be a hard activation gate whose SemVer prerelease rules silently reject valid hosts; `engines.dsh` declares the host range for the storefront instead.
- **No `screenshots.json`.** There is no interface to photograph. Declaring artwork for a configuration file would be decoration, not evidence; the storefront falls back to whatever it can extract.

If you want an in-app dependency installer, a default-off "Computer Use" toggle, or a doctor tool, other plugins in this ecosystem provide those. This one trades them for being small enough to audit in one screen — which matters more than usual for a plugin that hands over your keyboard, mouse and screen.

## Requirements

- **Windows 10 or 11.** The upstream server is Windows-only.
- **DeepSeek Harness with the in-box MCP client bridge.** Declared range: `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`; the author verified this plugin on **0.2.0-rc.2** (desktop).
- **[uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) on the `PATH` of the process that runs DSH.** `uvx` starts the upstream server and builds its isolated environment. If you installed uv with its official installer, this is already true.
- Optional: **a model that accepts image input**, if you want `Screenshot` to arrive as a real image. Without it the bridge degrades the image to a text diagnostic; `Snapshot` returns plain text and needs no vision at all.

## Install

From the app: **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin**, and enter one of

```text
dsh-windows-mcp-lite                                # npm package
github:sheilacraig/dsh-windows-mcp-lite             # GitHub repository
C:\path\to\a\local\checkout                         # absolute path
```

From a CLI-owned profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-windows-mcp-lite
```

The Electron desktop profile belongs to the app; install through its plugin panel there.

Then restart DSH, so the new patch layer composes at startup.

## First run is the slow one

`uvx` builds an isolated environment for the upstream server the first time, which downloads a few tens of megabytes of Python dependencies. On a slow link that is minutes, and the bridge gives up on the initial connection long before that; after the dependencies are cached, startup is quick.

Do it outside the harness instead, where there is no timeout:

```sh
npm run prewarm
```

The script runs `uvx windows-mcp@0.8.8 serve --exclude-tools ...` — the same argv the bridge uses — speaks `initialize` + `tools/list` to it, prints the server identity, the time it took, and the exact tool list, then exits. It is the same process the bridge will start, so a successful run means the harness side has nothing left to download or discover. With the environment warm, the author's run reached `initialize` in 2.1 s.

## What the model gets

**16 tools**, named `mcp__windows__<Tool>`. Upstream 0.8.8 publishes 21; this plugin excludes five by default (see [Least privilege](#least-privilege-by-default)).

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Screenshot` | Screen capture with cursor position and window list |
| `Snapshot` | Full desktop state: accessibility tree, interactive elements, scrollable regions |
| `DisplayInventory` | Display layout, work areas, DPI |
| `Click`, `Move`, `Scroll` | Mouse input, including explicit drag |
| `Type`, `Shortcut` | Keyboard input |
| `Wait`, `WaitFor` | Fixed delay, or poll the UI until a condition holds |
| `MultiSelect`, `MultiEdit` | Bulk selection / bulk text entry |
| `Clipboard` | Read and set clipboard content |
| `Notification` | Windows toast notifications |
| `App` | Launch an application, resize or focus a window |
| `ControlStatus` | Who owns the desktop right now — upstream cannot exclude this one |

## Verify

1. Run `npm run prewarm` once (above). It proves the server and the pinned version.
2. In DSH, ask the agent to call `mcp__windows__DisplayInventory`. It only reads display geometry — it does not click or type.
3. Then `mcp__windows__Snapshot` for the accessibility tree as text.

## Least privilege by default

`--exclude-tools PowerShell,Registry,FileSystem,Process,Scrape` — five upstream tools stay off, because DeepSeek Harness already owns shell, file, registry and process access under its own approval policy and sandbox. Enabling upstream's copies would add a second path to the same capabilities with none of those controls.

To change the set, override the row in your profile patch (see below). Removing `--exclude-tools` restores all 21 tools.

## Configuration

Every default lives in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml). To change one, override the row in **your profile's** patch — do not edit the installed copy:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- id: windows-mcp-lite
  config:
    serverName: windows
    transport: stdio
    command: uvx
    args: [windows-mcp@0.8.8, serve, --exclude-tools, "PowerShell,Registry,FileSystem,Process,Scrape,App"]
    toolCallTimeoutMs: 120000
    failOnStartupError: false
    env:
      ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY: "false"
      WINDOWS_MCP_DISABLE_FLASH: "1"
```

Two things about that override, both of which cost people time:

- **A patch replaces the entire `config` object; it does not deep-merge.** Every key you leave out is a key you delete. `serverName` and `transport` are required, `command` is required for `stdio`, `url` for `streamable-http`.
- **`serverName` decides every tool name** (`mcp__<serverName>__<tool>`). Changing it renames the whole tool set and invalidates prompt-cache prefixes.

**Only one Windows-MCP bridge per profile.** Two rows using the same `serverName` conflict, and the second one fails at load. Disable any other Windows-MCP plugin in the same profile before enabling this one.

Prefer a pre-installed interpreter over `uvx`? `uv tool install windows-mcp`, then set `command: windows-mcp` with `args: [serve, --exclude-tools, ...]`. Prefer a resident HTTP server? Switch `transport` to `streamable-http` and give `url` — note that the HTTP form has no `env`, so telemetry and flash settings then belong to how you start the server.

## Security

Installing this gives an agent your mouse, keyboard, clipboard and screen, through a process that runs with your user rights. Judge it as

# dsh-todo-reminder

![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-todo-reminder)
![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-todo-reminder)
![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-%3E%3D0.2.0--rc.2-blue)
![compat](https://github.com/Meltllsy/dsh-todo-reminder/actions/workflows/compat.yml/badge.svg)

DSH 的**全局个人待办**插件 —— 一份跟你所有会话、所有项目都无关的个人清单。

## 功能

- **全局面板**：侧边栏「待办」入口打开，浮在页面中央（不再挂在会话列里）—— 任何会话下
  打开都是同一份内容、同一个位置。新建（标题 / 备注 / 提醒时间 / 提醒样式 / 完成需确认）、
  完成、删除；待办 / 已完成分区展示。Esc 或点空白处关闭。
- **右侧待办条（Dock）**：窗口右缘常驻、可收起；收起时直接显示下一件要做的事
  （到期时间 + 标题），逾期变红；展开可快速添加 / 勾完成 / 稍后提醒；可上下拖动，可关闭。
- **到期提醒**：host 每 5 秒扫描到期任务，经 SSE 实时推到浏览器弹富 toast，动作有
  「完成 / 稍后提醒（分钟数可自定义）/ 忽略」；**切出到别的窗口时转成系统原生通知**。
- **多种提醒样式**：info（蓝）/ success（绿）/ warning（黄）/ danger（红，呼吸动画）。
- **提醒音**：每种样式可单独开关响铃；音量、音色可调；可试听。
- **完成需确认**：任务可开启，点「完成」先弹确认框。
- **Agent 工具**：todo_add / todo_list / todo_complete / todo_snooze / todo_delete。

> 本插件是原来那个「待办 + 会话提醒」二合一插件拆出来的**待办模块**。DSH 会话的
> 「跑完 / 提问 / 审批」提醒已经独立成 **dsh-session-attention**，两者数据、设置、
> 声效文件、接口全部独立，可单独安装、单独卸载。

## 安装

从 npm 装（推荐）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-todo-reminder    # 桌面端
dsh plugin --profile web     add dsh-todo-reminder    # 浏览器版
```

从源码装（仓库里已带构建产物 `lib/`，克隆后可直接指过去）：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Meltllsy/dsh-todo-reminder.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<克隆目录>
```

> 改了源码想重新构建：`npm install && npm run prepack`（host 半 `tsc` → `lib/`，client 半 `tsdown` → `lib/client.js`）。
## 设置与数据

| 项 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| 数据文件 | `$DSH_HOME/todo-reminder/todos.json`（待办 + 提醒事件 + 设置，原子写） |
| 自定义提醒音 | `$DSH_HOME/todo-reminder/sound.{mp3,wav,ogg,m4a}` |
| HTTP 接口 | `/api/todo/state`、`/api/todo/events`（SSE）、`/api/todo/sound`、`/api/todo/{add,update,delete,complete,snooze,dismiss-reminder,set-settings}` |

拆分后 `todos.json` 里遗留的 `settings.attention` / `settings.ball` 由本插件忽略（不删）；
它们会被 dsh-session-attention 首次启动时读走做迁移。

## 提醒音怎么走

1. **自定义音效文件优先**：音频解锁后探测 `/api/todo/sound`，命中则解码使用。
2. **内置合成音兜底**：没有文件 / 解码失败时用 WebAudio 现场合成四种音色。
3. **系统通知兜底**：音频尚未解锁时，由系统通知自己出声。

音频解锁靠 document 上的手势监听自动完成（点 DSH 里任何地方即可）。页面内音效在前台/
后台都会响；**页面完全关闭时不会响**，那时只有系统通知，而浏览器通知只能用系统默认音。

## 构建

```bash
npm install          # 只需一次
npm run prepack      # host 半 tsc → lib/；client 半 tsdown → lib/client.js
```

host 半只依赖 `node:` 内置模块（自包含）；client 半经 tsdown 打包为 ModuleLoader 客户端，React 交给宿主运行时。

## 兼容性

本插件依赖 DSH 的一些**内部点**（服务名、事件名、DOM 类名、客户端包格式）。DSH 演进较快，
这些点在版本之间**会变** —— 插件断掉往往不是插件自己的 bug，而是这里变了。所以仓库里带了一个自检脚本：

```bash
npm run check:compat                        # 检查本机已装的 DSH
node scripts/check-compat.mjs --from <dir>  # 检查指定目录（CI 用）
```

实测结果：

| DSH 版本 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `0.2.0-rc.2`（当前） | ✅ 15/15 |
| `0.2.1-alpha.2`（下一个） | ✅ 15/15 |

依赖点一览（断哪条、坏哪个功能，脚本输出里都写了）：

| 分类 | 依赖点 |
|---|---|
| 客户端 | `__ModuleLoader__` 加载器格式、`/plugins` 资源路由 |
| 服务 | `uiWorkspace.openSession`、会话列表 `byId` 快照、host 的 `webServer` / `systemPrompt` |
| DOM | 类名含 `sessionRow` / `newSession` / `centerCol` |
| 事件 | `session/event` / `turn/end` / `approval/asked` / `tool/call` |
| 工具 | `ask_user_question` |

**GitHub Actions 每周自动跑一次**（含 alpha 版本），不通过就自动开 issue —— 所以 DSH 更新导致的不兼容
会被提前发现，而不是等用户先撞上。

> 与 [dsh-session-attention](https://github.com/Meltllsy/dsh-session-attention) 是各自独立的插件，互不依赖，可单独安装。

plugins.description: A hotkey binder plugin for dsh, allows user to bind specific keys to trigger dictation.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-dictation-hotkey

Press-to-talk dictation for the DSH Web composer. Hold a key combination, speak,
release — DSH's own speech engine transcribes it and the text lands in the
composer.

The plugin adds **no second recognizer**: it drives the speech Remote that DSH
already ships with its voice-input bundle (local SenseVoice, CPU) and inserts the
result through the official composer actions.

```
hold Ctrl+Shift+Space ──▶ speak ──▶ release
        │
        ├─ microphone capture in the page (getUserMedia + AudioWorklet, muted output)
        ├─ encoded as the canonical 16 kHz mono PCM16 WAV the Remote requires
        ├─ ctx.remote.speech.transcribe()      ← official speech Remote (SenseVoice)
        └─ inputActions.insertText() / submit() ← official composer
```

## What it does

- **Push to talk**: `hold` (record while held) or `toggle` (press to start, press
  to stop) trigger modes.
- **Fill or send**: insert the transcript for review, or submit it immediately.
- **Reuses DSH's engine**: the same local SenseVoice provider the official
  microphone button uses — no extra process, model download, or cloud API.
- **Composer-native insertion**: text is spliced into the live draft through
  `inputActions.insertText`, so the caret, references, and attachments survive.
- **Configurable per browser**: hotkey, mode, send behaviour, beeps, and
  diagnostics live in a popover on the composer pill (`localStorage`).
- **Works on the new-conversation screen too**: with no session open there is no
  composer draft to splice into, so the transcript is pasted into the focused
  composer as a normal edit, and the pill returns with the first session.
- **Diagnosable**: optional per-keystroke log with audio level, audio length, and
  inference time, which separates "nothing was picked up" from "the recognizer
  missed it".

## Requirements

- DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` or a compatible release, Web profile.
- The official **voice input** bundle enabled (plugin manager → 语音输入). It
  provides the speech engine; without it the pill reports that no recognizer is
  mounted.

## Install

```sh
# from a checkout
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-dictation-hotkey

# or straight from git
dsh plugin --profile web add github:AndyYang12345/dsh-dictation-hotkey
```

Then reload the Web UI. The bundle is committed at `client/dist/client.js`, so a
checkout works without a build step.

## Use

A **🎙 Dictation** pill appears under the composer:

| Action | Result |
|---|---|
| Hold `Ctrl+Shift+Space`, speak, release | Transcript inserted into the composer |
| Click the pill | Settings: hotkey (press the keys to capture), fill ↔ send, hold ↔ toggle, beeps, diagnostics |

Releasing **any** key of the combination ends the recording, so there is no need
to lift them together.

On the home screen (no session yet) the pill is absent — the composer dock only
exists inside a session — but the hotkey still works: the controller stays armed
through a root-scope seat and the transcript is pasted into the focused composer.
Auto-send is skipped there, so sending stays your own keystroke.

## Settings

Stored per browser under `localStorage` key `dsh-dictation-hotkey.settings`.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `hotkey` | `Ctrl+Shift+Space` | `+`-separated combination; `Space`, `F9`, `Alt+~`, letters and digits are understood |
| `mode` | `hold` | `hold` = record while held, `toggle` = press to start/stop |
| `autoSend` | `false` | Submit the draft as soon as the transcript is inserted |
| `beep` | `true` | Short tones for start, stop, and failure |
| `language` | *(empty)* | Recognition language hint; empty follows the DSH speech settings |
| `providerId` | *(empty)* | Speech provider id; empty uses the deployment default |
| `minRecordMs` | `150` | Presses shorter than this are rejected with a visible notice |
| `tailMs` | `180` | Audio kept after release, so a fast release does not clip a syllable |
| `maxRecordSeconds` | `60` | Safety stop |
| `debug` | `false` | Keep the keystroke log |

## Diagnostics

Enable **诊断日志** in the popover; each keystroke then records a structured entry,
mirrored to the DevTools console and kept as a 20-entry ring buffer in
`localStorage` (`dsh-dictation-hotkey.log`, copy/clear buttons in the popover).

| `event` | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `start` | Microphone ready — `micStartMs`, triggering keys `heldCodes` |
| `stop` | Released — `heldMs`, `tailMs` |
| `ok` | Recognized — `audioSeconds`, `inferenceMs`, `chars`, `peakDb` |
| `empty-transcript` | Engine returned nothing — carries `peakDb`; `quiet: true` means the recording itself was near-silent |
| `skip` | Rejected by a threshold: `shorter than minRecordMs`, `empty audio`, `speech remote absent` |
| `transcribe-failed` / `mic-failed` / `insert-conflict` / `finish-threw` | Corresponding failure |

`peakDb > -45` with an empty transcript points at the recognizer (adjust
`language`); `peakDb < -45` means that take carried no usable sound.

## Development

```sh
npm run build     # build client/dist/client.js (esbuild)
npm run verify    # contract check: the bundle only touches injected services
npm test          # behaviour suite: fake microphone + recognizer
```

`verify.mjs` exists because Cordis throws when a plugin reads a service it did
not declare (`cannot get property "slots" without inject`) while the Web shell
only prints `web boot: 1 entry did not activate` — a diagnostic dead end this
plugin hit once, now a build-time check. `test-release.mjs` covers sloppy release
order, double taps, sub-threshold presses, empty transcripts, and auto-send.

## How it is wired

| Piece | Where |
|---|---|
| Hotkey, microphone, WAV encoding, state | `client/src/{index,controller,hotkey,audio,settings,ui}.js` |
| Composer seat (session-scoped) | `conversation.composer.dock` slot |
| Session-less seat | headless component in the root-scope `shell.overlay` slot |
| Recognition | `ctx.remote.speech.transcribe` — official speech Remote |
| Host half | `host/index.js`, intentionally a no-op (`apply() {}`) |
| Bundle layer | `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the plugin row |

The host half deliberately has no `@deepseek-ai/*` import and no service access:
a profile installs this package through a link, which resolves no dependencies for
it, so a host-side import would abort activation with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` and
DSH would refuse to boot the Web GUI.

## Limitations

- Keys are handled while the DSH page is focused. A key pressed with another
  window in front never reaches the plugin; system-wide support needs an OS-level
  helper and is not implemented.
- Microphone permission is granted for the DSH origin. The first ever use may
  require clicking the official microphone button once.
- Recording is capped by `maxRecordSeconds` and by the Remote's own audio limits.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 AndyYang12345

plugins.description: DSH plugin: per-conversation token and money accounting — session_cost / list_session_costs tools, the /cost command, and a composer cost pill with per-model rates and DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-cost — 统计每个对话消耗的 token 与金额

DSH 插件（Cordis bundle）· 工具 `session_cost` / `list_session_costs` · 命令 `/cost` · 界面「💰 消耗」药丸

DSH 自己**只记 token、不记钱**：`dsh-token-meter` 的 `tokenUsage` 投影给出精确的 token 桶
（未命中缓存输入 / 命中缓存输入 / 缓存写入 / 输出），但整个自带安装里没有任何文本单价——
唯一带价格的是图片 visual token。本插件补上"金额"这一半，并且把两半都做成
**可按模型分别计价**的账。

```
会话日志（每条 assistant/message 自带 provider/model + usage）
   └─ lib/usage.js   按 attempt 归属到它自己的路由，按 attempt 当时的时刻判断高峰/非高峰（仅峰谷价模型）
        └─ lib/rates.js   查单价表 → 整数最小单位（1e-6）累加
             ├─ 工具 session_cost / list_session_costs   （模型可调，精确到每次调用）
             ├─ 命令 /cost                                （不花 token，直接看）
             └─ 界面 💰 药丸                              （会话级近似，可一键与日志核对）
```

## 数字从哪来（以及哪一半是精确的）

| 数字 | 来源 | 精确度 |
|---|---|---|
| token 桶 | 已落盘的 `assistant/message.data.usage`（缺省回退到流里最后一个 `usage` chunk） | **精确**，与 DSH 自己的 `tokenUsage` 投影逐字节一致（[见验证](#验证)） |
| 路由归属 | 该条 assistant 消息自己的 `message.source.provider/model` | **精确**，中途换模型会分成多行分别计价 |
| 高峰/非高峰 | 该次调用的 `event.time` | **精确到规则**：周一至周五 01:00–04:00、06:00–10:00（按 `offPeakTimezone`，默认 UTC）为高峰，中国法定节假日全天按非高峰；**只对峰谷价模型生效**（键名含 `deepseek` 或 `peakPricing: true`），其余模型全天一个价 |
| 单价 | 本插件的 `rates` 配置 | **取决于你填的对不对**；未配置的模型只统计 token、不计金额，并明确列出来 |
| 💰 药丸 | `tokenUsage` + `modelSelection` 两个投影 | **近似**：整段对话按当前模型计价；换过模型时请点「与日志核对」或看 `/cost` |

缓存写入（`cacheWriteTokens`）DeepSeek 不单独计费，因此默认按普通输入（cache miss）价计价，
可用 `cacheWrite` 覆盖。金额用**整数最小单位**（1e-6，即"微元"）累加，避免长对话里浮点误差；
单位是 `currency` 那一个，不是美元。

## 安装

```powershell
# 在 dsh-session-cost 目录下
node install/install.mjs                 # 装进默认 desktop profile（含默认单价表）
node install/install.mjs --dry-run       # 先看会改什么
node install/install.mjs --currency '{"symbol":"$","code":"USD","perUsd":1}'   # 若账号按美元计费
node install/install.mjs --uninstall     # 卸载
```

安装做三件事，每件都有 `.dsh-session-cost-<时间戳>.bak` 备份：

1. 把包**实体复制**到 `<profile>\node_modules\@local\dsh-session-cost`（不用符号链接：源目录
   曾被链接清空过一次；实体复制还能让 `@deepseek-ai/*` 的裸导入走 profile 自己的解析路径）
2. profile `package.json`：加 `file:` 依赖，并把包名追加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`
   （这一步才让它出现在「插件」页的**已安装**里）
3. profile `cordis.patch.yml`：用受管块按 id 覆写两行，写入单价表 / 货币 / 非高峰设置

**装完**：改 `lib/index.js`、`lib/command.js` 等宿主半边 → **完全退出 DSH 再启动**；
改 `lib/client.js`（界面半边）→ 页面**硬刷新**（Ctrl+R）。插件页 → 已安装 →
`@local/dsh-session-cost` → 任一行 → **配置**，可直接编辑单价表（表单由本包自己渲染，
因为 DSH 只提供 `plugins.row.config` 扩展点、不自带渲染器）。

> 实测差异（本插件开发时踩到的）：**首次**把包加进 profile 会让运行中的 DSH 热重组，
> 宿主侧的工具/命令/路由**立刻可用**；但**插件模块本身不会被重新导入**——之后再改
> `lib/*.js` 并刷新副本，运行中的进程仍在跑旧代码，必须重启 DSH 才会换新。界面半边的
> 插槽注册发生在页面加载时，所以至少要硬刷新一次。

> 另一个实测差异：**DSH 自己开着的沙箱可能只允许写工作区**。这种情况下
> `<profile>\cordis.patch.yml` 能写、`<profile>\node_modules\@local\dsh-session-cost\` 却
> `EPERM`——因为前者在允许列表里、后者不在。安装器会逐文件复制并把
> `NOT updated (permission denied): lib/ ...` 明确打出来（而不是假装成功），此时**行已改、
> 模块还是旧的**：换一个能写该目录的权限重跑同一命令即可，不需要退出 DSH。
> 注意这与「文件真的被运行中的 DSH 锁住」（`EBUSY`）是两回事，安装器分开报告。

## 配置字段

**在界面里填单价**（推荐）：插件页 → 已安装 → `@local/dsh-session-cost` → 任一行 → **配置**。
那一页的「模型单价」是一张**可编辑表格**，每个模型一行，直接输入数字即可：

```
模型（<provider>/<model>）   未命中   命中缓存   缓存写入   输出
deepseek-official/deepseek-flash   2     0.04              8    ×
deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-pro  9     0.3              27    ×
[＋ 添加模型]   留空的「命中缓存 / 缓存写入」= 与未命中同价

模型   未命中   命中缓存   缓存写入   输出
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash   ¥2   ¥0.04   ¥2   ¥8      ← 只读预览（跟随 currency）
DeepSeek-V4-Pro       ¥9   ¥0.3    ¥9   ¥27

▸ 高级：直接编辑 rates JSON
```

- **未命中、输出必填**；命中缓存 / 缓存写入留空 = 与未命中同价（DeepSeek 的缓存写入不单独计费）；
- **「＋ 添加模型」**加一行，每行的 **×** 删掉该行（至少留一行）；
- 表格只改这四列，**同一模型上的其它字段会被保留**（`label`、`offPeakMultiplier`、
  `inputOffPeak` 等），不会因为你在界面上改了一个价就把高级设置悄悄删掉；
- 模型名必须写成 `<provider>/<model>`，**可以直接复制下面只读预览里的键名**；
- 下面是**只读预览**：按当前 `currency` 标注单位，把每个模型的四个单价列全，一眼能看出
  「我填的价会不会被这么算」；
- 最下面的**「高级」**是可折叠的 `rates` JSON 原文——要写表格没有暴露的字段
  （`inputOffPeak` 之类）时用它；两处是同一个值的两个视角，改哪边都会同步另一边的表格；
- **保存前会校验**：缺 `input`/`output`、值不是数字、模型名没有 `/`、模型名重复，都会**拒绝保存**
  并指出是**哪一行哪个字段**——因为 Host 挂载时会拒绝这种表，那会让整个读数不显示，
  所以宁可在这里拦住。

字段清单（表格没覆盖的部分用「高级」直接写）：

| 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `rates` | DeepSeek 官方价（见下） | JSON：`"<provider>/<model>"` → 每 100 万 token 的单价，**单位与 `currency` 一致** |
| `currency` | `{"symbol":"¥","code":"CNY","perUsd":1}` | 展示货币；`perUsd` 是 1 美元兑多少该货币 |
| `offPeakMultiplier` | `0.5` | 非高峰价 = 高峰价 × 该系数，**只对「峰谷价」的模型生效**（见 `peakPricing`） |
| `offPeakTimezone` | `UTC` | 判断高峰时段的 IANA 时区 |
| `offPeakHolidays` | 空 = 用内置清单 | 中国法定节假日（`YYYY-MM-DD`，逗号分隔），这些日期全天按非高峰价 |
| `dshHome` | 空 | 空 = `$DSH_HOME`，再退回 `~/.dsh` |

单价表每个条目可用的字段：

| 字段 | 必填 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `input` | ✅ | 未命中缓存的输入价 |
| `output` | ✅ | 输出价 |
| `cacheRead` | | 命中缓存的输入价；缺省 = `input` |
| `cacheWrite` | | 缓存写入价；缺省 = `input`（DeepSeek 不单独计费） |
| `label` | | 界面/报告里显示的名字，如 `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` |
| `peakPricing` | | 该模型是否有高峰/非高峰两档价；**不填时按键名判断：含 `deepseek` 才是 `true`，其余一律 `false`（固定价）** |
| `offPeakMultiplier` | | 该模型自己的非高峰系数，覆盖全局值；只对 `peakPricing: true` 的模型生效 |
| `inputOffPeak` / `cacheReadOffPeak` / `cacheWriteOffPeak` / `outputOffPeak` | | 直接写死非高峰价，覆盖系数；同样只对峰谷价模型生效 |

**峰谷价只属于 DeepSeek**。这是实测踩到的第二个坑：插件原来把非高峰折扣套在了**每一条**已配置
单价的路由上，于是本机真实存在的 `our-free-model/mimo-v2.6-flash-free`（只有一个固定价）被算成
半价，面板还理直气壮地写着「非高峰 ×0.5」——那个模型根本没有低谷时段。现在的规则是：

- 键名含 `deepseek` 的路由 → 峰谷价（`deepseek-official/*`、`deepseek-account/*`）；
- 其它一切路由 → 固定价，全天按表里的价格，面板显示「固定价」；
- 想覆盖就在该条目写 `peakPricing: true`（比如 DeepSeek 模型走了别的 provider 名，
  或某个转售商也分时计价）或 `peakPricing: false`（比如 DeepSeek 模型被按平价转售）。

实测（本机全部会话日志 + 已装配置）：修复前 `our-free-model/mimo-v2.6-flash-free`
合计 **¥0.945**，修复后 **¥1.8907**，正好差一倍；同一份数据里三条 DeepSeek 路由金额
一分不变（¥48.9713 / ¥10.5830 / ¥0.523）——也就是这次修正没有动到本来就正确的部分。

默认表按 [DeepSeek 官方定价](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/) 的**高峰价**
填写，单位是**人民币元 / 百万 token**——因为 DeepSeek 账号本身以人民币计费、余额也按人民币变动。
非高峰由 `offPeakMultiplier: 0.5` 折半（官方非高峰价为高峰价的一半）：

```json
{
  "deepseek-official/deepseek-flash": { "label": "DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash", "input": 2, "cacheRead": 0.04, "output": 8 },
  "deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-pro": { "label": "DeepSeek-V4-Pro", "input": 9, "cacheRead": 0.3, "output": 27 }
}
```

> **为什么默认是人民币，而不是美元**：这是实测踩到的坑。DeepSeek 的官方文档同时给出美元价
> （Flash 高峰 `$0.3 / $0.006 / $1.2`）。早期版本照抄美元价、`currency` 写 `$`，于是同一个
> 会话显示 `$1.1262`，而平台余额实际扣了 **¥9.06**——看起来像"统计少了一个数量级"，其实是
> **币种错了**，而且因为不能拿中美汇率当 1 用，误差正好是汇率倍数。把单价表和 `currency` 都
> 换成账号自己的人民币口径后，同一个会话算出 **¥4.9610**，与平台对得上。
>
> 如果你的账号是美元计费（或你想看美元），把 `rates` 换成美元价、`currency` 换成
> `{"symbol":"$","code":"USD","perUsd":1}` 即可——**两处必须同时改**，只改一个就会差一个汇率。

**高峰时段**（官方脚注）：周一至周五 `01:00–04:00` 与 `06:00–10:00` **UTC**，
**不含中国法定节假日**——节假日全天按非高峰。窗口是规则，节假日是日历，所以后者是
`offPeakHolidays` 数据：内置 2026 年清单，**每年 11 月国务院公布次年安排后需要更新**
（不更新只会把工作日节假日按高峰算，即偏高，不会偏低）。留空就用内置清单，填了就完全替换。

这个窗口**只对峰谷价的模型生效**（键名含 `deepseek`，或显式 `peakPricing: true`）；
固定价模型不看时间，也就不会因为节假日/时段变化而算错。`offPeakHolidays` 与
`offPeakTimezone` 只在前者身上起作用。

价格会变，**请以官方页面为准**自行更新。

## 用法

### 1. 界面：消耗药丸 + 明细面板

对话输入框上方（DSH 自带统计药丸那一排）会多一个胶囊：

```
● ¥0.0138 · 129k / 1.00M ⌄        ← 圆点：灰=空闲，绿=正在跑；未配置价格时描边转警告色
● ¥10.3089 · 284k / 1.00M ⌄       ← 金额是本会话（或家族）的花费，token 数是「当前上下文」
● ¥8.2288 [含派生 4] · 144k / 1.05M ⌄   ← 派生出过子代理时：金额是「本会话 + 派生会话」
```

**token 数字刻意用 DSH 自己的口径**：`已用 / 窗口`，也就是「下一次调用要发送的长度」。
这是 DSH 自带统计显示的那个数，用它才不会让人以为两边对不上（见下面「三个 token 数」）。

**只要这个对话派生出过子代理 / workflow agent，胶囊的金额就是整个家族的花费**，并在后面
标出包含了几个派生会话——否则它会看起来比实际便宜（子代理是独立会话、独立计费，它们的
token 根本不在本会话的 `tokenUsage` 投影里，所以这个数必须问宿主）。鼠标悬停会写清全部口径：

```
deepseek-official/deepseek-flash · 本会话 ¥5.6821 + 4 个派生会话 ¥2.5467 · 家族合计 ¥8.2288
  · 整段对话累计计费 243,629,270 tokens（含缓存重读） · 本次新增 1,372,099 tokens · 当前上下文 144k / 1.05M
```

**路由一律写成 `<provider>/<model>`**（悬停提示、面板头部、`/cost`、工具返回都是），
因为 `rates` 就是按这个键写的：它指的就是你要去编辑的那一条，而且同一个模型名可能被两个
provider 提供，只写模型名分不出是哪一条。配置过的 `label` 只在有空间的地方补在后面，
如面板头部的 `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash（DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash）`。

本会话自身的金额始终在同一行里，所以与 DSH 自带统计对照时不会失去参照。

点开是一个面板（点击外部或按 Esc 关闭；展开状态记在 `localStorage`，刷新后保持）：

```
对话消耗        deepseek-official/deepseek-flash（DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash）  [非高峰 ×0.5]
对话消耗        our-free-model/mimo-v2.6-flash-free                  [固定价]   ← 这条路只有一个价，不分峰谷
██████████████░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░   ← 金额构成条（本会话自身的构成）
■ 未命中 20%   ■ 命中缓存 2%   ■ 输出 78%      ← 图例：每种 token 的金额占比

输入 · 未命中缓存        1,000,000        ¥2.00
输入 · 命中缓存          1,000,000        ¥0.02
输入 · 缓存写入                  0

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-task-overlay · 任务悬浮窗

在 **DSH 窗口之外**放一个桌面悬浮窗，实时显示当前任务状态；并在 DSH 侧栏提供一个启停开关。

- **目标状态**：phase（进行中 / 已暂停 / 受阻 / 已完成）、objective、第 N/M 轮、受阻原因
- **Todo 进度**：进度条 + 清单（✔ 已完成 / ◐ 进行中 / ○ 待办）
- **提醒**：N 个会话等待你确认、N 个会话已完成未查看（跨所有会话）
- 最小化或关闭 DSH 后，桌面浮窗依然存在；DSH 完全退出后它会显示「DSH 未运行」但窗口不消失

> 桌面浮窗（PowerShell + WPF）**仅支持 Windows**；DSH 内的开关与状态推送跨平台。

## 安装

**插件市场（推荐）**：先安装市场插件 [dshmarket](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market)，
然后在 DSH 里 **设置 → Plugin Market** 搜索 `dsh-task-overlay` 一键安装。

**DSH 官方插件页**：安装框填 `github:gg947919490-byte/dsh-task-overlay`，
或贴 Release 里 `dsh-task-overlay.tgz` 的直链。

**CLI**：

```sh
dsh plugin add gg947919490-byte/dsh-task-overlay
```

安装后 **刷新一次 DSH 页面**（F5）即可在侧栏底部看到「桌面浮窗」开关。

## 使用

| 入口 | 操作 |
|---|---|
| DSH 侧栏底部「桌面浮窗」开关 | 点击启停桌面浮窗（绿点=运行中） |
| 浮窗标题栏 `▾` / `▸` | 展开详情 / 收成 190×32 迷你胶囊 |
| 拖动浮窗标题栏 | 移动位置（位置与折叠状态会记住） |
| 浮窗 `✕` | 关闭浮窗进程（可在 DSH 侧栏开关重新打开） |

首次手动启动（不经 DSH 开关）：双击 `desktop\launch-overlay.cmd` 或 `desktop\launch-overlay.vbs`。
开机自启：把 `launch-overlay.vbs` 的快捷方式放进 `shell:startup`。

## 工作原理

```
DSH GUI（客户端插件，拥有完整会话状态）
   │  POST 压缩快照 → 127.0.0.1:45123（2 秒心跳，变化即时推送）
   ▼
桌面浮窗（独立 WPF 进程 + 内置 TCP 监听）
   ▲
   │  侧栏开关 → 同源相对路径 /task-overlay/control（start/stop/toggle/status）
DSH 宿主（本包宿主半边）—— start 用 spawn 拉起浮窗，stop 发 {"cmd":"stop"} 优雅关闭
```

- 数据不来自宿主投影（root 上下文读不到会话作用域的 `todos`/`goal`），而由 GUI 客户端推送。
- 浮窗判断 DSH 存活用三段式：≤20 秒实时；>20 秒保留最后一帧并标注数据年龄；>150 秒且宿主端口拒连才显示「DSH 未运行」。

## 配置项

| 位置 | 参数 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dsh/client.js` | `BRIDGE_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:45123/task-overlay` | 客户端推送地址，需与浮窗 `-Port` 一致 |
| `desktop/task-overlay.ps1` | `-Port` | `45123` | 桥接监听端口 |
| 同上 | `-DshPort` | `19387` | 宿主端口，用于存活探测 |
| 同上 | `-Width` | `300` | 展开态宽度（200–520） |
| 同上 | `-StateFile` | `~/.dsh/task-overlay/desktop-window.json` | 位置/折叠记忆 |

## 安全说明

- 宿主控制接口只绑定 webServer 自身监听地址（默认 `127.0.0.1`），并校验请求 `Origin` 为同源或 `dsh-app://app`，防止任意网页 CSRF 启停。
- `start` 只执行包内固定脚本路径，不接受任何外部输入拼接。
- 桥接端口（45123）无鉴权，仅绑定回环；本机进程可伪造显示数据或触发关闭，属已知限制。

## 排查

- 最近一帧快照：`~/.dsh/task-overlay/last-payload.json`
- 浮窗没出现：确认 DSH 已刷新（F5）、侧栏开关显示「开」；或手动跑 `desktop\launch-overlay.cmd`
- 端口被占：改 `-Port` 并同步 `dsh/client.js` 的 `BRIDGE_URL`

## 开发备注（DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 实测）

- 客户端 bundle 为**手写零构建**：`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: 包名, factory })`，只 require 平台种子模块。
- 宿主行必须指向**包根**；`apply` 必须**同步**；宿主代码热生效需**换新包名**（Node ESM 按解析路径缓存）。
- 宿主 `spawn` 子进程**不要用 `detached: true`**（pwsh 会立即退出）。
- 本包不声明 peer，避免版本兼容校验把整包判为不兼容。

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# 项目书生成（proposal-generator-cn）

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：把「项目申报书」写作技能装进你的 DSH。

## 它是什么

一个技能 bundle。安装后，你的 DSH 会话就能按**真实申报件的文体**写项目书：

- **§1 文体铁律**——正文零元信息（11 类禁止项）、指标五拍论证（数值→基线→为何不够→为何能超→因此定为该值）、研究内容占正文 60–70%
- **§1.6 公式规范**——LaTeX 数学标记（`$$...$$` 与 `$...$`）白名单，转出的 .docx 里是 Word 原生 OMML 公式
- **9 份素材库**——评分权重、骨架 A/B、写作要点、合规避坑、信源链接、真实申报件拆解（共 ~600 KB）
- **2 个工具**——`md2docx.py`（Markdown→Word，仿宋_GB2312/黑体/楷体排版 + 自动目录 + 公式）与 `latex_omml.py`（LaTeX→OMML 引擎）

## 安装

### 本地安装（已下载本目录）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "D:/work/deepseekherness/对话区2/proposal-generator-cn"
```

（把 desktop 换成你实际用的 profile；web 版就是 `--profile web`）

### 从 GitHub 安装（发布后）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:<你的用户名>/proposal-generator-cn
```

## 使用

新开会话后直接说：

> 用 proposal-generator-cn 技能，根据这份指南写一份项目申报书

或把指南文件丢给会话，技能会自动匹配触发。

## 工具用法

```powershell
python "C:/Users/<你>/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/proposal-generator-cn/skills/proposal-generator-cn/tools/md2docx.py" 输入.md 输出.docx
```

要求：Python 3.8+，`python-docx`、`lxml`。

## 技能名说明

技能名必须是 kebab-case（`^[a-z0-9-]+$`），所以目录名是 `proposal-generator-cn` 而不是中文「项目书生成」。中文显示名在 description 里。

## 发布到 dsh.so 市场

1. 把本目录推到 GitHub 仓库（名字建议就叫 `proposal-generator-cn`）
2. 在仓库加主题标签 `dsh-plugin`
3. 市场索引会自动抓取（awesome 列表机制），或向 dsh-market 的源列表提交你的仓库

## 版本

v1.0.0 · 基于 SKILL.md v1.2（含 §1.6 公式规范）

plugins.description: Windows native toast notifications plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): agent turn done, subagent done, background job done - click to open the Web UI.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-win-notify

> DSH（DeepSeek Harness）**宿主层** Windows 原生 Toast 通知插件。
> 标签页关掉、浏览器整个关掉，通知照响。

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

---

## 为什么需要它

通知插件可以挂在两个地方，差别很大。

挂在**渲染层**（浏览器半身）的方案，通知逻辑跑在页面里的 JS 上。你把标签页切走、关掉窗口、或者干脆关掉浏览器，它就安静了——恰好是你最需要被叫回来的时候。

本插件挂在**宿主层**（Cordis host 半身），也就是 DSH 主进程里。事件在进程内直接产生，不经过浏览器，因此**前台窗口开不开、标签页在不在，都不影响通知送达**。

| | 宿主层（本插件） | 渲染层 |
|---|---|---|
| 标签页切走 | ✅ 照响 | ⚠️ 取决于实现 |
| 浏览器窗口关闭 | ✅ 照响 | ❌ 失效 |
| 合并 / 去重的落点 | 单个宿主进程，天然单点 | 各页面各自为政，跨页面无法协调 |
| 前台窗口探测 | ✅ 系统级（Win32） | ❌ 只能看页面自身焦点 |

## 功能

下表逐条对应 `index.mjs` 中实际注册的监听（行号以 `index.mjs` 为准，供核对）。

| 触发事件 | 通知内容 | 音效 | 实现位置 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **对话回合完成** | `✅ DSH 对话完成` + 会话标题 + 耗时 | `Notification.IM` | `session/event` → `turn/end` |
| **对话出错 / 中断** | `❌ DSH 出错` / `⚠️ DSH 对话中断` + 原因 | `Notification.Reminder` | 同上，按 `reason.kind` 分支 |
| **子代理完成** | `✅ 子任务完成` / `⚠️ 子任务结束` + 摘要 | 完成 `Notification.IM`；异常结束 `Notification.Reminder` | `ctx.on("subagent/end")` |
| **后台任务（job）完成** | `✅ DSH 任务完成` / `❌ DSH 任务失败` / `⚠️ DSH 任务已取消` | 完成 `Notification.IM`；失败 / 取消 `Notification.Reminder` | `ctx.jobs.events.subscribe({owners:"all"})`，取 `type === "settled"` |
| **模型提问等你回答** | `🤔 DSH 在等你回答` + 问题摘要 + 选项预览 | `Notification.SMS` | `ctx.on("user-questions/request")` |
| **工具审批等你决定** | `🔐 DSH 等待你审批` + 工具名 + 理由 | `Notification.Default` | `ctx.on("approval/request")` |

**顺带覆盖**：计划评审（plan-review）走的是 `user-questions/request` 且带 `intent: "plan-review"`，因此**已被提问通知这条路径覆盖**，无需单独配置。

### 通知行为

| 行为 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **前台探测** | `mode: auto`（默认）下先用 Win32 `GetForegroundWindow` 探测前台窗口；**你正在看 DSH 就不弹**，切走 / 最小化 / 关页面才弹。想看全部通知可设 `always`。 |
| **正文标注** | 通知正文以「`【工作区】会话 · 内容`」的形式标注归属，多工作区并行时能分辨是哪一路跑完了。 |
| **合并** | 同一工作区短窗口内的多会话完成会合并为一条（`✅ DSH 完成 ×N`）；后台 job 与随后的回合完成也会合并。 |
| **速率配额** | 全局限制通知频率，避免多会话同时完成时刷屏（`minIntervalMs` / `ratePerMinute`）。 |
| **免打扰时段** | 支持跨午夜时间窗（如 `23:00-07:30`）；提问与审批默认作为紧急事件**穿透**（`quietUrgent`）。 |
| **点击通知** | Desktop 下抬回 DSH 窗口（`dsh://open`）；其他场景打开带鉴权 token 的 DSH 页面。**不跳转到具体会话**（见「不做」）。 |

### 音效

音效使用 Windows 系统具名音（`Notification.*`），按事件区分：完成类 `Notification.IM`、提问 `Notification.SMS`、审批 `Notification.Default`、出错/中断 `Notification.Reminder`。

> ℹ️ **音效按事件固定，不可自定义。** `sound` 只是开关（`true`/`false`），改不了音色；要换音色需改 `index.mjs` 里的 `SOUND` 表。
>
> ⚠️ 改 `SOUND` 表时须写 `Notification.IM` 这种形式，**不要写 `ms-winsoundevent:Notification.IM`**——后者会被底层通知库判为非 `Notification.` 前缀而**静默改写为默认音**（不报错，只是音效不对）。这也是本插件不提供自定义音频的原因，见「不做」。

## 安装

包名：`@zhang-tod/dsh-win-notify` · 仓库：[zhang-tod/dsh-win-notify](https://github.com/zhang-tod/dsh-win-notify)

装完**必须重启 DSH** 才会加载（宿主层插件在启动时挂载）。

> **重启由你自己操作。** 请通过 DSH 的正常退出 / 启动入口重启，不要在 DSH 运行中直接终止进程——本插件的安装过程不会、也不应该替你重启 DSH。

### DSH Desktop

Desktop 配置档由 Electron 应用独占管理，CLI 的 `dsh plugin` 不接受它（见下方「已知限制」）。请走应用内入口：

1. 侧栏 → **插件**（Plugins）
2. **Add plugin**，填 `@zhang-tod/dsh-win-notify`
3. 安装完成后**启用**该 bundle
4. 由你自行重启 DSH

### CLI 管理的配置档

适用于 `web`、`headless`、`sdk`、`acp` 及自建配置档：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhang-tod/dsh-win-notify
```

随后重启该配置档。

### 卸载

Desktop：侧栏 → **插件** → 找到该 bundle → 卸载 → 由你自行重启 DSH。

CLI 配置档：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove @zhang-tod/dsh-win-notify
```

## 配置

| 配置项 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `auto` | `auto` = 正在看 DSH 时不弹；`always` = 总弹；`never` = 不弹 |
| `turns` | `true` | 对话回合完成通知 |
| `subagents` | `true` | 子代理完成通知 |
| `jobs` | `true` | 后台任务（job）完成通知 |
| `questions` | `true` | 模型提问等你回答时的通知 |
| `approvals` | `true` | 工具审批等你决定时的通知 |
| `sound` | `true` | 是否播放提示音（具名音效见「音效」一节） |
| `port` | `0` | `0` = 自动取 DSH 的实际端口（推荐）。**不要写死端口**：DSH 的端口由系统分配，写死会让「点击通知」开到错误的页 |
| `desktopRaise` | `true` | Desktop 下点击通知抬窗（`dsh://open`）而非开浏览器 |
| `quietHours` | `""` | 免打扰时段，如 `"23:00-07:30"`（支持跨午夜），多段用逗号分隔（`"09:00-12:00,14:00-18:00"`）；空 = 关闭 |
| `quietUrgent` | `true` | 免打扰时段内仍放行紧急事件（提问 / 审批） |
| `minIntervalMs` | `3000` | 全局速率配额：相邻两条通知的最小间隔（`0` = 不限） |
| `ratePerMinute` | `20` | 全局速率配额：每分钟最多发几条（`0` = 不限） |
| `mergeWindowMs` | `3000` | 同工作区多会话完成 / job+回合 的合并窗口 |
| `questionPreviewChars` | `120` | 提问正文预览长度 |
| `questionOptions` | `3` | 选项预览个数（`0` = 不显示选项） |
| `summaryMaxChars` | `120` | 通知正文摘要的最大字符数 |
| `probeTimeoutMs` | `5000` | 前台窗口探测的超时（毫秒） |
| `icon` | `""` | 通知插图（png/jpg/gif 绝对路径）；空 = 内置 DSH 鲸鱼图 |

以上 19 项与 `index.mjs` 的 `DEFAULTS` 一致。覆盖方式：在配置档的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里按 `id: dsh-win-notify` 写 `config`。

## ⚠️ 不做

以下为**有意的能力边界**，不是待办事项。列在这里是为了避免预期落差。

| 不做 | 原因 |
|---|---|
| **跨平台** | 仅支持 Windows。通知、前台探测、点击跳转全部依赖 Win32 与 Windows Toast API，没有 macOS / Linux 实现，也不在计划内。 |
| 自定义音频文件（wav / mp3） | Windows Toast 音效只能用**系统具名音**（本插件用 `Notification.*` 形式）。未打包（unpackaged）应用拿不到 `ms-appx:///` 资源，而 `C:/` 之类的文件路径在 Toast 里是 **Unsupported**。所用通知库还会把任何非 `Notification.` 前缀的音效**静默改写为默认音**。 |
| **toast 按钮一键审批** | 需要注册 COM 服务器并保持常驻进程；且审批决策走 Cordis **waterfall 返回值**，进程外回调无法注入结果。本插件只负责**提醒**，审批仍须回 DSH 界面完成。 |
| **常驻通知**（`scenario="reminder"`） | 系统规定：该场景下若没有能**在后台激活**的 toast 按钮，通知会被**静默忽略**。上一条不做，这一条就没有成立条件。 |
| **点击通知跳转到具体会话** | 宿主层拿不到客户端半身的 `ctx.uiWorkspace` 服务，无法在宿主侧构造指向某个会话的深链接。点击只会打开 DSH 主界面。 |
| **声明 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peerDependencies** | 有意为之。DSH 会拿声明的 peer 范围做兼容性门禁，声明即可能被拦。本插件只依赖稳定的公开宿主 API，故不声明。 |
| **图形设置页** | 第一版不做，配置直接写 `cordis.patch.yml`。 |

## 已知限制

实测得到，如实列出。

| 限制 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 通知归属可能显示为通用值 | 插件使用 Windows Toast 的应用标识去署名通知，默认值取 DSH Desktop 在系统注册的应用标识 `com.deepseek.dsh`。若你所用身份未在系统注册（例如某些 CLI 配置档），通知在系统通知中心里的**来源名称与图标可能显示为通用值**——这不影响通知内容与点击行为。 |
| 前台探测可能失效 | 探测依赖**窗口标题 / 进程名的文本匹配**。窗口标题被改写（浏览器扩展、自定义标题、远程/虚拟桌面等）时匹配不上，会出现「正看着 DSH 却仍然弹通知」。 |
| 全权限下收不到审批通知 | DSH 处于全权限（`approval: never`）时，系统层面**根本不会发出审批请求**，因此本插件不会（也无法）为该事件弹通知。这是预期行为，不是缺陷。 |
| Desktop 配置档不能用 CLI 装 | `dsh plugin --profile desktop` 被 DSH 直接拒绝：`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`。这是 DSH 的既有机制，非本插件缺陷；请走应用内「插件」页。 |

## 常见问题

**装完没反应？**
宿主层插件在启动时挂载，装完必须**重启 DSH**。

**标签页关了还会响吗？**
会。插件在 DSH 主进程里跑，与浏览器页面无关。

**支持 macOS / Linux 吗？**
不支持，仅 Windows。见「不做」。

**怎么彻底静音？**
把 `mode` 设为 `never` 可关闭全部通知；只想关掉声音、保留弹窗，则把音效开关（`sound`）设为 `false`。具体配置项见「配置」章节。

**为什么我点了通知没跳到刚才那个会话？**
这是有意为之。点击通知会打开 **DSH 主界面**，不会定位到某个具体会话——宿主层拿不到客户端半身的会话导航服务。会话级跳转见「不做」。

**用 CLI / 浏览器方式访问 DSH 时，点通知能打开吗？**
能。DSH 的界面地址需要鉴权 token，本插件会在打开时自动带上，因此打开后是**可直接使用**的界面，而不是 401 错误页。（Desktop 用户点通知则是把 DSH 窗口抬到前台。）

**审批时怎么没弹通知？**
先确认 DSH 不是全权限模式（`approval: never`）。该模式下系统层面根本不发出审批请求，插件自然收不到——不是插件没实现。切到需要审批的权限档（如 `ask`）即可验证。

## 实现说明

| 项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 运行位置 | DSH 宿主进程（Cordis host 半身），非渲染层 |
| 通知通道 | [`node-notifier`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/node-notifier) 发 Windows Toast；不可用时降级为 PowerShell WinRT toast（降级路径无点击跳转） |
| 前台探测 | 调用 Win32 `GetForegroundWindow` / `GetWindowText` / `GetWindowThreadProcessId`，带短时结果缓存 |
| 事件来源 | DSH 公开宿主 API（`session/event`、`subagent/end`、jobs 服务、提问服务等），不使用私有内部接口 |

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 Zhang Zhaodong

plugins.readme_text:
> 🕒 v3 · 2026-10-08 20:40 · dsh-agent ｜ 变更：诚实化定位（中文字体支持来自 SciencePlots）+ 新增效果截图区 ｜ 上一版：v2 · 2026-10-08 20:28

# sci-figures — 科研作图技能包（DSH Skill）

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 用的科研作图技能：从「这张图要证明什么」到成图，含期刊样式工具箱、四个可复用图式、六条出图路线实测对比。

**它做什么**：把科研出图的**图式**（怎么用图形讲一句话）和**踩坑**固化成可复用资产，并在 [SciencePlots](https://github.com/garrettj403/SciencePlots) 之上封装一个默认栈（字体回退链 + 关掉 `text.usetex` 冲突 + 矢量字体嵌入 + 色盲安全配色）。

> ⚠️ **中文字体支持主要来自 SciencePlots 的 `cjk-sc-font`**（其官方文档已支持简体中文），本技能做的是在其之上少踩坑，**不是它的替代品**。本技能独有的部分是**五个图式**与**踩坑清单**。

## 装

本仓库根目录**就是**技能目录。clone 后放进 DSH 的**用户级技能根**：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/yanggaihao5-sys/dsh-sci-figures.git
cp -r dsh-sci-figures ~/.dsh/skills/sci-figures
```

Windows（PowerShell）：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/yanggaihao5-sys/dsh-sci-figures.git
Copy-Item -Recurse dsh-sci-figures "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\sci-figures"
```

依赖（按需，缺了会自动回退不报错）：

```bash
pip install scienceplots matplotlib            # 期刊样式（推荐）
pip install plotly kaleido plotnine altair vl-convert-python   # 可选：另外五条路线
```

## 有什么

| 文件 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `SKILL.md` | 技能主文件：五步流程、硬规则、命名约定、更新协议 |
| `scripts/mpl_style.py` | 工具箱：`use()` / `save()` / `save_pgf()` / `PALETTE` + 四个图式函数 |
| `references/图式库.md` | 图式库：钉子 · 阶梯 · 滑轴 · 魔方串烧（append-only，持续追加实例） |
| `references/工具链.md` | 六条出图路线实测对比（SciencePlots / pgf / TikZ / Plotly / Plotnine / Altair）+ 实测坑 |

## 效果

示例图全部由 `examples/make_examples.py` 用固定 seed 生成，**可复跑**（不是手放的死图）：

| 钉子（钉住关键点） | 阶梯（分阶段抬升 + 事件标注） |
|---|---|
| ![钉子](examples/fig1_nail.png) | ![阶梯](examples/fig2_staircase.png) |

| 滑轴（断轴看全貌 + 尾部） | 魔方串烧（多快照共享色标） |
|---|---|
| ![滑轴](examples/fig3_sliding.png) | ![魔方串烧](examples/fig4_cube_skewer.png) |

复跑：

```bash
python examples/make_examples.py
```

## 自检

```bash
python scripts/mpl_style.py     # 四个图式各出一张，验证工具箱可用
```

## 一句话选法

- 图里有**中文**（中文期刊 / 毕业论文）→ 本技能，`use()` 已处理字体回退与 usetex 冲突
- 论文是 **LaTeX** 写的 → 再出 `.pgf`（`save_pgf()`），字体与正文完全一致
- 纯英文 + 目标是 Nature/CNS 系版式 → 用第三方 `nature-figure` 类技能

## License

MIT

--- description: "CESP/OpenPeon sound packs and browser notifications for the dsh web client: browse and install packs from the OpenPeon registry, pick one, and play per-moment sounds with an in-app toast plus an optional native notification" kind: "package-reference" --- # dsh-openpeon English | [中文](README.zh.md) Unofficial client of [OpenPeon CESP v1.0](https://github.com/PeonPing/openpeon); not affiliated with PeonPing. It bundles **no audio** — see [License](#license). ## Summary Makes a session audible: when the session's state changes, you hear a sound and see a notification. - Sounds for six moments: a session starts or ends, the agent starts working or finishes, it fails, or it needs your input. - An in-app banner, plus an OS notification if you allow it. - Sound packs come from the [OpenPeon registry](https://github.com/PeonPing/registry): browse and download them in the settings page, then listen, switch or delete them. ## Install This plugin lives outside the DSH checkout, at `~/coding/dsh-plugins/dsh-openpeon`, so the upstream tree keeps tracking clean. It is registered entirely from the machine-local profile: 1. Add the package to `~/.dsh/profiles//package.json`: ```json "dependencies": { "dsh-openpeon": "file:/Users/xzong/coding/dsh-plugins/dsh-openpeon" } ``` 2. Load its row in `~/.dsh/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - insert: - id: dsh-openpeon name: "dsh-openpeon" config: {} ``` 3. `pnpm install` inside that profile directory, then `pnpm build` here. The pack ships as `lib/index.js` (host half, Node builtins only) and `lib/client.js` (browser half, baseline modules only), so nothing here needs to be published or installed next to the DSH sources. ----- ## Table of Contents - [Use it](#use-this-package) - [Understand the implementation](#understand-the-implementation) - [Further Exploration](#further-exploration) - [Model Experience](#model-experience) - [Known Limitations and Deferred Work](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) - [License](#license) ----- ## Use it Open **Settings → openpeon**. 1. **Pick a sound pack.** The page lists the packs you have installed and the 370 packs the registry offers. Search by name, author, tag or language. Each catalogue row shows the pack's author, license, trust tier, size and sound count. *Download* installs one; once installed, *Preview* plays one of its sounds, *Use* makes it the active pack, and *Delete* removes it. Only what you download is kept, on your machine. 2. **Choose the moments.** Each of the six rows has its own switch and its own *Preview* button, so you can hear that moment's sound without waiting for it to happen. This works even while alerts are off. 3. **Turn alerts on** with the switch at the top, and set the volume with the slider. Your choices are remembered in this browser. Each sound is a [CESP v1.0](https://github.com/PeonPing/openpeon) category, and a pack supplies its audio under those category names. The third column is therefore what a pack has to fill for that sound to play: | Sound | What sets it off | CESP category | |---|---|---| | Session start | a session appears | `session.start` | | Working | the agent starts on a turn | `task.acknowledge` | | Finished | the turn stops — including when you interrupt it | `task.complete` | | Failure | the agent hits an error | `task.error` | | Needs input | an approval or a question is waiting for your answer | `input.required` | | Session end | a session goes away | `session.end` | A pack need not cover all six — a moment whose category it leaves out simply stays silent, so if one moment matters to you, check that the pack lists its category before installing. The standard defines nine categories; the other three have no DSH event to ride, so they are not offered — see [Known Limitations](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work). Nothing plays until you install a pack and turn alerts on. Browsers only allow audio after you have interacted with the page, so the first alert of a page can be silent — after that it works for the rest of the page's life. ## Understand the implementation One Cordis package with two sides. The **Host side** runs in the harness process and owns the files, the network and the routes; the **Client side** runs in the browser and owns the settings page, the banners and playback. The two sides only ever talk over one HTTP prefix, `/openpeon`. ### Host side (`src/index.ts` → `src/host/`) Files: - `routes.ts` — owns the request surface - `registry.ts` — fetches and caches the index - `packs.ts` — validates manifests and verifies digests - `paths.ts` — owns the `$DSH_HOME` layout and refuses paths that escape it - `http.ts` — performs the downloads The plugin registers the following API routes: - catalogue route (`state`, `registry`, `install`, `remove`, `active`) - per-moment audio route (`sound/`) - preview route (`preview//`) Nothing on that prefix is authenticated: those reads are as open as the frontend's other non-index assets. The three endpoints that change something (`install`, `remove`, `active`) additionally require the request to come from the page's own origin, so another document cannot make your browser install or delete a pack. That check constrains browsers only: a client sending no `Origin` at all (`curl`, a local script) passes it, which leaves the server's listen address as the boundary that actually keeps requests local. The plugin keeps its files in `$DSH_HOME/dsh-openpeon/`, so upgrading the plugin never disturbs them: - `registry.json` — a cache of the whole pack index, plus a fetch timestamp. Valid for six hours; past that it is refetched, and a failed refetch keeps this copy. - `state.json` — the pack you have selected, or `null` when you have none. - `packs//` — an installed pack: its own `openpeon.json`, its install record, and its audio. It comes from the jsDelivr CDN, and only the files the six moments actually reference are downloaded, so a pack costs less than its advertised size. Nothing is installed until the integrity checks pass: 1. the pack's `openpeon.json` must match the SHA-256 the index publishes for it — until that passes, no audio is downloaded at all; 2. every sound file must match the SHA-256 its `openpeon.json` records (packs that declare none skip this step). Updates compare the same manifest hash: when the index now publishes a different one than the install recorded, the pack is offered as updatable. `version` is not used for this — a pack's own `version` disagrees with the index's for roughly one pack in seven. The browser keeps none of it: the catalogue, the audio and the previews are all served `no-store`, leaving only your alert preferences in localStorage under `dsh-notifications`. ### Client side (`src/client/`) Files: - `index.ts` — the entry: registers the locale namespace, creates the stores, injects the two slot contributions and subscribes to events - `locales.ts` — the Chinese and English dictionaries - `notification-store.ts` — persists preferences to localStorage under `dsh-notifications` - `NotificationSettingsSection.tsx` — the `openpeon` settings page, audition buttons included - `pack-store.ts` — installed-pack and catalogue state - `PackPicker.tsx` — the installed list and the pack catalogue - `sound-player.ts` — one lazily created `AudioContext`, silent on any failure, and a queue that orders fetching and starting rather than completion - `toast-store.ts` — replaces the current banner instead of stacking - `ToastContainer.tsx` — renders that banner Each component keeps its `.module.css` beside it. Contributes two slots: - `settings.section` — the `openpeon` page: id `openpeon`, order 100, nav label from the locale - `shell.overlay` — the toast container, id `notifications-toast` It registers the locale namespace and subscribes to the forwarded Host event behind each moment: | Forwarded event | CESP category | Mode | |---|---|---| | `approval/request` | `input.required` | waterfall | | `user-questions/request` | `

plugins.description: Project Forge — a DeepSeek Harness agent preset: local-only git, four state documents, layout & naming discipline, compaction recovery, five write guards.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-project-forge

English | [中文](docs/README.zh.md)

**Project Forge (项目锻造模式)** — a DeepSeek Harness agent preset that turns an agent into the steward of a project: it keeps the project recoverable (local git), traceable (four state documents + decision log), well-organized (layout & naming discipline), and safe to continue after context loss (compaction recovery), with five write guards that hold even when the model does not cooperate.

It ships two presets:

| Preset | For |
|---|---|
| `project-forge` | Full stewardship: protocol, live document digest, compaction recovery, 5 write guards |
| `project-forge-review` (in `review/`) | Read-mostly review mode: code review, simple tasks, clean-room subagents |

## Install

```sh
# Local development checkout
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-project-forge
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-project-forge/review

# Or straight from git
dsh plugin --profile web add github:sopreigj/dsh-project-forge#main
```

Bundle plugins take effect after restarting `dsh web`. Then pick 项目锻造模式 / 项目锻造 · 干净审查 in the mode picker.

## What the mode enforces

- **Local-only git**: never push, add a remote, or rewrite history until the user explicitly asks.
- **Four state documents** at the project root: `done.md` (current state + shortest reproducible path), `todo.md` (queue), `plan.md` (strategy), `tortuous.md` (negative knowledge, fixed entry template). The digest inlines the tail of the first three plus repo state and `.agents/steward.md` every turn.
- **Checkpoint protocol**: close a logical unit → run checks → update documents → one commit. Never commit per command.
- **Layout & naming**: directory/file/identifier names follow one-word-one-meaning at every level; checked at every checkpoint; the layout guard refuses unacknowledged mixed-artifact roots.
- **Parallel sessions**: single document owner, per-file claims released on commit, stale claims self-clean (30 min).
- **No secrets in git**: refuses to commit credential files (`.env`, `*.pem`, ...).
- **Compaction recovery**: a real `compaction/end` event folds a recovery message (protocol restatement + fresh digest) into the next step.

## Configuration

All switches default on; set `false` to disable.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `protocol` / `recoveryProcedure` | `true` | register the protocol / recovery prompt sections |
| `digest` / `digestFiles` | `true` / `[plan.md, todo.md, done.md]` | inline document tails every turn |
| `digestTailLimits` | `{plan.md:20000, todo.md:10000, done.md:20000}` | per-document tail budget |
| `digestMaxBytes` | `32768` | overall digest ceiling |
| `stewardFile` / `stewardFilePath` | `true` / `.agents/steward.md` | inline the repo's own rules |
| `injectOnCompaction` / `recoveryMinTurnStep` | `true` / `1` | recovery message, at most one per turn |
| `guardLocalGit` / `guardCommitCheckpoint` / `guardLayoutCheckpoint` / `guardSecrets` / `guardConcurrentWrite` | `true` | the five write guards |
| `concurrentWriteMode` | `both` | which files the claim guard protects |

## Layout of this repo

```
dsh-project-forge/
├── package.json          # bundle manifest (dsh.bundle.patch)
├── cordis.patch.yml      # the preset composition (project-forge)
├── plugin/               # the mode plugin (protocol + digest + recovery + guards)
├── skills/project-forge-grilling/   # bundled discussion skill
├── review/               # the review-mode bundle (its own package.json)
└── README.md / LICENSE
```

## Development

```sh
node plugin/index.test.mjs plugin/index.js   # self-test (config, digest, all five guards)
```

The plugin imports only Node builtins — profile-installed bundles resolve no third-party packages. The hand-written Standard Schema in `plugin/schema.js` implements the exact `~standard.validate` interface Cordis requires (the official docs use `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`; a hand-written schema is used here to keep the bundle dependency-free).

## Boundaries (read before trusting it)

- Guards refuse at the shell-tool boundary; they are anti-slip, not a security boundary (alternate phrasing/scripts/provider APIs can bypass).
- Guard E protects high-contention files only (the four documents + `.agents/steward.md` + source files); merge conflicts in ordinary files are git's job.
- The protocol is prompt text: it is always *present*; whether the model *obeys* is not machine-verified except where a guard enforces it.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](./LICENSE).

plugins.description: 出口管制物项台账核对：依据《中华人民共和国出口管制法》。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-export-ctl-check — Export-control item register and licence closure cross-check

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-export-ctl-check` reads one export-control item register — the exporter header plus one row per item — and cross-checks that register's own completeness and closure rather than any judgement about the items: whether each item states in the 是否受控 column whether it is controlled, whether an item marked as controlled carries a 出口许可证号, whether a licence number that is filled in is accompanied by an issue date, whether the end use or the end user is recorded, whether the destination is recorded, whether a licence number repeats inside the same register, whether the control category is one of the institution's own 管制类别 values, and whether a placeholder such as 【】, XXX, 待填, TBD or 示例 still survives in the item-name column.

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-export-ctl-check: real output over its EC-001 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-export-ctl-check/main/docs/assets/dsh-export-ctl-check-demo.png)

Real output from this plugin over its own `EC-001` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| Is it reported when an item marked as controlled has no licence number? | `EC-002` reports that gap: for a row whose 是否受控 value is one the rule is configured to treat as controlled — shipped as `是`, `Y`, `yes`, `true`, `受控`, `√` — it requires a 出口许可证号. It checks only that the number is filled in; it does not judge whether the licence is genuine, still valid, or covers that item and that destination. If your register writes some other word for controlled, add it to the rule's condition values, or the row counts as not controlled and the rule stays silent — this plugin holds no control list to decide the question for you. |
| An item states whether it is controlled but leaves the 最终用途 and 最终用户 columns empty — does anything catch that? | `EC-004` reports the row: it asks for at least one of those two columns to be filled. One of the two is enough, and the rule does not judge whether the stated use or user is true or whether the case is one the law prohibits or restricts. |
| A licence number is written down but the issue-date column is blank. Is that a finding? | `EC-003` requires it. The condition is the licence number: a row without one is not asked for a date at all. The rule does not check the licence's validity period, and it does not weigh the issue date against the export date — it establishes that a date is there, not that it comes first. |
| One and the same licence number appears on several rows. What does the check say? | `EC-006` reports the number as repeated across the register. It cannot tell a single licence covering several items — a normal way to keep the register — from a number copied by mistake, so a hit needs a person to confirm it; the rule does not renumber anything, and it does not say how many rows may share one licence. If your register is deliberately written one-licence-many-items, give the rows of that licence a serial number, or switch the rule off. |
| A row has no 最终目的地 at all. | `EC-005` reports it, because every item has to carry a destination. It checks that the column is filled, not that the destination is permitted: whether a country or region is embargoed or restricted is read from lists the competent authority publishes, and this plugin holds no country list of its own. |
| The item-name column still reads `【示例】` or `XXX` — is that treated as a defect or as a real name? | `EC-008` reports the row when the name contains one of the terms the rule looks for — `【`, `】`, `{{`, `}}`, `XXX`, `xxx`, `待填`, `待补充`, `TBD`, `todo` or `示例`. That term list follows your own template and can be adjusted. The rule looks for those terms in that one column only: it never judges whether the name itself is factually correct. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《中华人民共和国出口管制法》 | 2020 年 10 月 17 日第十三届全国人大常委会第二十二次会议通过，主席令第五十八号公布，自 2020 年 12 月 1 日起施行 | EC-001, EC-002, EC-003, EC-004, EC-005, EC-006, EC-008 |
| 《中华人民共和国出口管制法》 | 现行版本本次未核实 | EC-007 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks an **出口管制物项台账** for the closed loop a register can be held to — that
each item states whether it is controlled, that a controlled item carries a licence number, that a licence
carries an issue date, that the end use or end user is recorded, that a destination is recorded, that licence
numbers do not repeat, that the control category comes from your vocabulary, and that no placeholder survives.
It does **not** decide whether an item is controlled, whether a licence is required, or whether an export would
breach the rules.

> ### ⚠️ What this plugin deliberately cannot do
>
> **It does not contain the control list, and it does not try to map a commodity code or a technical parameter
> onto a list entry.** Because of that it **cannot find the most serious defect of all: an item that should
> have been declared controlled and was not.** Whether an item is controlled is the exporter's own
> determination under the law, and confirming it means checking the published list. This limit is stated in
> the pack's header, in each rule's note, and in the troubleshooting section below — it is the single most

>

# dsh-paper-doc-adapter — Parsed exam paper structural self-consistency check across question type, answer, score and yotta identifier

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-paper-doc-adapter` reads one parsed exam paper — the paper header plus one row per question — and checks that parse result's own structural self-consistency: that each question records its number and stem, that an answer or an explanation is present, that the question scores total the paper score the header states, that the question type comes from the vocabulary you configure, that the difficulty coefficient falls inside your range, that question identifiers are present and unique, that a knowledge point is recorded, and that no template placeholder survives in the stem.

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-paper-doc-adapter: real output over its PD-006 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-paper-doc-adapter/main/docs/assets/dsh-paper-doc-adapter-demo.png)

Real output from this plugin over its own `PD-006` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| Both the question number and the stem are blank on a row — does the check say anything? | Yes. `PD-001` reports a row whose `questionNo` and `stem` are both empty, because it asks for at least one of the two. It checks that something is filled, not whether the question is well written or the stem rigorous. |
| A question has its number and stem, but neither an answer nor an explanation. | `PD-002` reports that row: it asks for at least one of `answer` and `explanation`. It does not check whether the answer is correct — that is subject-expert review, and the pack says as much. |
| The question scores add up to 98 while the header says 100 — is that caught? | Yes. `PD-003` adds the `score` column and compares the total with the `totalScore` the paper header states, allowing the configured tolerance of 0.01; if the header total is not a parseable number it reports itself in `skipped` instead. It only does the addition — whether the marks are distributed sensibly is not judged. |
| We never listed our own question types. What does the tool do with the question type column? | `PD-004` reports itself in `skipped`, because its `values` list ships empty: naming question types is your institution's convention and the engine hard-codes no list. Once you configure your values, a `questionType` outside them is reported; the rule then checks membership only, and it performs no question-type-specific structure check. |
| The difficulty column holds `1.2` in one row and `中等` in another — what comes back? | `PD-005` reports the value it cannot parse as a number and the value outside the configured `min`/`max` range of 0–1. That range is your institution's convention, not the only scale — 1–5 or a percentage needs `min`/`max` changed or the rule disabled. It checks the range only, never whether the difficulty is appropriate, and it is capped at `info`. |
| Two questions carry the same yotta identifier. Why is that worse than a blank one? | `PD-006` reports the repeated value, comparing with whitespace ignored, because importing that parse result would silently overwrite an existing question; a blank identifier only keeps that one question out. With no identifier filled anywhere the rule reports itself in `skipped`. It checks presence and uniqueness, and nothing beyond that. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《试题元数据规范》 | JY/T 0606 系列（本次未取得条文） | PD-001, PD-002, PD-003, PD-006, PD-007, PD-008 |
| 本机构题库与命题口径（本机构配置） | 无统一标准（本条依据为本机构配置的题型口径） | PD-004 |
| 本机构题库与命题口径（本机构配置） | 无统一标准（本条依据为本机构配置的难度口径） | PD-005 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks a **试卷解析结果** for structural self-consistency — that each question records its
number and stem, that an answer or an explanation is present, that the question scores total the paper's score,
that the question type comes from your vocabulary, that the difficulty coefficient falls inside your range, that
question identifiers are present and unique, that a knowledge point is recorded, and that no placeholder survives.
It does **not** decide whether a question is well written, whether an answer is correct, whether the difficulty is
appropriate, or whether the paper meets its assessment objectives.

> ### ⚠️ What this plugin deliberately does not do
>
> **It treats the paper as a generic table and performs no question-type-specific checking.** So it **does not
> verify that an answer letter falls within the options offered**, that a fill-in-the-blank has the right number of
> blanks, or that a multiple-choice question has exactly one correct option. Those need the structure of each
> question type parsed, which this adapter does not attempt. That boundary is stated in the pack's header and in
> the troubleshooting section.
>
> **It never checks whether data is fit to import into a question bank beyond key presence and uniqueness.** A
> duplicate identifier is the dangerous case — importing would silently overwrite an existing question — which is
> why `PD-006` is `warn` and why it reports itself in `skipped` when no identifier column is present rather than
> checking the wrong column.
>
> **The difficulty range `0–1` is a local convention, not the only scale.** It is the common convention, larger
> meaning easier; a unit using 1–5 or a percentage can change `min`/`max` or disable the rule.
>
> **Every `excerpt` in the rule pack says, in so many words, that the clause text was not obtained** — the
> verification pass retrieved neither JY/T 0606's text nor the yotta platform's field specification. When the
> texts are in hand, replace each `excerpt` with the real clause and raise `kind` to `direct`.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.1`. `engines.dsh` is deliberately not declared: it has no reader and cannot reject a host |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native`, `ptc` and `both`; for a full paper use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `paper_doc_adapter` tool. It reads one parsed paper — the paper header plus one row per question —
applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PD-001` | the question number and stem are recorded | warn | principle |
| `PD-002` | an answer or an explanation is present | warn | principle |
| `PD-003` | the question scores total the paper score | warn | principle |
| `PD-004` | the question type comes from your vocabulary (off by default) | info | local |
| `PD-005` | the difficulty coefficient is inside your range | info | local |
| `PD-006` | question identifiers are present and unique | warn | principle |
| `PD-007` | a knowledge point is recorded | warn | principle |
| `PD-008` | the stem holds no unreplaced placeholder | warn | principle |

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-paper-doc-adapter
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-paper-doc-adapter'
```

## Configuration

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rulesFile` | string | `rules/paper-doc-adapter.yaml` | Rule-pack path, relative to the package root |
| `disabledRules` | string[] | `[]` | Rule ids to stop running; each appears in `skipped` |
| `onlyRules` | string[] | `[]` | Run only these rule ids; empty runs every rule |
| `skipNotes` | string | `""` | Note appended to every `skipped` reason |
| `timeoutMs` | number | `120000` | Cooperative tool timeout budget |

Rule-level parameters worth knowing:

- `PD-003` `field` / `headerField` / `tolerance` — the score column and the header total it must match.
- `PD-004` `values` — your question types, e.g.
  `[单选题, 多选题, 判断题, 填空题, 简答题, 计算题, 作文题]`. Empty me
