plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Chess Game

国际象棋 × 两种形态：**单文件网页版**（双人同屏）+ **DeepSeek Harness Web 插件**（悬浮窗，双人/人机对战，PGN 导出）。零依赖、完全离线。

## 网页版（index.html）

两个人在同一台电脑上用鼠标轮流对战，浏览器打开 `index.html` 即玩。

- 白方先行，点一下自己的棋子（显示可走格圆点），再点一下目标格落子
- 红圈表示可吃子；被将军的王红圈高亮提示

## DSH 插件 dsh-chess-float（packages/chess-float/）

在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面里下棋：输入框工具栏 **♟ 按钮** → 弹出**可拖动悬浮窗**。

**功能**：

- 双人对战 / 人机对战（可选执白或执黑）
- 人机 AI：本地 negamax + αβ 剪枝引擎，5 级难度（入门→大师，难度=搜索深度，低难度带随机失误），毫秒级响应、零模型调用、完全离线
- 完整规则：王车易位、吃过路兵、兵升变、将杀、逼和、50 回合规则、子力不足和棋
- 悔棋（人机模式自动回退双方各一步）、SAN 标准记谱、**PGN 棋谱导出**（可导入 Lichess / chess.com 复盘）
- 主题 token 适配明暗主题

**安装**：

```bash
# 从源码（本仓库）
dsh plugin add packages/chess-float

# 离线安装（其他机器）
mkdir -p ~/plugins/chess-float
tar -xzf dsh-chess-float-1.2.0.tgz -C ~/plugins/chess-float --strip-components=1
dsh plugin add ~/plugins/chess-float
```

预构建 tarball 见 [Releases](https://github.com/x-cores/dsh-chess-game/releases)。安装后刷新 Web 页面即可看到 ♟ 按钮。

## 正确性验证

走法引擎通过标准 perft 校验（走法枚举数与国际象棋公认参考值完全一致）：

| 测试局面 | 深度 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 初始局面 | 1–4 层 | 20 / 400 / 8,902 / 197,281 ✓ |
| CPW #3（吃过路兵密集） | 1–5 层 | 14 / 191 / 2,812 / 43,238 / 674,624 ✓ |
| CPW #4（易位/升变密集） | 1–4 层 | 6 / 264 / 9,467 / 422,333 ✓ |

AI 引擎验证：深度 3 对随机对手 71 步将杀（约 44ms/步）；大师(5) 单步约 1.2s。

## 运行测试

```bash
node test-perft.js      # perft 规则校验
node test-gameplay.js   # 完整对局路径模拟（易位/过路兵/升变/SAN）
```

plugins.description: Add folder references to the DeepSeek Harness web composer: host folder dialog, /folder command, and folder drag/paste resolved into @path mentions.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-folder-attach

[![test](https://github.com/sixzjd/dsh-folder-attach/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/sixzjd/dsh-folder-attach/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

DSH 网页版拖入文件夹会被拒绝：「只有桌面端支持添加文件夹，浏览器里请添加单个文件」。
这个插件让它在**纯浏览器**里可用 —— 拖文件夹、`/folder`、主机文件夹选择框，都插入标准 `@路径` 引用。

> [English](README.en.md) · 需要 dsh `>= 0.2.0-rc.2`

## 背景

DSH 的输入框对"拖入/粘贴文件夹"有一条硬性限制：

```js
const bridge = globalThis.__DSH_HOST_PATHS__;
if (bridge === void 0 && directory) return t("attachment.directoryDesktopOnly");
// → "只有桌面端支持添加文件夹，浏览器里请添加单个文件"
```

浏览器出于安全**不会**给出拖入文件夹的绝对路径，只有桌面端（Electron shell 注入 `__DSH_HOST_PATHS__`）能把 `File` 映射回真实路径。而 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 目前**没有发布桌面端**：`dsh web` 只有 `--host/--port/--no-open/--trusted-host`，全量搜索也没有任何包写入该全局。

本插件不去绕过这个限制，而是**换一个问题来源**：不问浏览器要路径，问宿主机要。

## 原理

Web 界面分两半：浏览器里的 client，和你机器上的 Node host。浏览器是沙箱化的，**host 不是**。

DSH 已经自带一个宿主目录选择能力（`dsh-host-directory-picker-auto`）。在 macOS + 回环绑定时它解析成 `native` 后端，在**宿主机**上执行：

```
osascript -e 'choose folder' -e 'POSIX path of selectedFolder'
```

返回一个真实的绝对路径。插件把它接到输入框上——桌面端那条判定根本不会被触发。

拖入的文件夹则用 `fileReferences/list`（`@` 补全菜单背后的同一个索引）按名称解析：一次调用，宿主自己的模糊索引，已排除 `node_modules` 等。

## 功能

| 入口 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 输入框左侧「添加文件夹」 | 在宿主机弹出系统文件夹对话框，选中后插入 `@目录/` |
| `/folder` 命令 | 同上 |
| 拖入 / 粘贴文件夹 | 按名称在工作区内解析，插入 `@目录/`；同批普通文件走原有上传通道 |

插入的是**标准 `@路径` mention**，与桌面端拖文件夹产生的等价：工作区内用相对形式，工作区外保留绝对形式，含空格自动加引号。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-folder-attach
```

也可以从 GitHub 装（同一份源码，可钉到某个 tag）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:sixzjd/dsh-folder-attach
```

也可以在侧边栏 **插件 → 添加插件** 里填上面的地址。装完刷新浏览器页面。

<details>
<summary>从源码安装</summary>

```bash
git clone https://github.com/sixzjd/dsh-folder-attach.git
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web        # 或你的 profile 目录
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-folder-attach
```

</details>

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-folder-attach
```

或在插件页关闭开关。插件只在浏览器内注册一个 composer 槽位、一个斜杠命令和两个事件监听器，不写任何全局对象，卸载即无痕。

## 开发

```bash
npm test          # 两个回归测试
npm run check     # 语法检查 + 测试
```

无需构建：`dsh-client-modules` 把 `lib/client.js` **逐字节原样**作为浏览器 bundle 服务，所以它按 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 格式手写。

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | 空的宿主侧 `apply`，让包成为 Loader 条目、从而被扫描到 |
| `lib/client.js` | 全部行为 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 该 bundle 启用时贡献的组合层 |
| `locale/{en,zh}.json` | 插件页显示名（**`en.json` 必须存在**，否则 `zh.json` 不会被读取） |

## 依赖的公开接缝

只用官方声明过的扩展点，不改写官方代码、不打 monkeypatch：

- `ctx.slots.inject("conversation.input.left", …)` — 官方文档点名的 composer 扩展位
- 该座位的标准 props：`sessionId`、`inputActions`、`t`
- `ctx.commandUi.register({ name: "folder", ui: { kind: "action" } })`
- `ctx.remote.directoryPicker.pick()` — 宿主系统对话框，返回绝对路径
- `ctx.remote.fileReferences.list(sessionId, query)` — `@` 菜单背后的索引查询

## 已知限制

- **拖入/粘贴**的文件夹只能按名称在工作区内解析。浏览器不给路径，这无法回避；解析不到时明确报错并提示改用对话框，不会猜一个路径。
- 拖入产生的是 `@目录/` **纯文本 mention**，不是桌面端那种带图标的文件夹 chip——chip 需要真实路径。功能等价，外观不同。
- 索引查询有返回上限，极端情况下同名文件夹可能不在候选里，此时按未解析处理。
- 若 profile 把目录选择解析成 `browse` 后端（远程 / SSH 访问），系统对话框不可用，`pick` 会拒绝并提示；此时仍可用拖拽解析。
- 混合拖拽（文件夹 + 图片）时，插件会复刻 composer 的图片数量/体积预检，**但只统计本次拖入的图片**：已挂载的附件没有任何公开接口可读。宿主侧 `validateImageBatch` 仍按整条消息强制校验，所以这不是漏洞，只是提示可能来得更早、口径更宽。
- 插件页显示名依赖 `locale/en.json` 存在。

## 为什么它能活过 dsh 升级

兼容性闸门只校验 `peerDependencies` 里 `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` 前缀的版本，本插件不声明它，因此升级不会让 bundle 被跳过。真正的风险是上面那些接缝改名——那时表现是**静默不显示**，不会拖垮 DSH。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: Wire protocol for DSH Remote Control: sealed-record encryption (XSalsa20-Poly1305), key derivation, pairing URI, relay control frames, payload catalog. Pure functions, zero I/O. DSH 远控的线协议层：密封记录加密、KDF、配对 URI、控制帧与载荷目录，纯函数零 I/O。
plugins.readme_text:
# @dsh-remote/protocol

DSH Remote Control 的**线协议层**：密封记录（XSalsa20-Poly1305）、方向密钥派生（KDF）、
配对 URI、中继控制帧、`cmd.*` / `ev.*` 载荷目录、错误码可重试表、防休眠命令构造器。

**纯函数、零 I/O**：不认识时钟、不认识平台、不发定时器——所以每条冻结契约都能脱离环境
逐字节被测（含 golden vectors 对拍：与小程序里那份保留实现的 SHA-256 锚定）。

## 安装

```sh
npm install @dsh-remote/protocol
```

## 结构

| 子路径       | 内容                                                      |
| ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `…/keys`     | PSK 生成、两把方向密钥的 HKDF 风格派生、计数器 nonce      |
| `…/record`   | `seal()` / `open()`——基于 tweetnacl 的密封记录            |
| `…/frames`   | 中继控制帧的 zod schema + 解析器（帧名冻结，v1）          |
| `…/limits`   | 三端共享的数值预算（帧上限 / 附件上限 / 去重窗口）        |
| `…/registry` | 帧名 / 载荷名 / 能力 id 的注册表（编译期与 zod 联合一致） |
| `…/payloads` | `cmd.*` / `ev.*` 载荷目录的 zod schema                    |
| `…/pairing`  | `dshr:/p?...` 配对 URI 编解码、6 位码工具                 |
| `…/sleep`    | 防休眠命令构造器（`caffeinate` / `systemd-inhibit`）      |

完整清单见 `package.json` 的 `exports`；根入口会把全部子路径再导出一次。

## 开发

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test        # tsc 构建 + node --test
pnpm typecheck
```

## 红线

- **协议中立**：不引入任何传输层（WS / SSE / HTTP）与平台概念——游标、ack 这类
  会话层语义可以进协议，但「因为是 WS 所以……」不可以。
- 帧名与载荷名**冻结**：改动既有形状就是**破坏性变更**，必须同时升 `PROTOCOL_VERSION`
  并让三端一起升（`hello.protocol` 必填且必须与本端相等，不相等的一端在握手上就被拒）。
  ⚠️ 这里原来写的是"增量只许走**能力位**，不许改既有形状"——那条机制（
  `hello.capabilities` / `ev.host_info.caps` 与三端的降级分支）**已整条删除**
  （2026-10-11 用户裁决：没有真实用户，只留单版本制）。所以现在没有"偷偷加、对端不支持就退回"
  这条路：要么同版本，要么明说。
- 本包**不许出现** `node:fs` / `node:os` / `process.*`（I/O 全部在消费方）。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: Live CPU, memory and GPU readout in the DeepSeek Harness composer status bar.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-dock-vitals

Live **CPU / memory / GPU** readout in the DeepSeek Harness composer status bar — a small clickable badge next to the built-in context meter.

```
2 turns 30 steps · 98 tok/s │ 1.8M tok · cache 84% │ 6%
CPU 13%  MEM 87%  GPU 15%
                ↑ this plugin's badge, right of the context meter
```

- **Display-only plugin.** It registers no tools for the model. Samples never enter the conversation context and are never sent anywhere.
- Three metrics out of the box — **CPU / memory / GPU**; video memory and GPU temperature are one toggle away in settings.
- GPU works across vendors, no admin rights: `nvidia-smi`, `rocm-smi`, macOS `ioreg`, and Windows PDH counters as the catch-all. Whichever backend answers is named in the snapshot, and a backend that cannot report a field leaves it blank instead of printing `0`.
- Click the badge for a details panel: per-metric values, GPU model, core count and capacity.
- Three refresh presets: **fast 1.5 s / medium 3 s / slow 10 s** (default `3000 ms`).
- Opening ten sessions still samples once — every badge shares one snapshot and one timer.
- Sampling stops on its own 15 seconds after the last reader.
- Follows the host language (Chinese / English), including the details panel and tooltips.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-dock-vitals
```

Or drop the tarball in:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-dock-vitals-0.1.0.tgz
```

Restart DSH afterwards.

## Data sources

| Metric | Source | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CPU | Node `os.cpus()` sampled twice | Machine-wide busy percentage (`1 - Δidle/Δtotal`), not per-core. The first sample has no baseline and reads empty. |
| Memory | `os.totalmem()` / `os.freemem()` | |
| GPU | A vendor CLI, probed per platform (see below) | When nothing answers, GPU shows `—` while CPU and memory keep working. |

GPU backends, tried in this order on each platform — the first that answers wins, and the winner is remembered so later ticks skip the dead ones:

| Platform | Backend | Command | Permission | Video memory / temperature |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Windows / Linux, NVIDIA | `nvidia-smi` | `--query-gpu=... --format=csv,noheader,nounits` | none | both |
| Windows, any vendor | PDH counters via `typeperf` | `"\GPU Engine(*)\Utilization Percentage" -sc 2 -si 1` | none | **neither** |
| Linux, AMD | `rocm-smi` | `-u --showmemuse --showmeminfo vram -t --showtemp --showproductname --csv` | none | both |
| macOS, any GPU | `ioreg` (IOKit registry) | `-r -d 1 -w 0 -c IOAccelerator` | **none** | used only (no total) |

`typeperf` is the only way to read a GPU on Windows for AMD/Intel — ROCm is Linux-only — so it is worth knowing its cost: **one round takes ~2.7 s**, where `nvidia-smi` takes ~50 ms. That is why GPU sampling is decoupled from the badge refresh rate: CPU and memory keep their own cadence, and the GPU value is served from the last completed reading.

Aggregation follows Task Manager: sum each process per engine type, then take the **busiest engine type** per adapter, then the busiest adapter. Summing every instance together over-reports, and reading only the 3D engine misses video encode/decode load entirely.

A field the active backend cannot report is `null` in the snapshot, never `0` — a missing temperature and a 0 °C temperature are different things. The details panel hides those rows rather than printing a made-up number.

The host side exposes one read-only endpoint:

```
GET /dsh-dock-vitals/snapshot
```

```json
{
  "cpu": { "percent": 13.2, "cores": 24 },
  "memory": { "usedPercent": 87.3, "usedGiB": 13.7, "totalGiB": 15.7 },
  "gpu": {
    "available": true,
    "name": "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU",
    "utilPercent": 15,
    "memoryUsedMiB": 1816,
    "memoryTotalMiB": 8188,
    "temperatureC": 64,
    "clockMegahertz": 2370
  },
  "gpuError": null,
  "gpuBackend": "nvidia-smi",
  "host": { "platform": "win32", "release": "10.0.26300" },
  "intervalMs": 3000,
  "updatedAt": 0
}
```

`gpuBackend` names the backend that produced the reading, so "why is my GPU blank / missing a temperature" is answerable from the payload itself. Non-loopback callers get `403`; anything but `GET`/`HEAD` gets `405`.

## Settings

Settings → **System Status**:

| Option | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Enable badge | on | Off means the badge never renders and never fetches |
| CPU | on | |
| Memory | on | |
| GPU | on | |
| Video memory | off | Unavailable while GPU is off |
| GPU temperature | off | Same |
| Refresh interval | 3000 ms | 1500 – 60000 ms |

Every field is `volatile`, so changes apply immediately without a restart. Configuration lives in the settings namespace `dock-vitals` — the `id` of the plugin's entry in your profile.

## Compatibility

- dsh `>=0.2.0-rc.1` (developed and verified on `0.2.0-rc.2`).
- Node `>=22`.
- Windows / macOS / Linux. CPU and memory come from Node's `os`; the GPU backends are read-only CLIs and registry reads (`nvidia-smi`, `typeperf`, `rocm-smi`, `ioreg`). Nothing needs administrator rights — this deliberately avoids `powermetrics`, which is macOS's richest GPU source but requires `sudo` on every call.
- Works in both the desktop app and the browser GUI: `dsh.client.platform` is `web`, and the desktop app is a shell around the same web frontend.

## Development notes

- Client components may only `require` modules from the host whitelist (`react`, `react/jsx-runtime`, `react-dom`, `react-dom/client`, `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-dockkit`). Anything else fails to resolve, and a throwing `require` kills the factory → the entry fails → the desktop build refuses to open. **Wrap every `require` in `try/catch` and ship a fallback.**
- Never call a hook inside `apply()`. `useSyncExternalStore`'s `getSnapshot` must return a **stable reference** — an object rebuilt on every call causes an infinite re-render loop.
- Styles use `--dsw-*` theme tokens only; literal colours are reserved for graphics.
- UI is contributed through `ctx.slots.inject(ownerKey, () => ctx.slots.register(...))`.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 让Deepseek Harness变得更顺手的各种小功能和UX增强包。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ux-plus

让Deepseek Harness变得更顺手各种UX增强与功能插件。

[![CI](https://github.com/plyflai/dsh-ux-plus/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/plyflai/dsh-ux-plus/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

**当前适配：[DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.1](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/releases/tag/dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1) 的 Web 界面。**

## 功能

| 功能 | 用起来有什么好处 |
| --- | --- |
| 对话字号与宽度 | **【一键切换】** 选择舒服的字号和阅读宽度。长篇回答看得更轻松，宽屏也能充分利用，不用放大整个界面。 |
| 复制会话 ID | **【随手复制】** 在会话菜单里一键拿到会话 ID，方便指定会话继续协作、定位记录或排查问题，省去手动翻找和选中文字。 |
| 最近活动排序 | **【快速找回】** 最近聊过的工作区和会话自动排到前面。多个项目同时推进，也能方便地回到刚才的工作。 |
| 提问结果默认展开 | **【回看更省事】** 提问结束后，问题和答案直接展开。检查决定、接着讨论时，少一次点击，也少一次找答案。 |

## 安装

需要 Node.js ≥ 22、PATH 中的 pnpm，以及一个 DSH Web profile。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:plyflai/dsh-ux-plus
```

安装后重启该 profile。打开 **设置 → UX Plus**，即可按需开关各项功能。功能默认开启，单项开关即时生效。

对话字号和宽度在 **设置 → 通用 → 对话区** 调整。

## 更新记录

每次推送到 main 在此追加一条，最新在上；完整历史见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

- **v0.1.2 · 2026-10-12** — 提问展开样式收敛：浅蓝只保留问答卡片一层（去掉外层行铺底）；答案白色，原始问题字号略小、颜色略灰。
- **v0.1.1 · 2026-10-11** — 提问块改用通知蓝；修复组内会话行排序在手动排序/筛选下静默失效；修复折叠分组配额导致的行层整段失效。
- **v0.1.0 · 2026-10-09** — 首个版本：对话字号与宽度、复制会话 ID、最近活动排序、提问结果默认展开。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 plyflai

plugins.description: 把 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）里能调用的所有模型，开放成本机 OpenAI / Anthropic 兼容网关，Claude Code、Cline、ZCode 等工具可直接使用，无需再填 API Key。Expose every model DSH can already call through one loopback OpenAI/Anthropic gateway, so other local dev tools can use them.
plugins.readme_text:
# Model Bridge — 把 DSH 的模型给你的其他开发工具用

> English: [README.en.md](README.en.md)

把 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）里已经能调用的所有模型**，通过一个本机网关开放给任何支持
OpenAI 或 Anthropic 接口的软件使用 —— Claude Code、Cline、Roo Code、Continue、
Cherry Studio、ChatBox、ZCode，或你自己的脚本。

**不需要再填一次 API Key。** 网关直接调用 DSH 进程内的 `ctx.llm.stream()`，凭据由
DSH 里已有的适配器自己解析。插件从不读取、也不存储任何上游凭据。

```
┌─────────────┐   OpenAI / Anthropic    ┌──────────────────┐   ctx.llm.stream()   ┌────────────┐
│ 你的开发工具 │ ──────────────────────▶ │  dsh-model-bridge │ ──────────────────▶ │ DSH 的适配器 │
│ (ZCode 等)  │ ◀────────────────────── │  127.0.0.1:8791  │ ◀────────────────── │ (凭据在此)  │
└─────────────┘        SSE 流           └──────────────────┘      进程内调用      └────────────┘
```

---

## 一、你要填的三样东西

| 项目 | 值 |
|---|---|
| **OpenAI 兼容 Base URL** | `http://127.0.0.1:8791/v1` |
| **Anthropic Base URL** | `http://127.0.0.1:8791` |
| **API Key** | 见 `~/.dsh/model-bridge/key`（DSH 设置页里可直接复制） |

模型名填**限定名**，例如 `workbuddy/deepseek-v4.1-flash`。
完整清单见 `http://127.0.0.1:8791/v1/models`，或在 DSH 设置页里看。

---

## 二、安装

插件是标准的 DSH bundle。把它放进 profile 的依赖与 bundles 列表，然后**重启 DSH**：

```jsonc
// ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-model-bridge": "file:F:/KF/dsh api/dsh-model-bridge"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
        // …
        "dsh-model-bridge"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

挂载由插件自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 完成，只有一行 —— 这一行就是全部的宿主接线：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: model-bridge
      name: 'dsh-model-bridge'
```

装好后跑一次体检，确认 profile 能组装出这个 bundle：

```powershell
node "F:\KF\dsh api\dsh-model-bridge\tools\verify-mount.mjs"
```

> **安装新 bundle 需要重启 DSH。** 重启后 8791 才会开始监听。

---

## 三、在 DSH 里开关与选择模型

**设置 → 插件 → Model Bridge**：

- **启用本地网关** —— 开关。关掉后 8791 立刻停止服务；选择会被记住，下次启动按记忆执行。
- **接入信息** —— 上面三项，每项都有复制按钮；Key 默认打码，点「显示」可看全。
- **暴露的模型** —— 按 provider 分组，逐项勾选，带搜索框。
  取消勾选的模型**不会**出现在 `/v1/models`，**也无法**被调用（不是只藏起来）。
  「全选 / 全不选」用来批量操作。
- **复制模型名** —— 每行右侧有复制按钮（悬停出现），工具栏有「复制全部」一次复制所有已勾选项。

这个网关随 DSH 启动而启动、随 DSH 关闭而关闭。设置页的开关是额外的运行时控制，
不需要重启 DSH。

---

## 四、常见工具的填法

### Claude Code 等 Anthropic 原生工具

```powershell
$env:ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8791"
$env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY  = "<你的 key>"
```

模型名填 `workbuddy/deepseek-v4.1-flash`。

### OpenAI 兼容的客户端（Cline、Roo Code、Continue、Cherry Studio、ChatBox 等）

- Provider：**OpenAI Compatible**（或「自定义 OpenAI」）
- Base URL：`http://127.0.0.1:8791/v1`
- API Key：`<你的 key>`
- Model：`workbuddy/deepseek-v4.1-flash`

### Python

```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8791/v1",
    api_key="<你的 key>",
)
reply = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="workbuddy/deepseek-v4.1-flash",
    messages=[
        {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."},
        {"role": "user",   "content": "你好"},
    ],
)
print(reply.choices[0].message.content)
```

### Node.js

```js
import OpenAI from "openai";

const client = new OpenAI({
  baseURL: "http://127.0.0.1:8791/v1",
  apiKey: "<你的 key>",
});
const reply = await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: "workbuddy/deepseek-v4.1-flash",
  messages: [
    { role: "system", content: "You are a helpful assistant." },
    { role: "user", content: "你好" },
  ],
});
console.log(reply.choices[0].message.content);
```

### curl

```powershell
curl.exe -H "Authorization: Bearer <你的 key>" http://127.0.0.1:8791/v1/models
```

---

## 五、接口

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/healthz` | 存活探针。**唯一不需要鉴权的路由**，因为它只回答「进程在不在听」 |
| `GET` | `/v1/models` | 模型清单（OpenAI 格式）。`?refresh=1` 强制重新枚举 |
| `POST` | `/v1/chat/completions` | OpenAI 对话补全，支持 `stream: true` 与 `tools` |
| `POST` | `/v1/messages` | Anthropic Messages，支持 `stream: true` 与 `tools` |
| `GET` | `/v1/bridge/info` | 网关自身信息（两个 Base URL、provider 列表） |

鉴权用 `Authorization: Bearer <key>` **或** `x-api-key: <key>`（后者是 Anthropic 原生客户端
的习惯）。两者都是常量时间比较。

**裸名有歧义时会明确报错**，不会瞎猜。比如 `deepseek-v4.1-flash` 同时被多个 provider 提供，
就必须写成 `workbuddy/deepseek-v4.1-flash`，报错信息里会列出所有候选。

---

## 六、必须知道的四点

1. **只在 DSH 运行时可用。** 它是 DSH 进程内的插件，不是独立常驻服务 —— DSH 一关，
   8791 就没了。需要 7×24 常驻是另一件事。

2. **Key 是本机文件，本机任何程序都能读。** 这是设计使然：外部工具要能认证，密钥就
   必须能被它们读到。网关只绑 `127.0.0.1`，并逐请求校验 `Host` / `Origin` 以防 DNS
   重绑定，所以**局域网和公网访问不到**。

3. **WorkBuddy 池要求第一条消息必须是 `system`。** 这是上游的安全策略，网关只是如实
   转发：

   ```jsonc
   // ❌ 会被上游拒绝：502 "first message is not system prompt"
   {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "你好"}]}

   // ✅ 正确
   {"messages": [
     {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."},
     {"role": "user",   "content": "你好"}
   ]}
   ```

   多数客户端本来就会自动带 system 提示，通常无需理会。

4. **这些模型会消耗推理 token，`max_tokens` 别设太小**（建议 ≥512），否则推理占满配额、
   正文会是空的。

---

## 七、设计要点

- **零凭据**：插件不注册 adapter、不声明 configurable provider，因此永远不会与既有
  provider 路由冲突。它只**消费** `ctx.llm`。
- **进程内调用**：走 `ctx.llm.stream()` 而非 HTTP，所以完全绕开凭据搬运问题。
- **两个协议、一套内核**：chunk 遍历、错误处理、收尾逻辑只写一次，两种协议各自提供
  渲染器。
- **工具调用是完整的**：`tool-call` 的 `block-start` 不带 id/name（真实适配器的行为），
  所以 `content_block_start` 被推迟到 id/name 已知才发；若某个工具调用只有 `block-end`
  没有增量，也会从 `block-end` 补齐，保证客户端一定拿得到可执行的调用。

---

## 八、测试

```powershell
cd "F:\KF\dsh api\dsh-model-bridge"

node test\test.mjs           # 35 项：密钥、鉴权、回环策略、协议转换、路由、组装
node test\test-toolcalls.mjs #  6 项：工具调用流式契约（含零参数调用）
node test\test-settings.mjs  # 41 项：设置页与开关
node test\test-client.mjs    # 61 项：客户端 bundle

node tools\verify-mount.mjs     # 挂载体检：profile 能否组装出这个 bundle
node tools\verify-fix-proves.mjs # 对照实验：证明回归测试真的能抓住那个 bug
node tools\smoke-mount.mjs      # 端到端：8799 端口起一个假宿主，两种协议各打一遍
node tools\check-live.mjs       # 线上检查：重启 DSH 后网关是否真活着
```

`verify-fix-proves.mjs` 是刻意的**对照实验**：它复现修复前的输出，断言测试必须拒绝它。
一个修复前后都通过的测试什么也证明不了。

---

## 九、出问题时

| 现象 | 原因与处理 |
|---|---|
| 连不上 8791 | DSH 没运行、插件没挂载、或设置页里被关了 |
| 401 | Key 不对。读 `~/.dsh/model-bridge/key` 重新复制 |
| 403 `host_not_allowed` | 用了 `127.0.0.1` 之外的地址，或经过了代理 |
| 400 说模型有歧义 | 按提示写成 `provider/model` 形式 |
| 503 `no_adapter` | 该 provider 在当前 DSH 里没有活动适配器 |
| 模型列表里没有某个模型 | 设置页里没勾选它 |
| 502 `no API key for provider route` | 该 provider（如 `deepseek-official`）需要在 DSH 模型设置页登录 |

---

## 十、许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: Connects DSH to the Unity MCP server
plugins.readme_text:
# @comecaramelos/dsh-unity-mcp

Connects DSH to the **Unity MCP** server — the `unity-ai-relay` executable the
Unity AI Assistant package (`com.unity.ai.assistant`) installs — through the
stock `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` stdio bridge, plus a settings/status card in
the Web GUI.

Every tool the relay registers is exposed as a normal `mcp__unity__*` tool.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @comecaramelos/dsh-unity-mcp
```

The plugin **does not download anything**: it launches the `unity-ai-relay`
executable your Unity Editor installed. Install the
[Unity AI Assistant](https://docs.unity3d.com/Packages/com.unity.ai.assistant@2.0/manual/unity-mcp-get-started.html)
package first, and keep a Unity Editor running — the relay is the Editor's
side-channel, so an Editor that is not running answers
`No Unity Editor connected`.

## Configuration

Settings live under **Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration → DSH Unity MCP**.

- **Unity relay executable** — the executable the bridge launches. Open the
  picker, hit **Fetch executables** to search this machine (the search also walks
  every Windows user profile visible from a WSL host), and pick one. The pick is
  remembered; applying a different one restarts the connection.
- **Extra flags** — one flag per row, appended after the `--mcp` mode flag the
  bridge always passes, for example `--project-path=/home/roberto/game`,
  `--name=MyProject`, `--log-level=debug`.
- **Reduce log output** — keeps the relay's own progress lines out of the DSH
  console by redirecting its stderr into a log file (turn it off to debug the
  raw output).

Nothing is picked for you: what the saved rows list is what you can pick, and a
path you picked stays picked — if it later stops running it reads broken, it is
never silently re-resolved.

### Windows relay from WSL

A Windows relay launched through the WSL interop mount works like a native one:
it speaks MCP over stdio, so nothing about the connection changes. The card says
so when that is what is running, and reminds you to keep the relay's arguments
(`--log-dir`, and `--project-path` when you pin a project) in their Windows
spelling — the relay resolves them on the Windows side.

## Row configuration

For a per-profile pin, edit the plugin row's `config`:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `serverName` | `unity` | the bridge's server namespace (tool names are `mcp__<serverName>__<tool>`) |
| `relayPath` | `""` | the executable to launch when the card has never picked one |
| `relayPaths` | the platform's relay locations | the candidate list the **Search executables** run probes |
| `extraFlags` | `[]` | flags appended after the `--mcp` mode flag |
| `command` | `""` | a launcher prefix to wrap the spawn with (the relay needs no wrapper) |
| `env` / `cwd` | `{}` / `""` | passed through to the bridge |
| `toolCallTimeoutMs` | `60000` | per-tool-call timeout |
| `failOnStartupError` | `false` | fail the load when the bridge cannot start |
| `reconnect` | `{ enabled: true, initialDelayMs: 500, maxDelayMs: 30000, maxAttempts: 10 }` | reconnect policy |
| `bridgeStderr` | `"log"` | console-output routing: `"log"` captures stderr into a log file, `"console"` echoes it |
| `bridgeStderrLog` | `""` | log path override for `"log"` mode (absolute paths only) |

The environment variable `DSH_UNITY_MCP_FLAGS` (whitespace-separated) seeds the
launch flags for one run.

## Manual installation

Replace `/path/to/dsh-unity-mcp` with your local checkout:

```sh
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@comecaramelos
ln -s /path/to/dsh-unity-mcp ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@comecaramelos/dsh-unity-mcp
```

Add the dependency and bundle to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`, preserving
existing entries:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@comecaramelos/dsh-unity-mcp": "link:/path/to/dsh-unity-mcp"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
        "@comecaramelos/dsh-unity-mcp"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

---

[Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [License](LICENSE.md)

plugins.description: Always-on ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English output for DSH. Commands: /ste on, /ste off, /ste.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ASD-100

Forces ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English on every reply and every document.

## What it does

When the mode is on, the plugin adds an always-on section to the system prompt of
every request. The section holds the writing rules of simplified technical English:
20 words in a procedure sentence, 25 in a descriptive sentence, one instruction per
sentence, active voice, simple tenses, the condition before the command, one word
with one meaning, no semicolons, no em dashes, no contractions. A reply answers
first and uses prose only.

## Commands

- `/asd100 on` turns the mode on.
- `/asd100 off` turns the mode off.
- `/asd100` reports the current state.

`/asd-100` is accepted as an alias.

## State

The mode is one flag file: `~/.dsh/dsh-asd-100/.active`. The plugin reads it on every
request, so all sessions share the state and a change takes effect at once. To turn
the mode off from outside the chat, delete the file.

## Where the rules come from

The rules ship with the plugin in `skills/simple-english/`, so a fresh install follows
the full rule set and the four reference files it points to. When
`~/.agents/skills/simple-english/SKILL.md` exists, that copy wins, and you can edit
your own rules there. When neither copy exists, the plugin uses a built-in rule set
of nine lines. All three paths are in `lib/index.js`.

## Config

Two optional fields, set in the bundle patch that loads the plugin:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-asd-100
      name: dsh-asd-100
      config:
        skillDir: /path/to/simple-english   # default: ~/.agents/skills/simple-english, then the packaged copy
        stateFile: /path/to/.active         # default: ~/.dsh/dsh-asd-100/.active
```

## Development

```sh
node --test test/ste.test.mjs
```

The plugin imports node builtins only. It has no dependencies.

## Files

- `lib/index.js` — the plugin: the prompt section, the command handler, the flag file.
- `cordis.patch.yml` — the bundle patch that loads it.
- `skills/simple-english/` — the rule text and its references, spliced from the
  `simple-english` agent skill (MIT), version 2.1.1, standard ASD-STE100 Issue 9.
- `test/ste.test.mjs` — seven tests.
- `awesome-dsh-plugin-entry.yml` — the list entry for the awesome-dsh-plugin PR.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: PPAP 提交资料核对：依据《生产件批准程序（PPAP）手册》。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ppap-check — PPAP submission element completeness check

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-ppap-check` reads one PPAP submission element checklist — the part header plus one row per element — and checks what a checklist can be held to mechanically: that an element the customer required carries a submission record, that a submitted element carries a date, that a controlled element (design record, FMEA, control plan, process flow, dimensional results, MSA) carries a revision, that the sheet names its part number and submission level, that element numbers are unique, and that no template placeholder survives in the element column.

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-ppap-check: real output over its PP-001 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-ppap-check/main/docs/assets/dsh-ppap-check-demo.png)

Real output from this plugin over its own `PP-001` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| An element is marked as required in the 是否要求 column, but there is no submission record for it — is that reported? | Yes. `PP-001` reports the row when the `required` column holds a value that counts as required (`是`, `Y`, `yes`, `true`, `要求`, `√`) while the `submitted` column is empty. It reads that column of your own checklist, never a built-in element list — which elements are required depends on the level the customer specifies — and it does not judge whether the content of what was submitted is acceptable. |
| The row is marked as submitted, but the date cell is empty. And if the date is filled in but falls after the customer's deadline? | `PP-002` reports a row whose `submitted` column holds a value that counts as submitted (`是`, `Y`, `yes`, `true`, `已提交`, `√`) while the `submittedAt` cell is blank. It only checks that the date cell is filled in — whether the date falls inside the deadline set by the customer's project plan is not checked. |
| The control plan row is filled in but its version cell is empty — will that be reported, and what about elements that carry no revision by nature? | `PP-003` looks at element names matching `conditionPattern` — design record, engineering change, DFMEA/PFMEA, control plan, process flow, dimensional results, measurement-system analysis, samples, checking aids, PSW, material reports, preliminary process capability — and reports each matching row whose `version` cell is empty. It only checks that the version is filled in, not that it is the correct or the current revision; narrow the pattern if an element genuinely carries no revision. |
| Every element row looks complete, but the tool says the sheet is missing the part number and the level. Our form records the level on each row instead. | `PP-004` reads the header only: `partNo` and `level` must both be present at the top of the material. If your form keeps the level on the detail rows, change this rule's `fields` or write a check of your own — the rule does not look for those values inside the rows. |
| The level cell reads `Level 3`, but `PP-005` never says anything about it. | `PP-005` ships with an empty `values` list, and empty means unconfigured, so it reports itself in `skipped` instead of passing quietly. Put your customer's level spellings into `values` and it will report any value that is not on the list. Even then it only checks that the value is on your list — whether the level chosen is the right one is the customer's decision — which is why the rule is capped at `info`. |
| Our checklist was copied from last year's template: one element name still reads 【待填】 and two rows carry the same element number. | `PP-006` reports an element name that still contains a placeholder — `【`, `】`, `{{`, `}}`, `XXX`, `xxx`, `待填`, `待补充`, `TBD`, `todo`, a `terms` list you can adjust to your own template. `PP-007` reports a repeated element number in `elementNo`, comparing with whitespace ignored; a hit usually means the element was registered twice or the number was copied wrong, and which of the two it is has to be confirmed by a person. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《生产件批准程序（PPAP）手册》 | AIAG PPAP（现行版次与条号本次未核实） | PP-001, PP-002, PP-003, PP-004, PP-005, PP-006, PP-007 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks a **PPAP 提交要素清单** for what a checklist can be held to mechanically —
that an element the customer required carries a submission record, that a submitted element carries a date,
that a controlled element (design record, FMEA, control plan, process flow, dimensional results, MSA) carries
a revision, that the sheet names its part number and submission level, that element numbers are unique, and
that no template placeholder survives. It does **not** decide whether PPAP may be approved, whether the level
is right, or whether an element's content satisfies the customer. **The submission level is the customer's to
set, and this plugin ships no level-to-element mapping.**

> ### ⚠️ Read this before trusting a citation in the report
>
> **Every `excerpt` in this plugin's rule pack says, in so many words, that the clause text was not
> obtained.** The method lives in the automotive **AIAG《生产件批准程序（PPAP）手册》** (and the customer
> specific requirements under IATF 16949). The verification pass could not retrieve verbatim clause text, so
> rather than paraphrase a quotation the pack states the gap in the `excerpt` field itself and puts the
> honest reasoning in `note`. Every rule is therefore `warn` or `info`, and a test asserts that no rule
> claims a quotation it does not have. **When the text is in hand, two things must be done: replace each
> `excerpt` with the real clause, and raise `kind` to `direct`.**
>
> **Which elements must be submitted depends on the level the customer specifies** (Level 1–5), so `PP-001`
> reads the **checklist's own 是否要求 column** rather than any built-in list, and `PP-005`'s level vocabulary
> ships **empty** — with no vocabulary configured it reports itself in `skipped` instead of passing quietly.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.1`. `engines.dsh` is deliberately not declared: it has no reader and cannot reject a host |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native`, `ptc` and `both`; for several parts use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `ppap_check` tool. It reads one submission-element checklist — the part header plus one row per
element — applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PP-001` | a required element has a submission record | warn | principle |
| `PP-002` | a submitted element carries a date | warn | principle |
| `PP-003` | a controlled element carries a revision | warn | principle |
| `PP-004` | the sheet names its part number and level | warn | principle |
| `PP-005` | the level comes from your customer's vocabulary (off by default) | info | local |
| `PP-006` | the element column holds no unreplaced placeholder | warn | principle |
| `PP-007` | element numbers are unique | warn | principle |

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-ppap-check
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-ppap-check'
```

## Configuration

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rulesFile` | string | `rules/ppap-check.yaml` | Rule-pack path, relative to the package root |
| `disabledRules` | string[] | `[]` | Rule ids to stop running; each appears in `skipped` |
| `onlyRules` | string[] | `[]` | Run only these rule ids; empty runs every rule |
| `skipNotes` | string | `""` | Note appended to every `skipped` reason |
| `timeoutMs` | number | `120000` | Cooperative tool timeout budget |

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lawcite-adapter — Statute citation and legal document element check

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-lawcite-adapter` reads one statute-citation inventory — the document header plus one row per citation — and checks that inventory's own verifiability and document elements: that each citation states its law and article number, that the article number follows the Chinese form, that a direct quotation has been transcribed into the quotation column, that the power status comes from your own vocabulary, that the citation states where it is used and what it argues, that the document header names its title and type, that citation numbers are not repeated, and that no unreplaced placeholder survives in the quotation column. It does not verify that a statute exists, that it is currently in force, that it has not been amended or repealed, or that it applies to the case.

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-lawcite-adapter: real output over its LC-001 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-lawcite-adapter/main/docs/assets/dsh-lawcite-adapter-demo.png)

Real output from this plugin over its own `LC-001` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| A citation row carries an article number but the law name is blank. Is that reported? | Yes. `LC-001` requires the law name and the article number (`lawName`, `articleNo`) on every row and reports the row that leaves either one blank. It checks that they are written, not that the statute or the article exists: it holds no statute database and does not query one. |
| The article number is written `第 577 条`, or `第12条第3款`. Will it pass? | `LC-002` matches `articleNo` against `^第[〇零一二三四五六七八九十百千0-9]+条(之[一二三四五六七八九十]+)?$`, so the spaced form `第 577 条` and the mixed form `第12条第3款` are both reported. It checks the form of the number only, nothing about whether the article exists; a paragraph or item number belongs in its own column, so `第12条` goes in `articleNo`. The `pattern` is adjustable to your house style. |
| One row's quotation column is empty and another still reads `【待补充】`. Are both caught? | Yes, by two rules. `LC-003` requires `quotedText` to be transcribed on every row; `LC-008` reports the row whose `quotedText` still contains a template term (`【`, `】`, `{{`, `}}`, `XXX`, `xxx`, `待填`, `待补充`, `TBD`, `todo`, `示例`). Neither compares the text with the statute: `LC-003` checks that a quotation is present, `LC-008` only that no placeholder survives. 「略」 is deliberately absent from the terms, so `……（略）` is a normal abridgement and passes. |
| The report shows `LC-004` as `skipped` instead of passing. Why? | Because `LC-004`'s `values` list ships empty, meaning the power-status vocabulary is not configured, so the rule reports itself in `skipped` rather than passing silently. Fill `values` with your own vocabulary (for example `现行有效`, `已修订`, `已废止`) and `LC-004` then checks that `effectiveStatus` is on that list. It checks membership in your list, not whether the recorded status matches the facts. |
| The rows name the law and quote it, but say nothing about where the citation is used or what it argues, and the header gives no document type. Is that reported? | Yes. `LC-005` requires `usage` and `purpose` on every citation row and reports a row that leaves both blank; it does not judge whether the citation really supports that argument. `LC-006` requires the header to declare `documentTitle` and `documentType`, and does not judge whether the type was chosen correctly. |
| The same article is cited in two sections and both rows carry citation number 3. Is that a finding? | Yes. `LC-007` reports a `citationNo` that repeats inside the inventory, because a repeated number stops the footnotes from locating each citation. Citing the same provision in several sections is normal: give each citation its own number. The rule does not judge whether citing the same provision twice is appropriate. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 本机构法律文书审查口径（本机构配置）—— 原挂《中华人民共和国立法法》，已核实其第六十五条为立法技术条款 | 无统一标准（本条依据为本机构配置的引用管理口径）—— ⚠️ 《立法法》2023 年第二次修正文本已核实，本条不引用该法 | LC-001 |
| 本机构法律文书审查口径（本机构配置）—— 原挂《党政机关公文格式》GB/T 9704—2012，已核实为版式标准 | GB/T 9704—2012（本次未取得条文） | LC-002, LC-003, LC-005, LC-006, LC-007, LC-008 |
| 本机构法律文书审查办法（本机构配置） | 无统一标准（本条依据为本机构配置的效力口径） | LC-004 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks a **法条引用清单** for verifiability and document elements — that each citation
names its law and article, that the article number follows the Chinese form, that a direct quotation is
transcribed, that the power status comes from your vocabulary, that the citation states where it is used and what
it argues, that the document names its title and type, that citation numbers are unique, and that no placeholder
survives. It does **not** verify that a statute exists, that it is currently in force, that it has not been amended
or repealed, or that it applies to the case.

> ### ⚠️ This plugin does not query a statute database — and that is the point
>
> **It cannot find the most consequential error: a citation to a statute or article that does not exist, or that
> has been repealed.** Confirming that requires the national laws-and-regulations database and the facts of the
> case, which is a legal professional's work. What this plugin checks is whether a citation left behind the
> elements needed to verify it — the law, the article, the quoted text, the power status, the purpose.
>
> That boundary is stated in the pack's header, in `LC-001`'s, `LC-003`'s and `LC-004`'s notes, and in the
> troubleshooting section. Read it before acting on any finding: **a clean report from this plugin is not a
> statement that the citations are correct.**
>
> `LC-002` checks the article number's *form* — `第X条` in Chinese or Arabic numerals, allowing `第X条之一` —
> and nothing about whether the article exists. `LC-003` checks that a quotation is transcribed, not that the
> transcription matches the statute. `LC-004`'s power-status vocabulary ships **empty** because no statute's
> current status is built in either.
>
> **Every `excerpt` in the rule pack says, in so many words, that the clause text was not obtained.** The regime
> lives in 《中华人民共和国立法法》, GB/T 9704—2012 and each institution's legal-document review rules. The
> verification pass could not retrieve verbatim clause text, so the pack states the gap in the `excerpt` field
> itself and keeps every rule at `warn` or `info`. **When the texts are in hand, replace each `excerpt` with the
> real clause and raise `kind` to `direct`.**
>
> ⚠️ **One basis was corrected rather than completed.** GB/T 9704—2012《党政机关公文格式》 was verified chapter by
> chapter to be a **layout** standard — paper, typesetting, binding, the placement of document elements and the
> specimen forms. **It contains no provision about citation management at all.** Six rules had been hung on it
> anyway ("every citation must name the instrument and the article", "a direct quotation must be transcribed",
> and so on). Those six now declare **the institution's own legal-document review practice** as their basis, are
> rated **`institutional-configuration`**, and therefore sit at **`info`** rather than `warn`. Leaving them at
> `warn` while their own note says "read this as the institution's practice" would have contradicted itself.
>
> **`LC-001` was then corrected the same way.** It cited 《中华人民共和国立法法》. That statute was obtained in
> full and does contain a numbering provision — 第六十五条: 「法律根据内容需要，可以分编、章、节、条、款、项、目」，with
> numbering rules and an authorisation for the NPC Standing Committee's working body to draft legislative
> technique rules. But that governs **how a law is itself drafted and numbered**; it says nothing about how an
> official document cites an existing law. So `LC-001` joins the other seven: **all eight rules in this pack now
> declare the institution's own review practice as their

plugins.description: Reliably push a local folder to GitHub: per-command proxy injection, self-healing gh auth, pre-push secret gate, and SHA read-back verification. Zero dependencies.
plugins.readme_text:
# outbox

> 把本地目录可靠地送上 GitHub。一句话，不翻车。

[English abstract](#english-abstract) · MIT

`outbox` 把「推送」从一个每次都要现场拼命令的临时动作，变成一条**确定性的流水线**：

```
代理自动探测 → gh 登录态自愈 → 推送前安全闸门 → 建仓 / 提交 / 推送 → 远端 SHA 回读校验
```

**一份内核，三种用法**：命令行、任何 Agent（读 `SKILL.md`）、DeepSeek Harness 插件（`dsh-github-push`）。
三种外壳共用同一份代码，不存在「插件和 CLI 行为不一致」的问题。

---

## 它到底解决了什么

推送失败几乎从来不是因为 `git push` 写错了，而是因为**周围那些没人管的事**。下面是真实踩过的坑，以及 outbox 的处理方式：

| 真实故障 | 为什么会发生 | outbox 怎么处理 |
|---|---|---|
| `gh` 突然报「未登录」，可 `git push` 明明好好的 | gh 把登录态存在自己的 `hosts.yml` 里，该文件会因版本升级/配置迁移被清空；但 token 一直躺在系统凭据管理器里 | 检测到未登录时，从凭据管理器取出 token 自动灌回 gh，并**重新校验** |
| 网络时通时不通、推送卡死 | 环境变量里的代理并不是每条调用链都带着；代理关掉后变量还指着死端口 | 每次先探测端口，通则**按次注入**代理、不通则只清掉指向该端口的陈旧变量后直连 |
| 推着推着要输密码，挂在半路 | git 交互式询问 | 子进程一律置 `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0`，宁可清清楚楚失败，也不静默挂起 |
| 密钥被推上公开仓库 | 没人会在推送前逐行看 diff | 推送前扫描**即将提交的索引**，命中高危内容直接阻断 |
| 命令返回 0，但推的是旧东西 | 退出码不等于结果 | 推送后回读远端分支，**要求远端 SHA 严格等于本地 HEAD** 才算成功 |
| 仓库里写死了本机用户目录的绝对路径 | 无意识泄露身份 | 扫描绝对路径中的用户名、身份证号、手机号等，命中后**禁止自动公开** |

---

## 安装

零依赖，只要 Node ≥ 18。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/<your-account>/outbox.git
cd outbox
node src/cli.mjs --help
```

## 用法

```bash
# 先看一眼会发生什么（只做预检，不提交不推送）
node src/cli.mjs --dir ./my-project --visibility private --dry-run

# 发布到私有仓库（仓库不存在会自动创建）
node src/cli.mjs --dir ./my-project --visibility private --description "我的项目"

# 明确要开源时才用 public
node src/cli.mjs --dir ./my-project --visibility public
```

常用选项：

| 选项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `--dir <路径>` | 要发布的目录（默认当前目录） |
| `--name <仓库名>` | 远端仓库名（默认由目录名规整而来） |
| `--visibility <值>` | `public` / `private` / `ask`（默认 `ask`） |
| `--proxy <值>` | `auto` / `off` / `http://host:port`（默认 `auto`，探测 7890） |
| `--proxy-port <端口>` | 代理探测端口，默认 `7890` |
| `--dry-run` | 只做预检 |
| `--json` | 结构化输出，便于脚本与 Agent 消费 |

退出码：`0` 成功 · `1` 出错 · `2` 预检阻断 · `3` 需要你先做决定

## 安全闸门

扫描的对象是**索引**（`git ls-files --cached`），也就是真正会被推上去的东西——因此 `.gitignore` 覆盖的文件天然不会被误报。

命中结果分三级：

| 级别 | 含义 | 行为 |
|---|---|---|
| `block` | 高置信度凭据：GitHub/OpenAI/AWS 令牌、私钥文件内容、`.env`/`*.pem`/`id_rsa` 等文件名、超过 95 MiB 的文件 | **硬阻断**，远端不会被创建 |
| `confirm` | 疑似个人敏感信息：身份证号、手机号、学号字段、暴露本机用户名的绝对路径，以及你自己的自定义模式 | **禁止自动公开**，必须逐条确认 |
| `warn` | 疑似明文口令/密钥赋值、超过 10 MiB 的大文件、**已被 gitignore 覆盖却仍在版本控制中的残留** | 只提示，不阻断 |

补充自定义模式：在 `~/.outbox/patterns.json` 写

```json
{ "confirm": [{ "id": "my-secret", "label": "我自己的敏感词", "pattern": "公司内部代号" }] }
```

### 放行清单

任何**带测试夹具的仓库**都会天然含有假密钥——测试扫描器就得放几个假 token 进去。没有出口的话，这种仓库会被自己的闸门拦住（outbox 第一次推送时，确实拦住了它自己）。

两种放行方式：

**仓库级**：在仓库根目录写 `.outboxallow`，每行一条：

```
# <路径 glob> [规则 id]
tests/selftest.mjs    github-token
tests/**/*.fixture.js
```

省略规则 id 表示放行该路径下的全部规则，但**建议永远写明确则 id**——放行范围越小越容易审计。这个文件本身会随仓库一起提交，所以「谁放行了什么」永远可查。

**行内**：在同一行写上 `outbox:allow`，该行的内容规则全部跳过。

被放行的命中不会凭空消失，而是记入结果的 `allowlisted` 字段，依旧可见。

## 设计取舍

**为什么代理不写进 git 全局配置？**
写全局最省事，但一旦代理软件关掉，本机**所有** git 操作（包括别的仓库）都会连不上。outbox 只在本次命令上用 `-c http.proxy=...` 注入，不留后遗症。

**为什么不用 `where.exe` 定位 git/gh？**
Windows 控制台工具按 OEM 代码页输出，而 Node 按 UTF-8 解码。只要可执行文件路径含中文（例如用户名是中文），解析结果就会变成一串替换字符，随后 `spawn` 报 `ENOENT`。更阴险的是 Git 常装在纯 ASCII 路径下所以一切正常——这个 bug 只在中文用户名的机器上爆发。正确做法是**把裸名字交给 Windows 自己按 PATH 解析**。

**为什么推送成功的判据是 SHA 而不是退出码？**
`git push` 返回 0 只代表命令没报错，不代表远端真的有你要的那个提交。回读 `git ls-remote` 拿到远端分支 SHA、与本地 `HEAD` 严格比对，才是可信证据。

**为什么安全闸门扫描索引而不是目录？**
索引就是「将要被推送的内容」，天然排除了忽略项，不会对 `.gitignore` 里的东西误报。

## 作为 Agent Skill 使用

`SKILL.md` 是给任意 Agent（Claude Code / Codex / DSH / 其它）读的说明书。把它放进你的技能目录，或直接贴进系统提示，Agent 就知道什么时候该调 `outbox`、什么时候必须先问用户。

## 相关项目

- **[`dsh-plugin/`](dsh-plugin/)** —— 同一份内核的 DSH 工具壳，注册模型工具 `github_push`，让「一句话推送」真正落地。源码就在本仓库里；它同时单独发布为一个 `dsh-github-push` 仓库，以便被 DSH 插件市场收录。两处的内核副本由 `scripts/sync-plugin.mjs` 机械同步，不存在第二份手写实现。
- [`dsh-plugin-publish`](https://github.com/suyukun/dsh-plugin-publish) —— 面向 Agent 技能的**发布流程协议**（preflight → 建仓 → awesome 列表 PR → 市场提交）。它是「说明书」，outbox 是「代码内核」，两者互补。

## English abstract

`outbox` reliably pushes a local folder to GitHub in a single command. It wraps the parts that actually break: auto-detecting a local proxy (default port 7890) and injecting it **per command** instead of globally, self-healing a `gh` login by recovering the token from the OS credential store, gating the push behind a secret/PII scan of the staged index, and verifying success by reading back the remote branch SHA instead of trusting an exit code. Zero dependencies, Node ≥ 18. One core, three shells: CLI, agent skill, and a DeepSeek Harness plugin.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Live status badge + non-interrupting in-flight guidance for DeepSeek Harness · DSH 会话头实时状态徽标 + 运行中指导（不打断，支持图片附件与插话历史）
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-steer 中文 | [English](#english) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE) 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件：在会话头放一个实时状态徽标，并允许你在 Agent 干活的中途补一句、纠一句，而不用打断它。 Agent 跑长任务时有两个具体的麻烦。第一，你不知道它此刻在做什么——「等待响应」和「真的卡住」看起来一模一样。第二，你发现方向不对时，只能等它做完，或者直接打断，没有中间选项。这个插件分别解决这两件事。 ![会话头实时状态徽标 + 运行中指导浮层（真机截图）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyonleeeee/dsh-steer/HEAD/assets/screenshot-1-runtime-and-guidance.png) ## 快速开始 ```bash dsh plugin --profile add github:lyonleeeee/dsh-steer ``` 装完重启应用（`bundles` 只在启动时读一次）。之后会话头右上角会出现状态徽标和「指导」按钮。 桌面版（DeepSeek Harness.app）独占管理自己的 profile，需要用应用自带的 CLI： ```bash "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \ plugin --profile desktop add github:lyonleeeee/dsh-steer ``` ## 状态徽标 徽标只显示当前阶段，按发生的顺序推进：分析中 → 思考中 · 本步 N 字 → 输出中 · 本步 N 字 → 运行 <工具> → 读取工具结果，收尾回到「工作中」。工具阶段后面跟一句命令摘要，例如「运行 bash · Run route probes」。 有两处刻意的取舍。字数是按步统计的——每个 turn/step 边界重新计数，而不是整段会话的累计值，后者最终只会变成一个越来越大的无意义数字。徽标也不显示模型名，模型、provider、上下文窗口和步号（`T4·S3`）都放在点开的详情面板里，徽标本身保持安静。 耗时秒数由客户端本地时钟计算，host 只发时间戳，所以空闲时没有定时器，也不会每秒推一次 SSE。 状态不猜。没有新进展时显示「暂无新增量」，实时源断开时显示「状态实时源断开」，而不是继续挂着上一次的阶段。请求失败只显示官方返回的 `failure.code`；只有 `llm/retry` 真的触发才显示重试，不写「可能是网络问题」这种无法证明的话。 ![点开徽标：运行状态诊断面板（阶段、步号 T4·S1、语言切换）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyonleeeee/dsh-steer/HEAD/assets/screenshot-3-runtime-detail.png) ## 运行中指导 这是插件的主要能力。你写一句话，它会在当前回合内、最近一次小步（一次推理或一次工具调用）结束的边界被读进上下文，任务继续往下跑——不打断、不重开、不等整轮结束。 实现上用自定义消息 kind（`source.kind` 为 `dsh-steer`）加 `agent.steer()`。这一点是关键：如果按普通用户消息投递，模型会把它当成一条新任务，表现就是打断当前工作。 指导框支持直接贴图或选文件，附件经宿主的 `attachments` 服务落成持久引用。输入框按会话保存草稿，刷新不丢。 浮层里会列出本次会话发出的插话，每条标出它的归宿： - ✓ 已读取，并标出在第几轮第几步被读到，例如 `T7·S3` - · 已送达，还没被读 - ✗ 未读取，回合已结束或消息被丢弃 点任意一条可以把原文回填到输入框；未读取的可以一键重发，重发会带上原来的附件，不需要重新上传。历史只收本插件发出的插话，主对话框里的聊天记录不算。 ![指导浮层：插话历史标出在第几轮第几步被读取（✓ T1·S2）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyonleeeee/dsh-steer/HEAD/assets/screenshot-2-guidance-history.png) 界面语言在详情面板里切换，可选自动、中文、English。选择写在 `~/.dsh/dsh-steer.lang`，不使用 localStorage。 ## 为什么不提供排队和官方插话 官方的 queue 和 steer 本质上都是「以用户身份发一条消息」——对话框本来就能发，官方队列栏本来就能排队。所以 v0.1.0 把这两条通道删掉了，插件只保留上面那条不打断的投递。 ## 数据通道 | 路由 | 用途 | |---|---| | `GET /dsh-steer/state?session=` | SSE 实时快照，仅状态变化时推送 | | `POST /dsh-steer/steer` | 运行中指导。请求体为 `{sessionId, text?, attachments?, reuseAtts?}`，其中 `reuseAtts` 用于重发时复用已有附件，不重传字节 | | `GET /dsh-steer/attachment?session=&id=[&raw=1]` | 读取指导附件，`raw=1` 时直接回字节流 | | `GET\|POST /dsh-steer/lang` | 界面语言，取值 `auto`、`zh`、`en` | | `GET /dsh-steer/ping` | 健康检查 | 出错时返回稳定的错误码：`mode-removed`（400）、`no-live-agent`（409）、`missing sessionId or content`（400）、`payload too large`（413）、`no-attachments` 与 `no-attachment-api`（501）、`reuse-attachment-unreadable`（404）。客户端按语言把这些码映射成提示文案，界面不会直接显示中文原文。 ## 安全 插件不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai` 包，只使用 `ctx.agents` 与 `ctx.webServer` 两个公开服务，另外可选地取用 `attachments` 和 `sessionController`。所有路由只接受 loopback 地址（127.0.0.1 与 ::1），没有遥测，也没有对外网络请求。 请求体分两档限制：纯文字 3 KB，带附件 48 MB——上限先按宿主 `imageLimits` 计算，再封顶，避免宿主报出的 200 MB 上限把内存撑爆。附件字节只通过官方 `sessionController.attachment` 读回，该方法会校验该附件确实属于目标会话日志。 ## 测试 ```bash npm test ``` 38 个用例，覆盖状态机（含步切换归零）、附件链路（含宿主不支持时的 501 分支）、路由错误码、语言处理，以及客户端的纯显示逻辑。零依赖，跑在 `node --test` 上。 ## 刻意不做的事 这个插件的核心只有一件事：工作中途加一条指令。因此排队与改撤排队消息、投递模式、子代理进度、token 面板、可配置阈值、localStorage 都不做。 ## 许可证 MIT © 2026 Lyon --- # English [中文](#dsh-steer) | English A DeepSeek Harness plugin: a live status badge in the session header, plus a way to add or correct an instruction while the agent is working, without interrupting it. Long agent runs cause two specific problems. First, you cannot tell what the agent is doing right now — "waiting for a response" and "genuinely stuck" look identical. Second, when you notice the direction is wrong, your only options are to wait for the whole turn or to interrupt it. There is nothing in between. This plugin addresses both. ![Live status badge in the session header with the guidance popover open (real capture)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyonleeeee/dsh-steer/HEAD/assets/screenshot-1-runtime-and-guidance.png) ## Quick start ```bash dsh plugin --profile add github:lyonleeeee/dsh-steer ``` Restart the app afterwards (`bundles` are read once at startup). The status badge and a "Guide" button then appear in the session header. The desktop app (DeepSeek Harness.app) manages its profile exclusively, so use the CLI carrier that ships with it: ```bash "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \ plugin --profile desktop add github:lyonleeeee/dsh-steer ``` ## The status badge The badge shows one phase at a time and advances in order: Analyzing → Thinking · N chars this step → Writing · N chars → Running → Reading tool result, then back to Working. During a tool call it appends a short summary, for example "Running bash · Run route probes". Two deliberate trade-offs. Character counts are per step — they reset at every turn/step boundary instead of accumulating over the whole stream, which only ever produced a meaningless growing number. The badge also omits the model name; model, provider, context window and step (`T4·S3`) live in the popover, so the badge itself stays quiet. Elapsed time is computed by a local clock in the client — the host only sends timestamps — so there is no timer while idle and no SSE push every second. The badge does not guess. With no new progress it shows "no new progress"; if the live source drops it shows "live source disconnected" rather than keeping a stale phase on screen. A failed request shows the official `failure.code`; a retry appears only when `llm/retry` actually fires, never as a guess about the network. ![Clicking the badge: the runtime detail panel (phase, step T4·S1, language switch)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyonleeeee/dsh-steer/HEAD/assets/screenshot-3-runtime-detail.png) ## In-flight guidance This is the plugin's main capability. You write a sentence, and it is read into context inside the current turn, at the end of the nearest small step (one reasoning block or one tool call). The task keeps running: no interrupt, no restart, no waiting for the turn to finish. It works through a custom message kind (`source.kind` is `dsh-steer`) plus `agent.steer()`. That detail matters. Delivered as an ordinary user message, the model would treat it as a new task — which is exactly what an interruption looks like. The guidance box accepts pasted images and selected files; attachments are committed as durable references through the host's `attachments` service. Drafts are stored per session, so a refresh does not lose them. The popover lists the guidance sent in this session, each entry marked with where it ended up: - ✓ read, with the turn and step where it was consumed, for example `T7·S3` - · delivered, not read yet - ✗ not read — the turn ended, or the message was discarded Click any entry to put its text back in the input. Entries that were never read can be resent in one click, and the resend carries the original attachments instead of uploading them again. The list only contains guidance sent from this plugin; messages from the main composer are not included. ![The guidance popover: history marks the turn and step where each entry was read (✓ T1·S2)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyonleeeee/dsh-steer/HEAD/assets/screenshot-2-guidance-history.png) The UI language switches in the detail popover: Auto, 中文 or English. The choice is stored in `~/.dsh/dsh-steer.lang`; localStorage is not used. ## Why there is no queue and no official steer The official queue and steer are both just "send a message as the user" — the composer already does that, and the official queue bar already queues. v0.1.0 removed both channels, leaving only the non-interrupting delivery described above. ## Data channels | Route | Purpose | |---|---| | `GET /dsh-steer/state?session=` | SSE live snapshot, pushed on change only | | `POST /dsh-steer/steer` | In-flight guidance. Body: `{sessionId, text?, attachments?, reuseAtts?}`; `reuseAtts` reuses existing attachments when resending, without re-uploading | | `GET /dsh-steer/attachment?session=&id=[&r

plugins.description: Codex-style edit for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-dex-style-edit

Codex-style message editing for DeepSeek Harness: edit an already-sent message and continue from there.

Click the pencil under any user message, change the text in place, press Enter. DSH session logs are append-only, so the plugin forks a new session at the turn *before* that message, sends your edited text as its opening message, and archives the session it replaced. Your files and working directory are left exactly as they are.

The model you pick in the composer before sending is the model that runs the edited message.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

像 Codex App 一样编辑已发送的消息：点铅笔改气泡内容，**从这条继续**。

DSH 会话日志只追加、不可改写，所以实现方式是：在此消息之前那一轮处 fork 一个新会话，把改过的文本作为新会话的第一条消息直接发出，并归档被替换的原会话。工作目录与文件保持现状。

发送前你在输入框里选的模型，就是这条改过的消息实际使用的模型。

</details>

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:XylaAlyx/dsh-plugin-dex-style-edit
```

Then **restart DSH**. A pencil appears under every user message, and forked sessions carry a branch glyph in the sidebar.

Full notes (behaviour details, implementation, known limits): [docs/README.full.zh.md](docs/README.full.zh.md).

## License

MIT

# dsh-bid-qual-check — Bidder qualification condition register check

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-bid-qual-check` reads one bidder qualification condition register — the 投标人资格条件核对表, its header plus one row per qualification condition — and checks that register's own closed loop: that each condition records its requirement, that the bidder's actual position is recorded, that evidence is attached, that the verdict comes from your vocabulary, that a pass/fail item records position, evidence and verdict together, that the register names its project and bidder, that condition numbers are unique, and that no unreplaced placeholder survives in the requirement column.

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-bid-qual-check: real output over its BQ-002 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-bid-qual-check/main/docs/assets/dsh-bid-qual-check-demo.png)

Real output from this plugin over its own `BQ-002` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| One row has both `资格条件` and `要求内容` blank. Is that reported? | Yes. `BQ-001` holds every row to at least one of those two columns and reports the row when both are empty. It checks that something was written, not whether that condition is lawful or should have been set at all — that is a review of the tender document itself. |
| A condition has its `投标人情况` column empty, and no `证明材料` either. | Two findings: `BQ-002` reports the row for the blank `投标人情况` (`actual`) and `BQ-003` for the blank `证明材料` (`evidence`). Both check only that the cell is filled — not whether the position satisfies the condition, nor whether the document is valid, current or matches the original, which needs the originals and the committee's call. A column that is present with every cell blank is still reported row by row; a material without that column puts the rule in `skipped` instead of passing silently. |
| The `核对结论` column is blank on a row. Does `BQ-004` report it? | No — `BQ-004` tests only the values that are written and skips blank cells. Its `values` list ships empty, so out of the box the rule reports itself in `skipped`; once you configure your institution's vocabulary in `values` (`符合` / `不符合` / `需澄清`, say), a value outside that list is reported row by row. It checks that the value is in your vocabulary, not that the conclusion is correct, and no value ever invalidates a bid. The rule is capped at `info`, because the vocabulary is your institution's to set. |
| A row's `是否否决项` cell reads `是`, but `投标人情况` or `证明材料` is missing. | `BQ-005` requires `投标人情况`, `证明材料` and `核对结论` together on every row whose `是否否决项` cell matches the configured marks (`是`, `Y`, `yes`, `true`, `否决项`, `√` by default) and reports the row with what is missing. Which conditions count as pass/fail comes entirely from the tender document and from that column, never from a built-in list. If no row carries such a mark, the rule reports itself in `skipped` instead of passing — and it never decides whether the bid should be rejected. |
| The register's header names the tender number, but not the project or the bidder. | `BQ-006` reports the header once and names what is missing: `project` (the project name) or `bidder` (the bidder name). It only checks that the header declares those two parties — it does not check the tender number or the check date, and adding the verdict vocabulary to this rule would not help, because that is controlled by `BQ-004`'s `values`. |
| This register was copied from a template: two rows share the number `3`, and one `要求内容` cell still reads `待填`. | `BQ-007` reports the repeated `序号` (the comparison ignores whitespace, so `3` and ` 3 ` are the same number), and if no row carries a number at all it reports itself in `skipped` instead of passing. `BQ-008` reports the residual placeholder in `要求内容` — `【`, `】`, `{{`, `}}`, `XXX`, `待填`, `待补充`, `TBD`, `示例` and the rest of its `terms` list, which you can narrow. Both checks are literal: neither judges whether the requirement itself is right, and a requirement genuinely quoted with an `XXX` in it is reported too. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《中华人民共和国招标投标法》 | 1999年8月30日通过，2017年12月27日修正（全国人大常委会《关于修改〈中华人民共和国招标投标法〉、〈中华人民共和国计量法〉的决定》），本法自2000年1月1日起施行 | BQ-001, BQ-002, BQ-003, BQ-004, BQ-006, BQ-007, BQ-008 |
| 《中华人民共和国招标投标法实施条例》 | 国务院令第613号（2011 年 12 月 20 日公布，2017 年 3 月 1 日修订，自 2012 年 2 月 1 日起施行） | BQ-005 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks a **投标人资格条件核对表** for the closed loop a checklist can be held to —
that every condition records its requirement and the bidder's actual position, that evidence is attached, that
verdicts come from your vocabulary, that a **pass/fail item** records all three, that the table names its
project and bidder, that numbers are unique, and that no placeholder survives. It does **not** decide whether a
bidder is qualified, whether qualification fails, or whether a bid should be rejected. **That is the
qualification committee's call, made against the evidence originals and the tender document's conditions.**

> ### ⚠️ Read this before trusting a citation in the report
>
> **Every `excerpt` in this plugin's rule pack says, in so many words, that the clause text was not
> obtained.** The regime lives in 《中华人民共和国招标投标法》(notably its articles on qualification
> conditions and on bidders' qualifications), 《招标投标法实施条例》, and **each tender document's own
> qualification conditions**. The verification pass could not retrieve verbatim clause text, so rather than
> paraphrase a quotation the pack states the gap in the `excerpt` field itself and puts the honest reasoning
> in `note`. Every rule is therefore `warn` or `info`, and a test asserts that no rule claims a quotation it
> does not have. **When the texts are in hand, two things must be done: replace each `excerpt` with the real
> clause, and raise `kind` to `direct`.**
>
> Two judgements are yours, not the plugin's. **Which conditions count as pass/fail items depends entirely on
> the tender document**, so `BQ-005` reads the **checklist's own 是否否决项 column** rather than any built-in
> list, and the values that mark an item as pass/fail are configurable. And the **verdict vocabulary ships
> empty** — with nothing configured, `BQ-004` reports itself in `skipped`. A finding never says a bid is
> invalid; it says a cell is empty or a value is not in your vocabulary.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.1`. `engines.dsh` is deliberately not declared: it has no reader and cannot reject a host |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native`, `ptc` and `both`; for several bidders use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `bid_qual_check` tool. It reads one qualification register — the package header plus one row per
condition — applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BQ-001` | every condition records its requirement | warn | direct |
| `BQ-002` | every condition records the bidder's actual position | warn | direct |
| `BQ-003` | every condition attaches evidence | warn | direct |
| `BQ-004` | the verdict comes from your vocabulary (off by default) | info | local |
| `BQ-005` | a pass/fail item records position, evidence and verdict | warn | principle |
| `BQ-006` | the table names its project and bidder | warn | principle |
| `BQ-007` | condition numbers are unique | warn | principle |
| `BQ-008` | the requirement column holds no unreplaced placeholder | warn | principle |
## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-bid-qual-check
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-bid-qual-check'
```

# 博查网页搜索 for DSH

[简体中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的 Cordis bundle，为 DSH 的 `ctx.web` 提供网页搜索。当前版本为 **0.2.2**，面向 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 和 Cordis `~4.0.4`。

## 功能

- 将固定的 DSH 网页搜索 provider `bocha` 路由到博查或 DSH 官方 DeepSeek 搜索 provider。
- 可在 DSH 设置中选择搜索引擎；新安装默认使用 Bocha，选择会保存到当前 Profile。
- 成功结果会标注实际使用的厂商：`Search provider: Bocha (bocha).` 或 `Search provider: DeepSeek (deepseek-official).`
- 可直接在 **博查网页搜索** bundle 详情页配置 Bocha API Key 和搜索参数，无需再进入单独的插件行配置页。
- API Key 通过 DSH 凭据服务保存，不写入 Profile 配置文件。
- 复用 DSH 自带的 DeepSeek 搜索 provider；不会停用官方 DeepSeek 插件。

## 安装与首次使用

本插件是 DSH bundle（目标版本：DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`、Cordis `~4.0.4`）；请先安装 DSH CLI。包发布到 npm 后，在终端中安装到要运行 DSH 的 Profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile my-profile add dsh-bocha-web-search-plugin
```

将 `my-profile` 替换为你使用的 Profile 名称。此命令会从 npm 安装包并将 bundle 加入该 Profile；单独在任意项目中运行 `npm install` 不会把插件注册到 DSH。命令说明见 [DSH 官方安装插件指南](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/develop/basic/publish)。

安装后按以下步骤首次使用：

1. 使用同一个 Profile 启动或重启 DSH Web UI，在 **插件** 页面确认 **博查网页搜索** 已启用。
2. 在 bundle 详情页保存 Bocha API Key（详细配置见下节）；可从[博查开放平台](https://open.bochaai.com/)获取密钥。密钥保存在 DSH 凭据库中。
3. 前往 **设置 → 通用设置 → 搜索引擎**，选择 **Bocha**。
4. 在新会话中试试“搜索今天的 AI 新闻并列出来源”，确认结果中出现 `Search provider: Bocha (bocha).`。

插件启用后的列表页面示例：

![DSH 插件列表中的博查网页搜索](docs/bocha插件开启.jpg)

## 配置 Bocha

1. 在插件列表中打开 **博查网页搜索** bundle。
2. 在详情页填写并保存 Bocha API Key。密钥保存在 DSH 凭据库中，不会写入配置文件。
3. 按需调整接口地址、时间范围、最多返回结果数和请求超时。

详情页配置示例：

![博查网页搜索 bundle 配置页面](docs/bocha插件配置.jpg)

默认 Bocha 参数：

| 参数 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| API Key 引用 | `BOCHA_API_KEY` | 通过 DSH 凭据服务解析 |
| 接口地址 | `https://api.bochaai.com/v1/web-search` | Bocha Web Search API |
| 时间范围 | `noLimit` | 不限制时间范围；也可使用接口支持的日期范围 |
| 最多返回结果数 | `10` | 每次搜索的结果上限 |
| 请求超时 | `15000` ms | Bocha 搜索请求超时 |

## 使用 DeepSeek 搜索

在 DSH 设置中将搜索引擎切换为 **DeepSeek**，即可通过 DSH 自带的 DeepSeek 搜索 provider 搜索。该路由使用 DSH 标准 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 凭据引用、账号令牌路径及可选的 `DEEPSEEK_SEARCH_BASE_URL` 启动环境变量。请保持 DSH 自带的 DeepSeek 搜索插件启用；本插件不会同步该插件独立配置行中的自定义参数。

可在 **设置 → 通用设置 → 搜索引擎** 中切换 Bocha 和 DeepSeek：

![在 DSH 设置中切换搜索来源](docs/bocha插件切换搜索来源.jpeg)

## 结果标记

模型调用 DSH 的 `web_search` 工具时，成功的搜索结果会在 `Sources:` 前包含实际搜索厂商标记。例如：

```text
Search provider: Bocha (bocha).
```

或：

```text
Search provider: DeepSeek (deepseek-official).
```

该标记用于区分本次请求实际走过的搜索路由，不改变 DSH 的 `web_search` 工具名或来源列表格式。

## 路线图 / TODO

- [ ] 按[博查官方 API 文档](https://aq6ky2b8nql.feishu.cn/wiki/HmtOw1z6vik14Fkdu5uc9VaInBb)扩展支持完整搜索能力：
  - **Web Search API (`bocha-web-search`)**：自然语言查询、时间/站点过滤和文本摘要；返回网页标题、链接、片段、摘要、站点信息、发布时间及图片，开放平台总览也列出视频搜索。
  - **AI Search API (`bocha-ai-search`)**：通过 `answer` / `stream` 控制大模型总结和流式输出；除网页、图片外，还返回天气、百科、医疗、火车、汇率、股票等垂直领域模态卡及追问。
  - **Agent Search API (`bocha-agent-search`)**：调用专业领域智能体回答问题并提供深入结果与追问。
  - **Semantic Reranker API**：按语义相关性排序文档并返回得分。
- [ ] 为各 API 增加独立配置、凭据管理、路由、结果标准化和测试；实现前核对登录后文档中的参数、权限和计费规则。
- 当前插件仅接入 Web Search API；AI Search、Agent Search 和 Semantic Reranker 尚未实现。

## 搜索及相关 API 价格对比（统一口径）

> 统一按 **人民币（CNY）/1,000 次 API 调用**均摊；价格快照：**2026-10-11**。美元报价按 2026-10-09 人民币中间价 **1 USD = ¥6.7330** 换算并四舍五入到分（[汇率来源](https://www.sohu.com/a/1086126179_122014422)）。套餐、峰谷或搜索深度不同的，以价格范围表示。

| API | 折算价格（CNY / 1,000 次调用） | 口径说明 |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| **Bocha Web Search** | **¥3.60–¥36** | 付费资源包均摊价；按量 ¥36/千次，另有 1,000 次免费试用（3 个月）。大额包降至 ¥32/¥30/¥28/¥25 每千次。[博查价目页](https://aq6ky2b8nql.feishu.cn/wiki/JYSbwzdPIiFnz4kDYPXcHSDrnZb) |
| **Bocha AI Search** | **¥60** | 按量 ¥0.060/次；已列资源包均为 ¥60/千次、有效期 1 年。[博查价目页](https://aq6ky2b8nql.feishu.cn/wiki/JYSbwzdPIiFnz4kDYPXcHSDrnZb) |
| **Bocha GTE Reranker** | **¥5** | `gte-rerank` ¥0.005/次，自 2025-11-01 起计费；这是重排调用，不是搜索请求。[博查价目页](https://aq6ky2b8nql.feishu.cn/wiki/JYSbwzdPIiFnz4kDYPXcHSDrnZb) |
| **DeepSeek 原生搜索（估算）** | **¥5.05–¥10.10** | 假设每次搜索 1,000 输入 tokens（缓存未命中）+ 1,000 输出 tokens；范围对应低峰/高峰 API Key 价格。实际费用随 token 用量变化。[官方价格](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing) |
| **Brave Search** | **¥33.67** | 固定价 $5/1,000 次请求，按上述汇率换算；另有每月 $5 credits。[官方价格](https://brave.com/search/api/) |
| **Tavily Search** | **¥53.86–¥107.73** | 按量价范围：Basic 1 credit、Advanced 2 credits，$0.008/credit；月付计划约 ¥33.67–¥50.50（Basic）、¥67.33–¥101.00（Advanced），免费档每月 1,000 credits。[计费规则](https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-credits.md)、[官方价格](https://www.tavily.com/pricing) |

价格可能调整，购买前请以[博查价目页](https://aq6ky2b8nql.feishu.cn/wiki/JYSbwzdPIiFnz4kDYPXcHSDrnZb)及各供应商官方页面为准。

## 开发与测试

```sh
npm install
npm test
```

`npm test` 会构建浏览器端模块、检查 JavaScript 语法，并运行 provider 路由、凭据解析及响应处理测试。测试使用受控响应，不会代替真实 API 联网验证。

- [生产配置补丁示例](cordis.patch.yml)
- [独立组合配置示例](composition.example.yml)
- `src/index.js`、`src/provider.js`：Host provider 与路由实现

本仓库由个人开发者独立开发和维护，不是博查（Bocha AI）、DeepSeek 或 DSH 官方项目。选择 Bocha 时，搜索请求发送到博查提供的 API；实际使用须遵守博查的服务条款、隐私政策和配额限制。本仓库代码采用 MIT License（见 [package.json](package.json) 中的 `license` 字段）。博查、DeepSeek 和 DSH 的名称及商标归各自权利人所有。

感谢 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** 提供插件运行与 Web 搜索扩展能力，也感谢 **Bocha** 提供搜索服务与 API。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness A2A (Agent2Agent) plugin: expose DSH agents as standard A2A servers (agent card, message/send, message/stream SSE, tasks) + a2a_* tools to call remote A2A agents
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-a2a

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的 **A2A（Agent2Agent）协议**插件。

DSH 内置的互操作走 ACP + MCP，不包含 A2A；本插件补上这块拼图，**双向**打通 A2A 生态（Google ADK、a2ajava / a2a-python SDK、各类 agent 网关）：

- **服务器方向（入站）**：把 DSH agent 暴露为标准 A2A 服务器
  - Agent Card：`/.well-known/agent-card.json`（0.3.x）与 `/.well-known/agent.json`（0.2.x 兼容）
  - JSON-RPC 2.0：`message/send`（同步）、`message/stream`（SSE 流式）、`tasks/get`、`tasks/cancel`、`tasks/resubscribe`（断线续订）、`agent/authenticatedExtendedCard`
  - 任务生命周期 `submitted → working → completed/failed/canceled`，支持 `input-required` 暂停与 taskId 多轮续答
  - 版本协商（`A2A-Version` / `X-A2A-Version` 头）、可选 Bearer 鉴权、CORS、单轮超时、任务 TTL 回收
- **客户端方向（出站）**：注册 `a2a_*` 模型工具，让任意 DSH agent 直接呼叫远端 A2A agent
  - `a2a_discover` / `a2a_send` / `a2a_task_status` / `a2a_cancel`
  - 地址白名单（`clientAllowPatterns`）控制 agent 可呼叫的目标
- **可视化运维面板**（Web client 半，v0.2.0）：Plugins → dsh-a2a 的配置卡与设置 Plugins 分区的 A2A 标签页
  - 服务器状态：运行中/模式/地址/协议版本/鉴权 + curl 验证命令一键复制
  - 实时任务板：最近任务的状态徽标/上下文/产物数，非终态任务一键取消（5s 自动刷新）
  - 远端 agent 目录：保存常用远端地址，浏览器直连拉取其 Agent Card（名称/版本/技能）
  - 数据来自 A2A 服务器自带的 `/admin/status`、`/admin/tasks` 端点（Bearer 门禁同 JSON-RPC）

零运行时依赖（纯 Node ≥20 stdlib + 全局 fetch），与 [dsh-feishu-bot](https://github.com/zyfgood/dsh-feishu-bot) 同一插件体系。

## 一、安装

```bash
# 官方 CLI 一键安装（bundle patch 自动挂载）
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:zyfgood/dsh-a2a

# 或本地路径
dsh plugin --profile <name> add file:D:/DSHProjects/dsh-a2a
```

重启 profile 后生效。默认监听 `127.0.0.1:7310`。

> `lib/` 预构建产物随仓库发布，安装即用，无需构建脚本（无 pnpm ≥10 的 `allowBuilds` 步骤）。

## 二、快速验证

```bash
# 1) Agent Card（0.3 路径）
curl http://127.0.0.1:7310/.well-known/agent-card.json

# 2) 发一条消息（同步）
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:7310/ -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "message/send",
  "params": {
    "message": {
      "kind": "message",
      "role": "user",
      "parts": [{"kind": "text", "text": "你好，介绍一下你自己"}],
      "messageId": "m-1",
      "contextId": "ctx-demo"
    }
  }
}'
```

返回的 `result` 是 A2A Task：`status.state === "completed"`，回复文本在 `artifacts[0].parts[0].text`。同一 `contextId` 再次调用会复用同一个 DSH agent 会话（多轮记忆）。

流式：

```bash
curl -N -X POST http://127.0.0.1:7310/ \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 2, "method": "message/stream",
  "params": {"message": {"kind": "message", "role": "user",
    "parts": [{"kind": "text", "text": "流式演示"}], "messageId": "m-2", "contextId": "ctx-demo"}}
}'
```

SSE 依次推送 `status-update(working)` → `artifact-update` → `status-update(completed, final=true)` 后自然收流。

## 三、配置项

profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（或本包 `cordis.patch.yml` 默认层）：

```yaml
- id: a2a
  name: dsh-a2a
  config:
    port: 7310
    mode: agent
```

| 配置 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `host` | `127.0.0.1` | 监听地址；公网暴露改 `0.0.0.0` 并配合鉴权 |
| `port` | `7310` | 监听端口（`0` = 系统分配） |
| `publicUrl` | 按监听地址推导 | 写入 Agent Card 的 `url`；反代/TLS 部署时必须配置为外部可达地址 |
| `bearerToken` | 无 | Bearer 鉴权令牌，支持 `env:VAR`；配置后卡片宣告 `bearerAuth` |
| `agentName` / `agentDescription` / `agentVersion` | `DSH Agent` / … | Agent Card 元信息 |
| `skills` | 内置一条 dsh-agent 技能 | Agent Card 技能清单 |
| `mode` | `agent` | 入站处理模式：`agent` / `llm` / `echo`（见下） |
| `provider` / `model` / `systemPrompt` / `maxHistory` | — | `llm` 模式参数（`ctx.llm` 直答） |
| `agentId` | 自动 | `agent` 模式：固定复用 `ctx.agents` 中某会话；不配置则按 contextId 自动创建 |
| `agentPreset` | GUI 默认预设 | 自动创建会话的 preset（决定 agent 可用的工具集） |
| `workspace` | `process.cwd()` | 自动创建会话的工作目录 |
| `persistSessions` | `true` | contextId → 会话映射落盘（`$DSH_HOME/a2a/`），重启后自动恢复上下文 |
| `turnTimeoutMs` | `600000` | 单轮执行上限，超时任务置 `failed` |
| `taskTtlMs` | `3600000` | 已完结任务内存保留时长（之后 TTL 回收） |
| `tools` | `true` | 是否注册 `a2a_*` 出站工具 |
| `clientAllowPatterns` | `['*']` | 出站白名单：`'*'`、`https://a2a.example.com/`、`https://*.example.com/`、`'*:7310'` |
| `clientTimeoutMs` | `120000` | 出站调用超时 |

### 三种入站模式

- **`agent`（默认）**：每个 A2A `contextId` 对应一个持久 DSH agent 会话（完整工具/技能/工作目录），跨任务续答；映射可落盘跨重启恢复。会话忙时新消息走 `steer`（下一 step 边界消费）。
- **`llm`**：`ctx.llm` 直答（自包含轻量模式，不建 agent 会话，短期记忆按 `maxHistory`）。
- **`echo`**：回显原文，验证链路。

## 四、出站：agent 调用远端 A2A

插件默认注册 4 个模型工具（`tools: false` 关闭）：

| 工具 | 对应协议方法 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| `a2a_discover` | `GET /.well-known/agent-card.json` | 拉取远端 Agent Card（能力/技能/鉴权） |
| `a2a_send` | `message/stream`（自动降级 `message/send` + 轮询） | 发消息并等待远端最终回复 |
| `a2a_task_status` | `tasks/get` | 查询远端任务状态 |
| `a2a_cancel` | `tasks/cancel` | 取消远端任务 |

对话示例：「用 a2a_send 呼叫 http://其它机器:7310/ 的 agent，问它有哪些技能，把结果汇总给我」。

## 五、开发

```bash
pnpm verify   # 本地 typecheck（shims/ 提供 @deepseek-ai 结构类型）
pnpm test     # 构建 DSH 无关核心 + 31 项端到端冒烟测试
pnpm build:local  # 本地全量构建 lib/（shims 类型校验，产物与宿主构建一致）
pnpm build    # 完整构建（需要宿主环境提供 @deepseek-ai/* peer 依赖）
```

代码结构：

```
src/
├── index.ts       插件入口：Config schema + apply()
├── protocol.ts    A2A 类型 / JSON-RPC / Agent Card（纯函数，零依赖）
├── store.ts       任务存储 + SSE 事件中枢（事件缓冲、订阅、TTL）
├── server.ts      HTTP 服务器：card / message/send / message/stream(SSE) / tasks/* / admin/*
├── bridge.ts      DSH 桥接：echo / llm / agent 三种 TaskRunner
├── client.ts      出站 A2A 客户端（fetch + SSE 解析）
├── tools.ts       a2a_* 模型工具注册
└── persistence.ts contextId → 会话映射落盘
client/
└── client.js      浏览器半：A2A 运维面板（免构建 ModuleLoader 工厂，react 为宿主 external）
```

设计说明：

- `protocol` / `store` / `server` / `client` 不依赖任何 DSH 包，可独立构建与测试；DSH 桥接收敛在 `bridge.ts` / `tools.ts` / `index.ts`。
- `input-required` 事件带 `final=true` 关闭当轮 SSE，但任务保持非终态，客户端可凭 `taskId` 续答（续答复用同一任务与 history）。
- `tasks/cancel` 立即广播 `canceled(final=true)`；agent 模式下正在运行的一轮会在 500ms 轮询粒度感知退出并尽力 `interrupt`，不会阻塞后续轮次。
- 与 A2A 0.2.x 客户端的兼容：旧 card 路径照常服务；0.2 客户端不发送版本头时按同版本处理。
- 不支持的协议面按规范返回明确错误码：push notification `-32003`、批量 JSON-RPC `-32600`。

## 六、与 DSH 内置能力的关系

| 需求 | 用什么 |
|---|---|
| 程序化驱动 DSH agent（进程外） | 内置 ACP（`dsh-acp`，`pnpm dsh --profile acp`） |
| 挂载外部工具/资源 | 内置 MCP 客户端 |
| 跨 agent 生态互操作（Google ADK / A2A SDK） | **本插件** |

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Control running DeepSeek Harness sessions from desktop and mobile browsers using the stock DSH Web UI and a self-hosted relay.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Web Control

[English](README.en.md) · [安装](docs/installation.md) · [部署 Relay](docs/deployment.md) · [版本与限制](docs/compatibility.md) · [Releases](https://github.com/liangkw16/dsh-web-control/releases)

通过链接或二维码，在电脑、平板和手机浏览器中接管正在运行的 DeepSeek Harness 会话。

**尽可能复用 DSH 原版 Web UI，Web Control 只负责认证、连接与有限能力桥接。** 无需开放电脑的入站端口，无需远程桌面。

这是独立社区插件，与 DeepSeek 没有隶属或官方背书关系。当前版本 **v0.1.0**，验证目标为 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2**；其他 DSH 版本未声明兼容。Relay 需自行部署，本项目不提供公共托管服务。

## 能做什么

- 原版会话列表、消息、执行进度、工具记录、队列操作和审批交互。
- 在电脑与移动浏览器间切换，新页面可接替旧控制页面。
- 原版文件卡片、历史 diff、侧栏标签和完整文件预览；支持浏览器下载与上传。
- 插件在 DSH Host 中保持连接，关闭设置页面或仅锁屏后仍可使用；休眠、断网和退出 DSH 会影响连接。
- 通过版本协商和明确的命令接口适配，保留 DSH 原版业务资源，避免维护另一套聊天界面。

## 工作方式

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Browser[PC / 移动浏览器] <-->|HTTPS / WSS| Relay[自托管 Relay]
    Host[DSH Host + 插件] <-->|主动建立 WSS| Relay
    Host --> Session[原版会话与工作区服务]
```

Relay 负责认证、路由和静态 UI 分发。浏览器与 Host 均通过 TLS 连接到 Relay，**不是端到端加密**：部署者必须信任自己的 Relay。控制链接是访问凭据，不要公开分享。

## 快速开始

1. 从 [v0.1.0 Release](https://github.com/liangkw16/dsh-web-control/releases/tag/v0.1.0) 下载插件 `dsh-web-control-0.1.0.tgz`、部署包及 `SHA256SUMS`，按[部署指南](docs/deployment.md)启动 HTTPS Relay。
2. 在 DSH 桌面 App 的「插件 → 添加插件」中安装下载的 `.tgz`，启用插件。CLI 用户可运行：

   ```sh
   npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 plugin --profile web add ./dsh-web-control-0.1.0.tgz
   ```

3. 首次使用时，由 Relay 管理者生成一次私有连接配置，在 DSH「设置 → 网页远控」导入；日常使用只需打开生成的链接或扫码。
4. 保持 DSH 运行，在另一台设备的浏览器打开链接即可。停止远控、刷新链接与接管规则见[安装指南](docs/installation.md)。

预构建 tarball 不需要在安装时执行构建脚本。源码仓库是 monorepo；不要把仓库根目录当成可直接安装的插件包。

## 文档

| 文档 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| [安装与配对](docs/installation.md) | 桌面 / CLI、首次配置、控制链接、升级卸载 |
| [Relay 部署](docs/deployment.md) | Docker Compose、HTTPS、IP:port、备份回退 |
| [架构](docs/architecture.md) | 原版 UI 复用、状态同步和权限边界 |
| [兼容性](docs/compatibility.md) | 支持范围、文件限制、浏览器验收边界 |
| [排障](docs/troubleshooting.md) | 连接、证书、文件读取与锁屏 |
| [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md) | 构建、测试、PR 要求 |
| [发布流程](docs/releasing.md) | 制品、校验、验证与官方发现入口 |
| [安全政策](SECURITY.md) | 威胁模型、漏洞报告、凭据保护 |

## 本地开发

需要 Node.js 24.x、pnpm 11.25.0。运行测试只使用隔离 fixture，不连接你的生产 DSH。

```sh
corepack enable
corepack prepare pnpm@11.25.0 --activate
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
```

Relay 镜像还需要固定的原版 UI 资源；不能只运行 `docker build`。使用完整部署包，或按[发布流程](docs/releasing.md)组装 `release-input/web`。

## 许可证与来源

本项目使用 [MIT](LICENSE)。DeepSeek Harness 和其他依赖保留各自许可证，见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。原版 UI 资源的许可证随部署包分发。

DeepSeek [官网](https://deepseek.com/harness/)的“社区插件”指向 GitHub [`dsh-plugin` topic](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)，这是本项目采用的官方发现路径；不是“官方审核通过”的标志。
