plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-inju-boot · INJU 启动动画 **给 DeepSeek Harness 装一支开机动画。** 每次启动 Harness，全屏播放一支 WebGL2 实时粒子动画 —— 花 → 月球 → 虚影文字 → 实体 LOGO， 带一套极客 HUD / 终端层和 Apple 发布会式的程序化音效，播完自动淡出把界面交还给你。 [![test](https://github.com/inju0524/dsh-inju-boot/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/inju0524/dsh-inju-boot/actions/workflows/test.yml) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D20-brightgreen.svg)](package.json) [![dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0-success.svg)](package.json) [快速开始](#快速开始) · [设置项](#设置项) · [工作原理](#工作原理) · [自检](#自检) · [排障](#排障) · [English](#english)


6.3 秒走完全部 10 个阶段（每段约 0.6 秒，硬切）· 720×405 · 4 MB

### 十个环节 | # | 阶段 | 时间 | 画面 | |---|---|---|---| | 01 | 汇聚 | 0 – 3.2s | 星尘云团被吸聚成一朵参数化 3D 雏菊（花瓣 / 花心 / 花托 / 花茎 / 地面亮点） | | 02 | 花体 · 环绕巡游 | 3.2 – 5.8s | 相机缓慢环绕，花瓣层次与花茎前后关系都看得到 | | 03 | 崩解 | 5.8 – 7.3s | 每颗粒子沿花心向外爆散，带湍流冲量与惯性拖尾 | | 04 | 重聚 | 7.3 – 9.3s | 回吸聚合成一颗 3D 粒子月球（撞击坑 / 月海 / 山脉） | | 05 | 月球 · 静默自转 | 9.3 – 11.7s | 坑谷环脊在光照下缓缓转出 | | 06 | 显影 | 11.7 – 14.4s | 月球 → 虚影文字，粒子变细、变弥散、开始抖动 | | 07 | 虚影 · 闪烁漂移 | 14.4 – 15.7s | 全息虚影闪烁、漂浮 | | 08 | 像素偏移闪切 | 15.7 – 16.45s | 28 条横向切片错位 + 13×11 块状位移 + RGB 分离 + 过曝闪白 | | 09 | 实体 · 平面 LOGO | 16.45 – 20.05s | 硬切为实体平面 LOGO，带扫光；残留粒子成为光晕 | | 10 | 循环 · 淡出 | 20.05 – 21.05s | 淡出并重新开始 | > 全部 10 个阶段的时长、手感、每阶段的粒子尺寸 / 抖动 / 爆散冲量 / 体积光都能在设置页调； > 上面这张表读的就是动画目录那份 `inju.config.js`。 --- ## 这是什么 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件（bundle），给 Web 界面加两样东西： | | | |---|---| | **启动覆盖层** | 挂在 `shell.overlay`，页面一加载就全屏播放动画，播到设定位置后淡出 | | **设置页** | 挂在 `settings.section`，与宿主其它设置页并排，动画的一切参数都在这里调 | 动画本体是一支**零依赖的单文件 WebGL2 作品**：6 万颗自发光粒子、10 个阶段、程序化生成的 3D 雏菊 / 粒子月球 / 虚影文字 / 实体 LOGO，外加一层画在画布内、会跟着一起吃泛光与像素偏移闪切的 **极客 HUD**（数字雨、跟随主体的目标框、扫描线、实时点云小图、终端日志、遥测、hex dump）。 它还带了 **DeepSeek Harness 的产品身份层**：顶部逐字拉开的 `DEEPSEEK HARNESS` 铭牌、 左上角的 `root@deepseek-harness:~# dsh --profile desktop`、遥测里的 `MODEL` / `RUNTIME` 字段、 以及一整套 DSH 启动序列的终端日志。


完整分辨率静帧：第 02 阶段 · 花体环绕巡游  |  第 09 阶段 · 实体平面 LOGO

它还带了 **DeepSeek Harness 的产品身份层**：顶部逐字拉开的 `DEEPSEEK HARNESS` 铭牌、 左上角的 `root@deepseek-harness:~# dsh --profile desktop`、遥测里的 `MODEL` / `RUNTIME` 字段、 以及一整套 DSH 启动序列的终端日志。 ``` y= 27 root@deepseek-harness:~# dsh --profile desktop PHASE 2 / 10 花体 · 环绕巡游 y= 29 D E E P S E E K H A R N E S S y= 55 [ok] cordis composition online · sandbox: workspace-local 2.00 / 21.05 s y= 63 agent runtime · cordis composition · profile desktop y= 83 [!!] approval: never · telemetry: local · sig 0x000E 60,000 y= 194 MODEL deepseek-v4.1-flash y= 222 RUNTIME dsh 0.1.7 · node 22 y= 296 TARGET FLOWER · LOCKED y= 804 [boot] deepseek-harness 0.1.7 :: profile desktop y= 935 [███░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░] 10% DEEPSEEK HARNESS ``` > 上面是 `node tools/check-animation.mjs --dump` 打出来的**真实绘制调用**（1920×1080，t=2.0s）。 > 想看你自己屏幕尺寸下的排版：`node tools/check-animation.mjs --dump --w=1440 --h=900 --t=9.5`
预览图 / 动图是怎么来的（想自己重新生成的话） 动画自带**静帧模式**：`?t=<秒>` 定格在指定时刻并暂停，`hud=0` 隐藏页面 DOM 装饰、`telemetry=1` 保留极客 HUD。 插件把动画挂在 `/api/inju-boot/boot.html`，所以只要 Harness 在跑，直接用浏览器打开这个地址就能截图： ``` http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/inju-boot/boot.html?t=4.0&hud=0&telemetry=1 # 花体阶段 http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/inju-boot/boot.html?t=10.5&hud=0&telemetry=1 # 月球阶段 http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/inju-boot/boot.html?t=17.6&hud=0&telemetry=1 # 实体 LOGO ``` 两张静帧就是这样抓的：headless Edge + CDP，等 90 帧后 `Page.captureScreenshot`，再转成 WebP（1920×1080，共 240 KB）。 **hero 动图**是 10 段拼起来的：动画本体暴露了确定性单帧驱动 `window.__render.set(t)`， 所以可以对每个阶段钉住播放头、各取 5 帧（段内连续、段间硬切），再交给 ffmpeg： ```powershell ffmpeg -framerate 8 -i frames/f_%04d.png -vf "scale=720:-1:flags=lanczos,split[a][b];\ [a]palettegen=max_colors=64:stats_mode=diff[p];[b][p]paletteuse=dither=bayer:bayer_scale=5:diff_mode=rectangle" \ -loop 0 docs/preview-stages.gif ``` 三个踩过的坑，省得下次再走一遍： 1. **headless 下别加 `--disable-frame-rate-limit --disable-gpu-vsync`。** 那两个开关会让 `requestAnimationFrame` 的 dt 趋近 0，而 HUD 每 1/30 秒才重绘一次 —— 结果截到一张**没有 HUD** 的干净画面。 （用注入钩子数过 `fillText`：4 次 vs 去掉开关后的 10534 次。） 2. **GIF 对这个画面极其不友好。** 每颗粒子每帧都在动，等于每帧都是全帧更新。 实测 800×450 / 90 帧 是 **16 MB**；把动画自带的 `render.grain`（每像素胶片噪点）临时关掉后直接降到 7.5 MB。 粒子数与数字雨开关几乎不影响体积（5.1 MB vs 5.1 MB），真正决定体积的只有**分辨率 × 帧数**。 3. **ffmpeg 在这台机器上写不了 `%TEMP%`**（`Permission denied`），输出直接落仓库目录里就行。
--- ## 快速开始 ### 安装 **方式 A：交给 Harness 自己装（推荐）** 让 Harness 里的 Agent 调用 `plugin_manager`： ``` plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=<这个仓库的绝对路径> ``` 它会替你写 profile 的 `package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml` 并完成安装 —— **不要手改那两个文件**。 **方式 B：dsh CLI** ```powershell dsh --profile <你的 profile> plugin add "file:<这个仓库的绝对路径>" # 或直接从 GitHub 装： dsh --profile <你的 profile> plugin add "github:inju0524/dsh-inju-boot" ``` 装完**重启一次 Harness**（新增 bundle 需要重新组装 profile）。下一次启动就会看到动画。 > 卸载：`plugin_manager action=remove_bundle target=dsh-inju-boot` > 只是不想看了：设置页关掉「启用启动动画」，或在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里给这一行加 `disabled: true`。 ### 动画从哪来 插件按这个顺序找动画： 1. **设置页里显式填的「动画目录」**（填到含 `inju-particles.html` 的目录） 2. **插件的上一级目录** —— 把这个插件文件夹放进你自己的动画项目里，它就用那份**活的**动画， 你在 `inju.config.js` 里改一个数字，刷新页面就生效 3. **插件自带的 `assets/` 副本** —— 独立 clone 出来时用这份，保证任何机器上都能播 --- ## 设置项 设置 → **INJU 启动动画**。 | 分组 | 项 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | 播放 | 启用启动动画 | 总开关 | | | 每次启动只播一次 | 会话级去重，开发时热重载不会反复重播 | | | 时长倍率 | 等比拉伸整条时间轴（>1 更慢） | | | 结束阶段 | 播到第几个阶段末尾就淡出（默认播完整个循环） | | | 淡出时长 | 结束时的淡出毫秒数 | | 背景音乐 | 背景音乐 / 音效 | **是否播放背景音乐**。关掉时连引擎都不加载（`?audio=0`） | | | 背景音乐音量 | 0~1，覆盖动画配置里的 `audio.master` | | | 首次点击只解锁声音 | 默认开。第一次点击/按键只用来出声，**不中断动画** | | | 自动播放被拦下时提示 | 只在浏览器确实拦下自动播放时才出现 | | 跳过 | 点击中断动画 | 是否允许**点击**中断动画 | | | 按键中断动画 | 是否允许**按键**中断动画（Esc 始终可跳过） | | | 显示跳过按钮 / 按钮文字 | 右下角的跳过按钮 | | 画面 | LOGO / 虚影文字 | 虚影文字与最终实体 LOGO 都用它 | | | 粒子数量 | 1000 ~ 400000 | | | 粒子尺寸 / 粒子亮度 / 泛光强度 / 机距 | 直通动画的 `size` / `intensity` / `bloom` / `dist` | | | 极客 HUD / 终端层 | **可选，默认开启**。DSH 铭牌与启动命令行 + 数字雨 + 目标框 + 扫描线 + 点云小图 + 终端日志 + 遥测 + hex dump | | | 模式 | `flower3d` 程序化 3D 雏菊 / `photo` 照片粒子化 | | 窗口顶栏 | 顶栏融入动画 | **默认开启**。仅 Windows 桌面端：让最小化/最大化/关闭背后的标题栏背景变透明 | | | 隐藏「应用 / 编辑」菜单 | **默认开启**。仅 Windows 桌面端：动画期间隐藏 Desktop 注入的菜单条，播完恢复 | | 高级 | 动画目录 | 留空 = 自动探测 | | | HUD 终端台词 | 一行一条 `秒 文本`；`{text}` 会换成真正的 LOGO 文字 | | | `inju.config.js` 覆盖 | 一段 JSON，**深度合并**到动画目录那份 `inju.config.js` 之上 | 配置落在 `/inju-boot/config.json`（默认 `~/.dsh/inju-boot/config.json`）， `cordis.patch.yml` 里那一行的 `config` 是出厂种子。三层优先级： **内置默认值 ← YAML 种子 ← config.json（设置页写这里）**。 ### 「`inju.config.js` 覆盖」能改什么 动画配置的**全部**字段，键名与 `inju.config.js` 完全一致： ```json { "camera": { "orbitYaw": 0.6, "dist": 20 }, "moon": { "radius": 2.6, "craters": 110 }, "flower": { "layers": [ { "n": 40, "len": 2.4 } ] }, "render": { "bloom": 1.2, "exposure": 1.1 }, "hud": { "brand": { "title": "MY HARNESS", "subtitle": "我的启动序列" } }, "stages": [ { "dur": 3.2 }, { "dur": 4.0 } ] } ``` `stages` 数组**按下标合并**，只写想改的那几项就够了。 --- ## 工作原理 ### 一、动画托管：原文件一个字节都不改 `inju-particles.html` 里 `

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness MCP client bridge that carries the calling Agent's session id in tools/call params._meta
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-mcp-session-meta

Makes **DeepSeek Harness** tell MCP servers *which conversation* is calling.

Every `tools/call` the harness sends gets the calling Agent's session id in
`params._meta.session_id`. That is the one piece of information an MCP server
needs to keep per-conversation state — and the one DSH currently leaves blank.

> Chinese documentation: [README.zh.md](README.zh.md).
> This is an **unofficial community plugin** — not affiliated with or endorsed by
> DeepSeek.

## The problem

DSH's MCP client passes `{ name, arguments }` straight through as the request
params, leaving `_meta` empty:

```js
call: (args, execution) => client.callTool({ name: tool.name, arguments: args }, { … })
```

But `_meta` is a first-class optional field of MCP's `BaseRequestParamsSchema`:

```js
const BaseRequestParamsSchema = z.object({ _meta: RequestMetaSchema.optional() })
```

So a server can only ever see *the process*, never *the conversation*. For a
server whose state is per-conversation — browser automation with tab groups,
editors, anything with sessions — every conversation in the harness shares one
bucket and the server has no way to tell them apart.

Other MCP clients already send it: ZCode sends `session_id`, Antigravity sends
`antigravity.google/conversation_id`, Codex sends `thread_id`, WorkBuddy sends
`workbuddy.ai/conversationId`. DSH is the odd one out.

The identity is already sitting at the call site — the agent loop sets
`ToolExecutionInput.agent` (*"The agent on whose behalf the call runs"*), and
`agent.id` **is** the SessionId. It is simply not forwarded.

## What it changes

Two patches, both in the derived artifact:

| Patch | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `clientInfo` | `{ name: "dsh-mcp-client", version: "0.0.1" }` — a middleware self-report with a placeholder version | `{ name, title: "DeepSeek Harness", version: "<real>" }` |
| `tools/call` params | `{ name, arguments }` | `{ name, arguments, _meta: { session_id: <agent.id> } }` |

`_meta` is omitted entirely when there is no Agent on the execution (nested
dispatches) — a missing key means "this frame doesn't know", which is different
from claiming a session.

## Install

The artifact has to be regenerated against **your** installed DSH, because the
patch targets DeepSeek's *compiled* bundle and that changes between releases.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Liang-HZ/dsh-plugin-mcp-session-meta
cd dsh-plugin-mcp-session-meta

node sync.mjs                  # extract from your app.asar + patch (fails loudly if the anchors moved)
node install.mjs --list        # show the MCP entries in your profile
node install.mjs --server NAME # point that one entry at this package
```

Then **restart DSH** — see *Caching* below.

- `--profile web` — target another profile (default `desktop`)
- `--check` — report only, change nothing
- `--uninstall` — put the entry back to the upstream package

Only the entry you name is switched; other MCP servers keep using the upstream
client. Nothing else in the harness changes.

### Caching: a restart is required

DSH caches imported plugin modules. Editing plugin code — or even changing which
package an entry points at — does **not** take effect live: Node's ESM cache is
keyed by URL, and the plugin manager's enable/disable only re-runs `apply()` on
the already-imported module. A restart (or a brand-new entry id) is the only
thing that re-imports. Expect "the entry is active, the module name changed, and
it still runs the old code" until you restart.

## Compatibility

- Built and tested against `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` **0.2.0-rc.2**
  (DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2, macOS).
- `sync.mjs` asserts on both patch anchors. If a DSH upgrade moves them it
  **fails** rather than emitting an unpatched artifact — a silently unpatched
  copy is the worst outcome here, because the plugin would still load and simply
  stop doing anything.
- Node ≥ 22.15 (extraction uses `zlib.zstdDecompressSync`).

## How it is built (and why not a plain fork)

DeepSeek's harness repository does not accept external pull requests, and the app
bundle is code-signed with per-file integrity hashes — editing files inside
`app.asar` breaks the signature and is overwritten by every update.

So the artifact is **extracted, patched and regenerable** rather than a frozen
copy:

```bash
node sync.mjs          # regenerate lib/index.js from the installed app
node sync.mjs --check  # is the artifact still what this DSH would generate?
```

`sync.mjs` also reads the external modules the bundle imports and writes them
into `peerDependencies`. That is not bookkeeping: DSH's profile resolver supplies
packages **by peer declaration** ("Linked importers apply current peer
declarations at each ancestor node_modules"). An undeclared peer is not supplied,
and the plugin dies during import with no useful error. Deriving the list from
the artifact keeps it in step automatically.

## Notes for other DSH plugin authors

Two things that cost real time to discover:

1. **Declare every package you import as a `peerDependency`.** The resolver in
   `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot` reads the importing package's own manifest to
   decide what to supply. Miss one and the fiber ends up `DISPOSED` with a bare
   `fiber state 4` and no message.
2. **`patchReload: "live"` is a profile setting.** The shipped `web` profile has
   it; a profile without it will not pick up patch edits without a restart.

## When to delete this

When DSH forwards the session id itself. The upstream fix is small — the identity
is already in scope at the call site — and this plugin exists only to fill the gap
in the meantime.

That request is filed here, with the exact change and the evidence:
**https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/9519**

If it lands, this package is dead weight — uninstall it.

## License

MIT. The derived `lib/index.js` is a patched build of
[`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client)
(MIT, © DeepSeek). See [NOTICE](NOTICE).

plugins.description: Removes undici's 300s body timeout that cuts off long local-model prefills.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-undici-timeout-fix

Fixes DSH cutting off local-model requests after exactly five minutes of silence.

English | [简体中文](#简体中文)

## What this fixes

When a local model spends more than five minutes on prompt prefill, the request dies with
`terminated` and the model server logs `Client disconnected`.

The cause is **not** a DSH setting. Node's built-in `fetch` runs on undici, whose connection-level
`bodyTimeout` defaults to `300,000ms`. That timer is an *idle* timer: every body chunk resets it.
A model that is busy prefilling sends no bytes at all, so undici destroys the socket the moment
the five minutes run out.

`streamIdleTimeoutMs` does not help here. It configures DSH's own watchdog, which is a separate
timer and — before this plugin — fired at the same 300,000ms mark. Raising it just lets undici
win the race, which is why the error changes from `stream idle timeout after 300000ms` to the
bare `terminated`.

## How it works

DSH reaches the network through pi-ai calling the openai SDK, and that SDK uses the **global**
`fetch` (`Shims.getDefaultFetch()`). Replacing undici's global dispatcher therefore covers model
requests without patching DSH itself:

```js
import { Agent, setGlobalDispatcher } from 'undici'

setGlobalDispatcher(new Agent({ headersTimeout: 0, bodyTimeout: 0 }))
```

`0` **disables** undici's timers rather than setting a duration.

## Install

### From a release tarball (no registry needed)

Download `dsh-undici-timeout-fix-1.1.0.tgz` from the repository's Releases page, then:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add /path/to/dsh-undici-timeout-fix-1.1.0.tgz
```

The one dependency (`undici`) is still resolved from a registry you can reach, so a local npm
mirror or a proxy works fine.

### From npm

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-undici-timeout-fix
```

Or through the plugin manager in the DSH UI: add the package name `dsh-undici-timeout-fix` and
point the install source at a registry that serves it.

Installing by hand? Add the row to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: undici-timeout-fix
      name: 'dsh-undici-timeout-fix'
```

### Restart required

**Fully quit DSH and start it again.** The dispatcher is installed while the plugin loads, so a
running process keeps whatever it already set. On macOS use `Cmd+Q` — closing the window is not
enough, because the process survives.

Skipping the restart is the most common reason for "it still fails".

## Also configure `streamIdleTimeoutMs`

This plugin removes the transport ceiling, but it also removes DSH's own backstop. With no upper
bound at all, a genuinely wedged connection can hang forever. Keep a large but finite watchdog on
the provider that talks to your local model:

```yaml
- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
  config:
    providers:
      lmstudio1:
        displayName: lmstudio
        apiKeyEnv: LMSTUDIO1_API_KEY
        api: openai-completions
        baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1/
        streamIdleTimeoutMs: 1800000   # 30 minutes
        models:
          - id: qwen3.5-122b-a10b
            name: qwen3.5-122b-a10b
```

Do this for **every** provider you point at a local model. A provider without the key falls back
to the 300,000ms default.

You can also prefer a finite transport timeout over disabling it entirely:

```js
setGlobalDispatcher(new Agent({ headersTimeout: 3_600_000, bodyTimeout: 3_600_000 }))
```

## Verify

Send a request whose prefill exceeds five minutes. If it completes, the fix is live.

You can also confirm which timer fired by reading the error:

| Error | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `terminated` | undici's transport timer — this plugin's concern |
| `pi-ai stream idle timeout after xxxms` | DSH's watchdog — raise `streamIdleTimeoutMs` |

## Do not set proxy environment variables

`HTTP_PROXY`, `HTTPS_PROXY`, and `ALL_PROXY` make `dsh-http-proxy` install its own Agent during
boot, which carries the same five-minute limit and replaces this plugin's. DSH installs the proxy
before plugins load, so this plugin always wins *only when no proxy is configured*.

## Platform status

| Platform | Status |
|---|---|
| macOS (Darwin 24, Node 24.21.0 / undici 7.29.1 built in) | Tested, working |
| Windows | Untested — please open an issue with your result |

The code has no platform-specific paths, file writes, or process spawning, and depends only on
`undici`, so it should behave identically on Windows. It has not been verified there yet.

## Notes

- This bundle declares no `peerDependencies`, so DSH's plugin version-compatibility check does not
  block installation.
- pnpm's `minimumReleaseAge` policy (24 hours by default) blocks freshly published versions. If
  installation reports an older version, install an exact one: `dsh plugin add dsh-undici-timeout-fix@1.1.0`.

## License

MIT

---

## 简体中文

修复 DSH 使用本地大模型时，静默满五分钟后请求被切断的问题。

### 解决的问题

本地模型做 prompt 预处理（prefill）超过五分钟时，请求会以 `terminated` 失败，模型服务端日志出现
`Client disconnected`。

原因**不在 DSH 配置**。Node 内置 `fetch` 基于 undici，其连接级 `bodyTimeout` 默认 `300,000ms`。
该计时器统计的是**空闲时长**：每收到一个 body 数据块就重置。正在 prefill 的模型一个字节都不发，
于是五分钟一到 undici 直接销毁 socket。

`streamIdleTimeoutMs` 解决不了这个问题。它配置的是 DSH 自己的看门狗，是另一个计时器——而且在装本插件
之前，它同样在 300,000ms 处触发。把它调大只是让 undici 抢先触发，所以报错会从
`stream idle timeout after 300000ms` 变成一个光秃秃的 `terminated`。

### 原理

DSH 经由 pi-ai 调用 openai SDK 发起请求，而该 SDK 使用**全局** `fetch`（`Shims.getDefaultFetch()`）。
因此替换 undici 的全局 dispatcher 就能覆盖模型请求，无需改动 DSH 本体：

```js
import { Agent, setGlobalDispatcher } from 'undici'

setGlobalDispatcher(new Agent({ headersTimeout: 0, bodyTimeout: 0 }))
```

`0` 表示**禁用** undici 的计时器，而不是某个时长。

### 安装

### 从 Release 附件安装（无需registry）

从仓库的 Releases 页面下载 `dsh-undici-timeout-fix-1.1.0.tgz`，然后：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add /path/to/dsh-undici-timeout-fix-1.1.0.tgz
```

唯一的依赖（`undici`）仍会从你能访问到的 registry 解析，所以内网 npm 镜像或代理都可以。

### 从 npm 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-undici-timeout-fix
```

也可以在 DSH 界面里安装：包名填 `dsh-undici-timeout-fix`，安装源指向提供该包的 registry。

手动安装时，在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里加一行：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: undici-timeout-fix
      name: 'dsh-undici-timeout-fix'
```

### 必须重启

**完全退出 DSH 后重新启动。** dispatcher 在插件加载时安装，已运行的进程会继续沿用它之前的状态。
macOS 上请用 `Cmd+Q`——只关窗口不够，进程仍然存活。

漏掉重启是"怎么还是不行"最常见的原因。

### 同时配置 `streamIdleTimeoutMs`

本插件移除了传输层的上限，同时也移除了 DSH 自身的兜底。完全没有上限时，真正卡死的连接可能永远挂着。
请为每个指向本地模型的 provider 配一个足够大但有限的看门狗：

```yaml
- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
  config:
    providers:
      lmstudio1:
        displayName: lmstudio
        apiKeyEnv: LMSTUDIO1_API_KEY
        api: openai-completions
        baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1/
        streamIdleTimeoutMs: 1800000   # 30 分钟
        models:
          - id: qwen3.5-122b-a10b
            name: qwen3.5-122b-a10b
```

**每个**指向本地模型的 provider 都要配。漏配的会退回默认的 300,000ms。

如果你更想设一个有限值而不是完全禁用：

```js
setGlobalDispatcher(new Agent({ headersTimeout: 3_600_000, bodyTimeout: 3_600_000 }))
```

### 验证

发一个 prefill 超过五分钟的请求。正常完成即表示生效。

也可以通过报错文本判断是哪个计时器触发的：

| 报错 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `terminated` | undici 传输层计时器——本插件负责的范围 |
| `pi-ai stream idle timeout after xxxms` | DSH 看门狗——调大 `streamIdleTimeoutMs` |

### 不要设置代理环境变量

`HTTP_PROXY`、`HTTPS_PROXY`、`ALL_PROXY` 会让 `dsh-http-proxy` 在 boot 阶段安装它自己的 Agent，
它同样带五分钟限制，并会替换掉本插件。DSH 先装 proxy、后加载插件，所以**只有不设代理时本插件才一定生效**。

### 平台状态

| 平台 | 状态 |
|---|---|
| macOS（Darwin 24，Node 24.21.0，内建 undici 7.29.1） | 已测试，可用 |
| Windows | **未测试**——欢迎提 issue 分享你的结果 |

代码不含任何平台相关路径、文件写入或进程调用，唯一依赖是 `undici`，因此在 Windows 上行为应当一致，
但尚未实测验证。

### 其他说明

- 本 bundle 未声明 `peerDependencies`，因此不受 DSH 插件版本兼容性检查拦截。
- pnpm 的 `minimumReleaseAge` 策略（默认 24 小时）会拦截刚发布的版本。若安装提示装了旧版本，
  请指定精确版本：`dsh plugin add dsh-undici-timeout-fix@1.1.0`。

### 许可

MIT

plugins.description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) sidebar session deletion plugin for 0.2.0-rc.2 - replaces the version-incompatible dsh-session-delete
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-delete-next

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）侧栏**会话删除**插件 —— 为当前运行时（`0.2.0-rc.2`）重写的版本，
替代插件市场里因 peer 版本范围（`^0.1.0-rc.5`）不兼容而装不上的 `dsh-session-delete`。

仓库：<https://github.com/ljp888/dsh-session-delete-next>

[English](#english) | 中文

---

## 中文

### 功能

| 入口 | 菜单项 | 行为 |
|---|---|---|
| 会话行 `…` 菜单 | **删除会话** | 永久删除该会话的全部本地记录，不可恢复 |

要点：

- 危险操作，红色菜单项 + 独立确认对话框（明示「不可恢复」并显示会话标题）。
- **运行中的会话一律拒绝删除**（含当前会话）——宿主端返回 `409 live`，对话框给出提示。
- 删除后立即从侧栏消失，**无需刷新**（复用官方已转发的 `api-session/removed` 事件）。
- 菜单文案跟随 GUI 语言（中文 / 英文），走官方 locale 服务。

### 技术实现

与旧版插件的关键差异：**不再用 DOM 注入**。`0.2.0-rc.2` 已开放官方扩展点，本插件走
标准 slot 机制，不会随侧栏结构变化而静默失效。

**Host 半**（`index.js`，纯 ESM）

- 只 `inject: ['webServer']`，其余服务（`sessionPersistence` / `workspaceRegistry` /
  `sessions` / `storageDomain`）按请求用 `ctx.get()` 惰性获取，缺失时降级而不是拒绝加载。
- 注册同源路由 `POST /dsh-session-delete-next/delete`，请求体 `{ sessionId }`。
- 删除顺序（**先删文件，后记账**，失败绝不留下「已隐藏但未删除」的半删状态）：
  1. 拒绝 live / 已创建未落盘的会话；
  2. `ctx.sessionPersistence.stat(id)` 定位日志，`locate(header).path` 取路径，
     删除其所在目录（含 `session.lock`）；
  3. 安全校验：文件名必须匹配后端自己的 `session.v<N>.jsonl[.zst|.zstd|.gz]`，
     且目录必须位于持久化后端的 `root` 之内，否则拒绝；
  4. 清理 `session_projcache` 投影缓存；
  5. 从 workspace 账目 `detachSession`，并清除归档标记；
  6. `ctx.emit('api-session/removed', id)` 通知浏览器。
- 同源校验：跨站 `Origin` 直接 `403`。

**Client 半**（`client.js`，手写浏览器 bundle，无需构建）

- `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: '<包名>', factory })` 懒注册。
- 注册到官方 slot：
  - `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item`（会话 `…` 菜单，`order: 500`，排在
    pin/rename/fork/archive 之后）；
  - `shell.overlay`（确认对话框，独立于菜单生命周期）。
- 复用宿主注入的 `useMenuOpenState()` 关闭菜单；`t()` 来自 `ctx.locale.register`。
- 若宿主缺少所需 UI primitives，只告警并跳过注册，不会让 slot 渲染崩溃。

### 安装

最省事的方式是直接 clone 成 profile 的插件目录（`<profile>` 默认为 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`）：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ljp888/dsh-session-delete-next.git \
  ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-session-delete-next
```

Windows PowerShell 对应写法：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/ljp888/dsh-session-delete-next.git `
  "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-session-delete-next"
```

然后手动复制文件也可以，步骤：

1. 把整个包目录复制到 `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-delete-next/`
   （`<profile>` 默认为 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`）。
2. 在 `<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` **追加**一行挂载（此文件被 HMR 监听，保存后即热加载）：

   ```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: dsh-session-delete-next
         name: dsh-session-delete-next
   ```

3. 浏览器刷新一次即可看到菜单项。

> 不写入 profile 的 `package.json`：本包不在 npm 上，写成 `dependencies` 会让后续
> `pnpm install` / `dsh plugin` 操作去 registry 拉取而失败。代价是将来在 profile 里跑
> `pnpm install` 可能把这个目录剪掉，重装即可。

### 已知限制

- **不能删除 live 会话。** 官方没有公开的「驱逐运行中会话」API，所以正在运行或已打开的
  会话会被拒绝。先关掉它（或重启 DSH）再删。
- **子智能体会话**也可删除；删除后父会话的子智能体目录会少一项，界面会随
  `api-session/removed` 自行收敛。
- **附件不删。** `~/.dsh/attachments/**` 是内容寻址、跨会话共享的，删除会话不会动它。
- Windows 上若另一个进程仍持有 `session.lock`，`rm` 可能报 `EBUSY`；此时对话框会显示
  原始错误且**磁盘状态不变**，重试即可。
- 全量删除（按工作区批量）未实现——只做单个会话删除，减少不可验证的失败路径。

### 实测验证状态（本机）

| 项目 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 宿主端加载 + 路由注册 | ✅ `~/.dsh/logs/desktop-next.log`：`[dsh-session-delete-next] host ready: POST /dsh-session-delete-next/delete` |
| profile 热加载（无需重启） | ✅ 追加 patch 行后 Loader 自动刷新，日志即出现上述行 |
| 侧栏 `…` 菜单出现「删除会话」 | ✅ 红色危险样式 + 分隔线，排在官方「归档会话」之后 |
| 中文 locale 解析 | ✅ 显示「删除会话」，不是原始 key |
| 确认对话框 | ✅ 标题、含会话名插值的正文、红色「永久删除」、取消 |
| 执行真正删除（成功路径） | ⚠️ **未执行** —— 原因见下 |

**为什么没做破坏性实测**：验证时侧栏只有一条会话，正是承载那次对话的活跃会话。
官方在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 没有公开「驱逐运行中会话」的 API，所以插件会拒绝删除它；
跑通「删除成功」路径需要一个**非活跃**会话当靶子，我不拿真实对话历史去赌。
想自行确认：新开一个会话 → 随便发一条消息 → 切回原会话 → 对那个测试会话执行删除。
删除成功的判据是 `~/.dsh/sessions/<项目目录>/<会话 id>/` 整个目录消失，且侧栏该行立即消失。

> 注：`index.js` 的 fail-closed 安全加固（`sessions` 服务不可用时拒绝删除）不在 HMR
> 模块监听根内，需**重启 DSH** 才在运行实例中生效；之前的运行实例行为一致。

## English

Adds the missing **Delete session** action to the sidebar session row menu of DSH
`0.2.0-rc.2`, replacing the marketplace `dsh-session-delete` whose peer range
(`^0.1.0-rc.5`) no longer resolves.

- Permanently removes the session's local records; red danger styling plus a
  confirmation dialog that states the action is irreversible.
- Running/open sessions are refused (`409 live`) — they are never deleted.
- The row disappears immediately, with no refresh, by re-emitting the official
  `api-session/removed` forwarded event.
- Localized through the client locale service (zh/en).

Unlike the original plugin this uses the **official slots** rather than DOM
injection: `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` for the menu row and
`shell.overlay` for the dialog. Files are removed before any bookkeeping, so a
failure never leaves a session that is hidden but still on disk.

Install: clone this repository straight into the profile's plugin directory —
`git clone https://github.com/ljp888/dsh-session-delete-next.git ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-session-delete-next`
— then append the `- insert:` row to `<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` and refresh the
page. The profile `package.json` is deliberately left untouched because this
package is not published to npm.

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mcp-manager for DSH

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) bundle that manages MCP
servers registered in your DSH patch files: list, real-handshake probe, add from a
pasted project reference, enable/disable, remove, and credential rotation —
following the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` configuration contract.

## Install

**Option A — agent tool (Creator mode):** ask your agent:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle https://github.com/<owner>/dsh-mcp
```

**Option B — Web UI:** open the sidebar **Plugins** page in the DSH Web app and
install from the GitHub URL above.

Both official channels run pnpm, validate the bundle manifest, and select the
bundle automatically. After installation, seven tools become available to agents:

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `mcp_manager_list` | List registered MCP servers (credential values masked) |
| `mcp_manager_probe` | Real MCP handshake (`initialize` + `tools/list`) against one or all servers |
| `mcp_manager_add` | Paste an npm package / GitHub repo URL / MCP endpoint URL / JSON config; dry-run by default, `confirm: true` writes it |
| `mcp_manager_remove` | Remove an entry (`confirm: true` required) |
| `mcp_manager_toggle` | Enable/disable an entry (`confirm: true` required) |
| `mcp_manager_credential` | Locate / mask-display / rotate the `!!js`-referenced credential file |
| `mcp_manager_validate` | Check an entry against the official mcp-client rules |

Verify after installation: the tool call returns `application: applied`; then call
`mcp_manager_list` — it should show your servers (chrome-devtools, playwright,
github, …). Tools become `mcp__<serverName>__<tool>` in **new** sessions.

## CLI

The bundle also ships a zero-dependency CLI (same engine, no harness needed):

```sh
node cli/mcp.js list [--json]
node cli/mcp.js probe [--id <id>] [--timeout 60]
node cli/mcp.js add "<npm-package | github-url | mcp-url | json>" [--yes] [--no-probe]
node cli/mcp.js enable|disable <id> --yes
node cli/mcp.js remove <id> --yes
node cli/mcp.js credential <id> get|set <value>
node cli/mcp.js validate <id>
node cli/mcp.js schema
```

All writes go through the same guarded pipeline: surgery on a candidate copy →
validation with DSH's own loader (`loadOptionalPatches`) → atomic write with a
`.bak` backup. A candidate that fails validation never reaches your live patch.

## What it writes

Entries follow the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` contract exactly:

```yaml
- id: mcp-<serverName>
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
  config:
    serverName: <serverName>      # [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}, unique
    transport: stdio              # or streamable-http
    command: npx                  # stdio only
    args: ['-y', '<package>']
    failOnStartupError: true      # recommended for fresh entries
```

Secrets are never written into the patch: the tool stores them in a credential
file and references it with a `!!js` expression (the same pattern the official
GitHub entry uses). DSH hot-reloads the patch — new servers appear without a
restart.

## Scope and safety

- Writes target the **home** overlay `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml` (official
  composition order: bundle patches → profile patch → home patch → `--patch`).
- Every mutation requires explicit confirmation (`confirm: true` / `--yes`);
  removals and toggles keep a `.bak` of the previous file.
- Probes are read-only; they never start browsers or send credentials anywhere
  beyond the server's own endpoint.

## Development

```sh
node --test "test/*.test.mjs"   # 58 tests, zero dependencies
node -e "import('./scripts/check-bundle.mjs').then(m => console.log(m.checkBundle('.')))"
```

Official rules are vendored under `docs/official/` (extracted from the installed
DSH `app.asar`; provenance in `docs/official/README.md`), design and plan under
`docs/`.

# dsh-enter-using

DSH Web 界面插件：**命令授权（审批）支持键盘回车 + 数字键**，手感类似 Codex。

默认的 DSH 审批面板只认「回车允许 / Esc 拒绝」。装上这个插件后，面板变成带编号选项的键盘面板，不用鼠标也能授权。

## 按键

| 按键 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `1` | 允许一次 |
| `2` | 拒绝 |
| `Enter` | 确认当前高亮项（默认第 1 项＝允许一次） |
| `Esc` | 拒绝 |
| `↑` `↓` `←` `→` | 切换高亮项（循环） |
| 鼠标悬停 / 点击 | 同样可用 |

面板选项顺序固定为 `1 允许一次`、`2 拒绝`，与 Codex 一致：默认回车＝放行，误按回车也不会拒绝。

## 实现方式

- 以 `priority: 0.5` 注册到会话编辑器的链式槽位 `conversation.composer`，比官方审批面板（`priority: 1`）更早被匹配，从而接管审批渲染。
- `select` 只匹配 `kind === "approval"` 且可作答的待处理交互；其它待处理交互（例如计划评审）仍返回 `null`，继续由官方面板处理，互不干扰。
- 键盘监听注册在 `document` 的**捕获阶段**，命中后 `preventDefault()` + `stopPropagation()`。下列情况一律让行：
  - 事件已被处理（`defaultPrevented`）、输入框/文本域/`contenteditable` 内、页面上存在 `[role="dialog"]` / `[aria-modal="true"]` 弹窗；
  - 带 `Ctrl` / `Meta` / `Alt` 修饰、输入法组合态（`isComposing` / `keyCode 229`）、系统按键重复（`repeat`）。
- 不调用 `ctx.shortcuts.registerFixed`：官方审批面板已占用 `Enter` / `Escape` 两个固定快捷键，键位处理放在插件组件内部，避免重复注册冲突。
- 每次审批只作答一次：作答中禁用按钮，Host 拒绝/失败后自动恢复可作答状态，组件卸载后不再更新状态。
- 样式通过 `ctx.effect` 注入一串带 `data-plugin-css` 标记的 `<style>`，卸载时移除；类名统一 `deu_` 前缀，颜色只引用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题变量并带兜底值。

## 安装

本仓库本身就是一个 DSH bundle（`package.json` 里的 `dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`）。

- **DSH 内**：`plugin_manager` → `install_bundle`，target 填本仓库目录（例如 `D:\dsh-project`）。
- **命令行**：`dsh plugin add D:\dsh-project`。
- **npm / 插件商店**：发布到 npm 后，商店会显示版本号与下载量，并可安装预构建包（免 `allowBuilds` 构建授权）。

安装后按提示刷新页面或重启 `dsh web` 生效；命令授权面板出现时即可用数字键 / 回车 / Esc 作答。

## 开发

```bash
npm test
```

26 项测试，全部通过。测试在 `vm` 沙箱中加载 `client.js`（stub 掉 `window.__ModuleLoader__`、`document` 与 `react`），覆盖：槽位注册契约、locale 词典完整性、样式注入与回收、按键映射与全部守卫条件、作答状态机（重复按键 / 不可作答 / 失败回滚）、以及卸载时监听器清理。

## 上架 dshmarket（插件商店）

dshmarket 的插件列表来自精选目录 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)，条目不写在本仓库里，而在那边「一个插件一个 YAML 文件」。本仓库保留了一份待提交的条目副本：[market/dshmarket-entry.yml](market/dshmarket-entry.yml)。

收录条件（对照本仓库现状）：

| 条件 | 现状 |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` 声明 `dsh.bundle`（只有 `dsh.client` 不算） | ✅ `dsh.bundle.patch` |
| 仓库有真实可用的代码 | ✅ 26 项测试 |
| 仓库创建满 1 天 | ✅ 首个提交 2026-10-08 |
| 仓库添加 `dsh-plugin` topic | ✅ 已设置 |

提交状态：条目已通过 PR 提交到上游 —— [awesome-dsh-plugin#6971](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/6971)（只含 `data/plugins/wukiQAQ__dsh-enter-using.yml` 一个文件）。合并后目录站点与 dshmarket 会自动收录。

提交方式：把 `market/dshmarket-entry.yml` 复制到 `awesome-dsh-plugin` 仓库的 `data/plugins/wukiQAQ__dsh-enter-using.yml`，提 PR。文件名必须与 `url` 对应（`owner__repo.yml`），README 由 CI 生成、不要手改。条目字段已在本地用该仓库的 `scripts/lib/entries.mjs` 校验：4461 条全量 0 问题。

## 发布到 npm（版本同步）

商店卡片上的版本号取自 **npm 的 `dist-tags.latest`**（见 `dshmarket` 的 `src/registry.ts`：只有 GitHub 源码的条目 `version` 为 `null`，界面直接不显示版本号）。所以「随版本同步」＝把包装到 npm：之后每次 `npm version` + `npm publish`，商店会自动显示新版本，**不需要**再往目录提 PR。

- 收录与 npm 无关：不发 npm 也能从 GitHub 安装，只是没有版本号与下载量（上游 `contributing.md` 原文）。
- npm 映射由上游从 registry 自动采集：目录条目里不需要、也不允许手写 `npm:` 键。
- 发布前提（本仓库已就绪）：`repository` 指回本仓库（上游靠它把 npm 包与目录条目关联起来）；官方 `@deepseek-ai/*` 用 `peerDependencies` 声明，且范围带**显式预发布分支**（否则 node-semver 会静默排除所有 `-rc.*` 版本，用户 `npm install` 时遇到 `ERESOLVE`）；`private` 已移除。
- 手动发布：`npm login` → `npm publish`（`prepublishOnly` 会先跑 26 项测试）。
- 自动发布：[.github/workflows/release.yml](.github/workflows/release.yml) 在推送 `v*` 标签时发布，需要在仓库 Secrets 里配置 `NPM_TOKEN`（npm automation token，Publish 权限）。发版流程：改 `version` → 提交 → `git tag v0.1.1 && git push origin v0.1.1`。

## 目录

```
package.json                  # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client（platform: web, immediately）
cordis.patch.yml              # bundle 注入声明
index.js                      # Host 半边（无行为，UI 全在 Client）
client.js                     # Client 半边：审批面板 + 键盘交互
test/client.test.mjs          # 测试
market/dshmarket-entry.yml    # 待提交到 awesome-dsh-plugin 的商店条目
.github/workflows/release.yml # 打 v* 标签时自动 npm publish（需 NPM_TOKEN）
```

plugins.description: DSH 内嵌 Token 历史总用量组件
plugins.readme_text: # tlogs — DSH 侧边栏 Token 用量组件 [English](README.en.md) | 中文 tlogs 在 DSH 桌面端侧边栏页脚常驻显示 Token 用量，含紧凑条、展开面板与详细数据弹窗。 紧凑条常驻页脚： 展开后是七张卡片： ## 形态 ![紧凑条与展开面板](docs/images/sidebar.png) | 形态 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | 紧凑条 | 总量、今日、请求数。`↻` 刷新，`▾` 展开 | | 展开面板 | 总消耗、当前项目、今日、当周、当月、近 7 天、近 30 天 | | 详细数据弹窗 | 日历、图表、模型、供应商、年、月、当月按天、设置 | ## 语言 插件的界面语言在详细数据弹窗的**设置**页签里切换： | 选项 | 含义 | | --- | --- | | 跟随系统（默认） | DSH 界面语言 → 浏览器语言 → 中文 | | 中文 / English | 固定该语言 | 选择存在本机浏览器，插件重启后保持；只影响本插件界面，不改 DSH 自身语言。 ## 详细数据 弹窗按页签组织。**图表**页签的三张图共享同一套控制项（范围 × 数据源 × 指标 × 粒度），切换任意一项三张图一起变： **日历**页签按月列出逐日用量与金额，点某一天看当天明细： ## 数据来源 | 来源 | 覆盖 | 时效 | 金额 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 平台账单 | 账号全部设备，仅官方通道 | 滞后 10~30 分钟 | 有 | | 本机会话日志 | 仅本机，含所有供应商 | 实时 | 无 | 两路**逐日**合并：`max(平台, 本机官方通道) + 本机第三方供应商`。同一次调用会被两路各记一次，因此取大而不相加。 - 只有窗口内含平台看不到的第三方用量时，卡片才标 `第三方`；其余口径细节见卡片 tooltip。 - 历史月份与图表用平台口径。模型与供应商页签按**通道**判定，不按模型名：火山方舟上的 `deepseek-v4-flash` 属第三方。 ## 安装 四种方式：绝对路径、tarball、npm 包名、`github:/dsh-tlogs`。`lib/` 是已构建产物，安装不会构建。 desktop profile 不能用 CLI 安装，改用 设置 → 插件 → 安装；其它 profile 用 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tlogs`。 安装后重启 DSH。实测 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2（desktop、web）。 ## 凭据 | 顺序 | 来源 | | --- | --- | | 1 | 环境变量 `DEEPSEEK_PLATFORM_USER_TOKEN` | | 2 | 配置 `platformUserToken`（明文） | | 3 | DSH 凭据 `TLOGS_USER_TOKEN`（面板填写） | | 4 | 复用 DSH 已登录账号 | | 5 | 内置登录窗口（桌面端不可用） | 前 3 项优先于自动来源；退出登录只清除第 3 项。 ## 配置 | 配置 | 默认 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | `exposeUsageToModel` | `false` | 注册对话内查询工具 | | `useAccountSession` | `true` | 复用 DSH 账号凭据 | | `localUsage` / `localUsageScanDays` | `true` / `32` | 读会话日志与回溯天数 | | `enableProjectScope` | `true` | 当前项目卡片 | | `persistHistory` | `true` | 历史落盘 | | `autoRefreshSeconds` | `300` | 定时刷新间隔，0 关闭 | | `cacheTTL.total` / `.current` | `1800` / `300` | 缓存秒数 | | `startYear` / `startMonth` | `2024` / `4` | 历史起点 | | `requestIntervalMs` | `1000` | 月度请求间隔 | | `numberFormat` | `short` | `full` 千分位 / `short` K·M·B | | `compactMetrics` | `[total, today]` | 紧凑条指标 | | `cacheDir` | `''` | 空为 `/tlogs` | `compactMetrics` 可选：`total`、`today`、`week`、`month`、`last7`、`last30`、`cost_total`、`cost_today`、`cost_last7`、`cost_last30`。 环境变量：`DEEPSEEK_PLATFORM_USER_TOKEN`、`TLOGS_CACHE_DIR`、`DSH_HOME`。 ## 安全 | 措施 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | 凭据 | 只暴露 `getPlatformSession()`；会话凭据仅刷新期间持有；失效标记只存摘要 | | 网络 | 只连 `platform.deepseek.com`；不跟重定向；部署头白名单只放行 `x-` | | 模型隔离 | 默认不注册工具；打开后项目 id 仍是不可逆哈希 | | 会话日志 | 只读、只取计数与 provider/model，落盘只存路径哈希 | | 发布闸门 | `npm run verify:secrets` | 最小权限配置： ```yaml exposeUsageToModel: false useAccountSession: false enableProjectScope: false persistHistory: false localUsage: false ``` ## 隐患 **架构** 1. 同一浏览器 realm 内，其它插件可调用本插件的 RPC。 2. `.credentials.yaml` 同用户进程可读——本机凭据的主要暴露面，与插件无关。 3. 会话凭据只能断开引用，无法物理擦除（JS 字符串不可变）；DSH 内部是否缓存不在本插件边界内。 **取舍** 4. 面板显示项目 label，本机数据源读取会话日志；可用配置关闭。 5. 项目快照从插件启用当天开始，无法回溯。 **使用习惯** 6. 在对话中粘贴用量数字或截图会进入模型上下文。 ## 开发 ```bash pnpm run check # 密钥闸门、文案外置校验、注释闸门、typecheck、build、测试 pnpm run verify:dsh # 用本机 DSH 解析器校验插件声明 pnpm run golden # 在线端到端对拍，需要 DEEPSEEK_PLATFORM_USER_TOKEN ``` `test/golden.test.ts` 缺外部 Python 参考脚本时跳过，用 `TLOGS_REFERENCE_SCRIPT=<路径>` 指定。 ## 许可 GPL-3.0-only，全文见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness bundle: Serena MCP integration - IDE-grade symbolic code intelligence (find/rename/edit symbols) for DSH agents, plus tool-usage hooks bridge
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-serena

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/akash-digitavision/dsh-serena)

**One-line value:** install this and every DeepSeek Harness agent gains IDE-grade symbolic code intelligence — `find_symbol`, `find_referencing_symbols`, `rename_symbol`, `replace_symbol_body`, `get_symbols_overview` and more — via the [Serena](https://github.com/oraios/serena) MCP server, plus session hooks that keep agents actually using it.

**Capability category:** 工具与能力 (Tools & Capabilities)
**License:** MIT · **Compatibility:** DSH ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2 (bundles API); Windows/macOS/Linux; Python ≥ 3.11 for the Serena CLI

## What it adds to every agent on the profile

| Row | Module | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `mcp-serena` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` | Spawns the Serena MCP server (stdio) → `mcp__serena__*` tools: symbol search & overview, find references/implementations/declarations, rename & safe-delete symbols, symbolic editing, per-project memories, diagnostics |
| `dsh-hooks-claude-code` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code` (dependency of this bundle) | Runs `~/.dsh/hooks.json`: session-start project activation prompt, tool-drift reminders toward Serena's tools, stop cleanup |

Launched with `--context claude-code --project-from-cwd`: each session auto-activates its workspace as the Serena project, and tools that duplicate DSH built-ins (file read/search/shell) stay hidden.

## Install

**One command (recommended):**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:akash-digitavision/dsh-serena
```

or in **Settings → Plugin Market** (DSH Plugin Hub), search for `dsh-serena`.

### Prerequisites

1. **The Serena CLI** — the official install puts `serena` on your PATH (the bundle's default):
   ```bash
   # install uv first: https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/
   uv tool install -p 3.13 serena-agent
   ```
   Custom location? Point the bundle at it:
   ```powershell
   setx SERENA_COMMAND "C:\path\to\serena.exe"
   ```
   > **Windows note (Smart App Control / WDAC):** application-control policies may block uv-managed unsigned Python builds. Workaround: build a venv from a trusted/signed interpreter, `pip install serena-agent` into it, and `setx SERENA_COMMAND` to that venv's `serena.exe`.
2. **The hooks file** `~/.dsh/hooks.json` (Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\hooks.json`) — copy [`hooks.template.json`](./hooks.template.json):
   ```json
   {
     "SessionStart": [{ "matcher": "", "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "serena-hooks activate --client=claude-code" }] }],
     "PreToolUse":    [{ "matcher": "", "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "serena-hooks remind --client=claude-code" }] }],
     "Stop":          [{ "matcher": "", "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "serena-hooks cleanup --client=claude-code" }] }]
   }
   ```
   `serena-hooks` ships with `uv tool install serena-agent`. If it is not on the DSH process PATH, use the absolute path to the executable in the template.

Then **restart DeepSeek Harness**. Verify by asking an agent: *"activate this project with serena"*.

## Permissions & external services

- Spawns a local `serena` MCP server process (language servers may download per-language tooling on demand)
- Reads/writes only your activated project workspaces; memories stored per-project in `.serena/`
- No accounts, no API keys, no telemetry

## Known limitations

- The hooks-bridge dependency is version-pinned (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code` `0.2.0-rc.2`); if your DSH runtime is newer and install is rejected for peer incompatibility, match the version to your runtime
- First symbol query in a new project downloads that language's language server — first call can be slow

## Uninstall

Remove `dsh-serena` from the profile `dsh.profile.bundles` + `dependencies` (or `dsh plugin remove`), then restart the host. The Serena CLI, venv and hooks file are independent of the bundle.

## Credits

Upstream: [oraios/serena](https://github.com/oraios/serena) (MIT / GPL-3.0) — this bundle only wires it into DeepSeek Harness.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin engineering handbook — build checklist, slot map, safety invariants, release/publish flow and pitfalls, distilled from a real plugin.
plugins.readme_text:
# 插件工程链路手册（DSH）

> **这是什么**：给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）做第三方插件的"施工手册 + 坑单"。
> **来源**：`dsh-colors`（多彩Harness）0.9.9 → 0.9.11 的完整实战，包含全部踩过的坑与验证过的结论。
> **用法**：下次做插件先读 §0 清单，再按 §2 起骨架；卡住查 §11 故障速查。
> **维护**：本手册是**通用文档，独立成册**，不放进任何单个插件的仓库（专用 ≠ 通用）。
> 公开册：https://github.com/dreamtao2199/dsh-plugin-handbook
> 工作区真源：`D:\~T~ Empire\~I~\AI\数字产品\.deepseek\.dsh-plugins\PLUGIN-ENGINEERING-HANDBOOK.md`；本地镜像 `C:\Users\dream\dsh-dev\dsh-plugin-handbook\README.md`；改完跑同目录 `_tools\sync-handbook.ps1` 同步。

---

## 0. 十分钟快速开始（Checklist）

| # | 做 | 命令 / 动作 | 验收标准 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 起骨架 | 目录 + `package.json`（§2） | `dsh plugin --profile <档案> add <路径或 github:owner/repo>` 不报错 |
| 2 | 写宿主半 | `index.js`（可以先是空壳） | 档案里出现该插件条目，无 loader 报错 |
| 3 | 写客户端半 | `src/**` → `node build.mjs` → `client.js` | 硬刷新后界面出现（席位生效） |
| 4 | 定状态 | 一个 `STORAGE_KEY` + 迁移旧键（§4） | 刷新/重启后设置不丢 |
| 5 | 过安全红线 | 对照 §5 逐条自查 | 不订阅 `theme/change`、不用 `setInterval`、全屏浮层只 1 个 |
| 6 | 写断言 | 四套测试（§6） | 全绿，且"测试这个测试"能变红 |
| 7 | 打包 + 自校验 | `tools/make-manifest.mjs` → `tools/package.mjs` | MANIFEST 逐文件 0 不匹配；产出 `.tgz`/`.zip` |
| 8 | 部署 | 备份 → 合并复制 → 刷新（§8） | 开发副本与部署副本哈希一致 |
| 9 | 发布 | `git commit/push` → tag → Release（§9） | 别人能 `dsh plugin add github:owner/repo` |
| 10 | 上架 | 向精选列表提 PR（§9.3） | 仓库有 `dsh-plugin` topic；描述与代码一致 |

---

## 1. 心智模型

* **一个插件＝两半**：宿主半（跑在 DSH 进程里，Node）＋ 客户端半（跑在浏览器/Electron 渲染进程）。
  * 宿主半：注册工具（tools）、服务、审批、连接外部系统。
  * 客户端半：注册界面席位（slots）、样式、状态。
* **DSH 是"一切皆插件"**：模型、工具、沙箱、会话存储、UI、甚至 agent loop 本身都是插件层。所以"扩展点"非常多，但**能安全用的只有官方席位与官方服务**。
* **"装得上"的判据**：`package.json` 里必须有 `dsh.bundle.patch`（指向 `cordis.patch.yml`）；只有 `dsh.client` 是**装不上**的（这是精选列表里被拒最多的一类）。
* **纯聚合包不收录**（精选列表规则）：自己不带行为的"依赖清单包"不单独收录。

---

## 2. 最小骨架

```
dsh-myplugin/
  package.json       # 必需：dsh.bundle.patch（+ 有界面时 dsh.client）
  cordis.patch.yml   # loader patch：把插件插进档案
  index.js           # 宿主半（空壳也行，令牌层可以全在客户端）
  client.js          # 客户端半的构建产物（唯一交给宿主加载的客户端文件）
  src/               # 源码：lib/（纯逻辑）· client/（界面与席位）· data/ · styles/
  tests/             # 断言（至少一套）
  docs/              # PRD / ARCHITECTURE / USER-GUIDE / TEST-REPORT / RESTORE / HANDOFF
  tools/             # make-manifest.mjs（清单自校验）· package.mjs（打包）
```

`package.json` 关键片段：

```jsonc
{
  "name": "dsh-myplugin",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "dsh": {
    "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" },  // ← 必需
    "client": { "platform": "web" }               // ← 只有需要界面时
  }
}
```

`cordis.patch.yml` 最低内容：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: my-plugin-id
      name: dsh-myplugin      # 包名，与 package.json 的 name 一致
```

客户端半的加载协议（本宿主实测）：

```js
window.__ModuleLoader__.load({
  id: '<客户端模块 id>',
  factory(require) {
    // 返回 { inject, apply }：inject 声明需要的服务，apply(ctx) 里注册席位/样式
    return { inject: ['theme', 'slots'], apply(ctx) { /* … */ } };
  },
});
```

> 客户端半只能用宿主给的服务（如 `theme`、`slots`）；**不要**在这里 import 第三方库凑体积——256 KiB/文件的限制与"无运行时依赖"是加分项。

---

## 3. 席位地图（实测结论，含坑）

| 席位 | 能做什么 | 实测约束 / 坑 |
|---|---|---|
| `settings.section` | 一个完整设置页（`id`/`order`/`label`） | 首选！一个插件一个页面，最稳 |
| `settings.general.item` | 通用页里的单行设置项 | 只适合单个开关/一行控件 |
| `settings.launcher` | 账号行/启动器位置 | **单席位**，官方占用者 `priority: 0`；要用更低值（如 `-1`）才能"遮蔽"，停用即还原 |
| `shell.overlay` | 帧级浮层（色条、HUD） | **全屏浮层只准 1 个**，`z-index` 固定低值，多个会互相盖 |
| `conversation.composer.dock` | 输入框附近的常驻动作区 | 适合放动作按钮，不适合放长文本 |
| `sidebar.session.row.leading` | 会话行首标记（竖杠/圆点） | **只在会话"空闲"行挂载**；运行中的行不显示——这是宿主行为，不是 bug |
| `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` | 会话「…」菜单项 | 与上一行配合：菜单里选，行首显示 |
| `sidebar.panellist` + `main` | 侧栏常驻入口 + 整页工作台 | 两处 **id 必须一致**；`main` 的键 `conversation`/`plugins`/`schedules` 已被占 |
| `sidebar.footer.action` | 侧栏底部动作 | owner 会把条目**竖排**堆叠 → **做不到"与某个按钮并排"**，想并排请放弃该席位 |

两条铁律：

1. **想"并排"先查 owner 的布局**（竖排堆叠的席位不可能并排）。
2. **单席位用 `priority` 抢位**：数值越小越靠后渲染；要"盖住"官方项就用比它更小的值，并保证停用能还原。

---

## 4. 状态与存储

* 一个版本化键：`dsh-myplugin.state.v1`（改结构就升 v2 并写迁移）。
* **旧键迁移**必须做（改名/重构时用户数据不能丢）：一次读多个 `LEGACY_KEYS`，迁移后写新键。
* 数值上限要有（例如头像 1 MB、单会话 200 条），超限**降级而不是崩**。
* 客户端状态只放"可重建"的东西；真实凭据放宿主凭据存储，**永远不进浏览器**。

---

## 5. 安全红线（照抄自查）

| 编号 | 红线 | 为什么 |
|---|---|---|
| S1 | **不订阅 `theme/change`** | `overrideTokens` 会发该事件，订阅后重绘＝自激循环＝渲染进程 OOM（本项目曾经的崩溃根因） |
| S2 | **不用 `setInterval` 轮询重绘** | 同上，改为"事件驱动 + 上限计数" |
| S4 | **全屏浮层最多 1 个** | 多个浮层互相盖、渲染成本翻倍 |
| S5 | **颜色令牌里不放渐变** | 渐变会与"叠加"设计冲突，且不可预测 |
| S14 | **不做渐变文字**（`background-clip:text`） | 会把 `color:transparent` 继承给行内 `code`，芯片变空白块——本项目已整条移除 |
| — | 所有渲染包在 `safeComponent` 里 | 单个组件抛错不该让整页白屏 |
| — | 熔断器 + 一键停绘 | 出事时用户能自救，不需要重装 |
| — | 自检故障**可见**（显示「故障【render:…】」） | 白屏是最难排查的形态 |

---

## 6. 测试：四套断言 + "测试这个测试"

| 套 | 断言什么（示例） | 本项目项数 |
|---|---|---|
| breaker | 窗口内重绘 N 次就熔断；窗口滚动后重新计数 | 13 |
| state | 旧键迁移、随机+锁不打架、还原出厂真的清空 | 59 |
| wcag | 每套配色 × 每个令牌的对比度阈值；标记色 ≥3:1 且互不重复 | 492 |
| bundle 冒烟 | 构建产物里配色齐全；不含深色变体；**不含已删除的功能**（防复活） | 128 |

**"测试这个测试"**：故意造一个坏值，确认测试会变红。
— 本项目踩过：第一版元素类型守卫**永远通过**（假绿灯），补了"故意造坏值"的用例才发现。

**诚实边界**：断言只能证逻辑，**证不了观感**（"这个效果好看吗/看得出变化吗"）。那部分必须真机走查，并把结论写进 `docs/TEST-REPORT.md`。

---

## 7. 构建 / 清单 / 打包

```powershell
node build.mjs                 # src/ → client.js（单一产物）
node tests/*.mjs               # 四套断言
node tools/make-manifest.mjs   # 重新生成 MANIFEST.sha256（覆盖所有受版本控制的文件）
node tools/package.mjs         # 跑断言 + 生成清单 + 产出 dist/*.tgz 与 *.zip
```

* **清单自校验**：把 MANIFEST 里每条哈希重算一遍，必须 **0 不匹配**。这是"交付物与源码一致"的唯一机器证明。
* 归档里必须带 `MANIFEST.sha256`、`LICENSE`、`THIRD-PARTY.md`。
* 每次改文档/源码后**重生成清单**，否则自校验会失败（这是好事：它会抓住你忘了的事）。

---

## 8. 部署与回滚（本节是血泪）

**正确姿势**：

1. 先备份目标目录（时间戳后缀）。
2. **只合并、不删除**：`robocopy <src> <dst> /E`（**绝不要**先 `Remove-Item -Recurse` 再复制）。
3. 需要把档案指向开发目录时用 junction；改档案文本前先备份。
4. 部署后校验关键文件哈希（开发副本 ≡ 部署副本）。
5. 客户端半改动 → **硬刷新**即可；宿主半或 manifest 改动 → 需要重启 `dsh web`。

**踩过的坑（真实事故）**：

* ❌ **"部署脚本先删目标目录再复制"抹掉了两次 `.git`**——不是 `/MIR` 的错，是那句 `Remove-Item -Recurse -Force`。恢复靠 `git init` + `git fetch --depth 1` + `reset origin/main`，代价很大。**删目标目录这一步已永久移除**。
* ❌ PowerShell 陷阱：`$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'` 下 **git/node 把进度写到 stderr** 会让脚本中断 → 统一用 `cmd /c "… 2>&1"`。
* ❌ `@(@('a','b'))` 会**拍平**成 2 元素数组 → 批量"查找替换"助手会替换单个字符（本项目曾因此毁掉 `package.json`）。改文件一律用直接字符串 `.Replace`。
* ❌ `"$login/$name: …"` 会被解析成变量 `$login` + 字面量：用 `${login}`。
* ❌ 读 UTF-8 的 `.ps1` 要 `-Encoding utf8`；脚本不能直接 `&` 运行（执行策略）→ 管道给 `Invoke-Expression`。

---

## 9. 发布与上架

### 9.1 发布（自己的仓库）

```powershell
git add -A; git commit -m "…"; git push origin main
git tag v0.1.0; git push origin v0.1.0      # 归档随 tag
# Release 里挂 dist/*.zip 与 *.tgz
```

别人安装：`dsh plugin --profile <档案> add github:<owner>/<repo>`（可选 `#v0.1.0` 钉版本）。

### 9.2 市场（dshmarket）到底怎么读数据

* **每次打开实时拉** `https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/plugins.json`（无过期缓存兜底）；连不上会报原因并提供重试。
* 该 JSON 由精选列表仓库 `awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin` 的 **CI 每日编译** `data/plugins/*.yml` 得到。
* 市场的**安装来源被硬限制在精选列表内**——所以"上了 GitHub"≠"市场能搜到"。
* 网络不通时可换镜像：环境变量 `DSHM_REGISTRY_URL` 指向同结构 `plugins.json`。

### 9.3 上架：一个 PR，一个文件

`data/plugins/<owner>__<repo>.yml`（monorepo 子包：`owner__repo--packages-my-plugin.yml`）：

```yaml
url: https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>      # 必须精确等于仓库地址
name: <owner>/<repo>                        # monorepo 子包用 owner/repo#subname
category: theme                             # 见下方合法取值
description:
  en: 一句话，讲功能，不用形容词最高级
  zh: 一句话（可选，维护者会补）
```

合法 `category`：`agi ui usage theme model identity session memory tools wsl browser vision voice docs skill workflow git notify dev security remote market fun`

**硬性要求**（评审会逐条看）：

1. `package.json` 声明 `dsh.bundle` manifest（决定"装得上"）；
2. 仓库有真实可用代码（占位/纯 README 不收）；
3. **仓库创建满 1 天**（自动检查；专拦"创建几分钟就提 PR"）；
4. 仓库加 **`dsh-plugin`** topic；
5. 描述**必须与代码一致**（会被逐条核对；不能出现已删除的功能）；
6. 分类选贴近的即可，选不准维护者会改，不会打回。

**队列真相（2026-10-08 实测，供预期管理）**：

* 收录是**人工评审 + 大致按创建时间顺序**；当时仓库有 **≈826 个未处理 PR**，正在合并的是 **9-28 创建**的 PR；
* 每天合并量约 10~20 条；因此"提交后通常一天内生效"指的是**合并之后**站点/CI 的收录速度，**不是评审排队时间**；
* 结论：**提交后要有"以周计"的心理准备**；**不要撤回重提**（重提＝排到队尾）。
* 合并后：CI 重编译 `plugins.json` → 市场下次打开即出现，**无需重启、无需重装**。

---

## 10. 主题 / 配色工程要点（若做"外观类"插件）

* **叠加而非覆盖**：配色只写颜色令牌；效果只写行为令牌（透明度/阴影/描边/滚动条/贴图）。两者独立，可任意组合。
* **令牌分层**：`<pkg>` → `:accents` → `:finish` → `:workspace`；主通道＝插件 `<style>`（`!important`），次通道＝`ctx.theme.overrideTokens`。
* **必须有兜底**：用户没选配色时，效果回退到中性浅色（不要猜宿主品牌色）。
* **标记类颜色要推导**：从当前配色推导出一组标记色，约束 ≥3:1 对比度、互不重复（否则浅色配色下标记看不见）。
* **不提供深色变体**（如果你只做浅色）：用断言把"不含深色"钉住，避免以后手滑。

---

# OpenSpec 看板

**简体中文** | [English](./README.en.md)

在 DeepSeek Harness 的右侧栏查看当前项目的 OpenSpec 变更、规格和待办任务。

## 你可以做什么

- **掌握变更进展**：查看筹划中、进行中、已完成和已归档的变更，展开查看相关文件与任务。
- **处理待办**：在活动变更中勾选已完成的任务，或选择“仅看未完成”，专注眼下要做的事。
- **查找规格**：浏览当前规格及其变更来源，点击文件即可在 DeepSeek Harness 中打开。
- **随时接着看**：搜索、切换变更和规格，或返回先前的列表时，看板会保留当前会话的筛选、展开项和滚动位置。项目文件发生变化时，内容会自动更新。

## 安装与使用

桌面版 DeepSeek Harness：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:vowdemon/dsh-openspec-dashboard
```

使用独立的 `dsh web`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:vowdemon/dsh-openspec-dashboard
```

打开包含 `openspec/` 目录的项目，在右侧栏点击“添加标签页”，选择 **OpenSpec 看板**。使用 `dsh web` 时，安装插件后需重启 Web 服务并刷新页面。

> 目前支持标准 OpenSpec 项目；自定义模板或外部 store 暂不支持。已归档变更的任务不可勾选。看板的浏览位置不会在页面重载后保留；如果自动更新暂时不可用，标题旁会显示“更新失效”，现有内容仍可查看。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-brake-pedal

[![CI](https://github.com/zhanshenovo/dsh-brake-pedal/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/zhanshenovo/dsh-brake-pedal/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

制动踏板自检彩蛋。输入框旁边多一颗 `🛞 制动自检`，点开就是一场 **6 脚全力制动测试**：
支架**随机**断在第 2–6 脚，偶尔（约 1/8）压根不断，然后弹出一份虚构的《情况说明》。

```
● 自检中止 · 第 4 脚断裂                      会话已运行 14m05s
第 1 脚   1,612 N   ✓ 踏板支架 完好    运行 14m05s
第 2 脚   1,658 N   ✓ 踏板支架 完好    日志 545 KB
第 3 脚   1,704 N   ✓ 踏板支架 完好    21:59 起
第 4 脚   1,750 N   ✕ 砰 —— 支架断裂   轮次 2
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
踏板力为推导值 ← 会话起始时间 / 已运行时长 / 日志体积 · 断裂位置每次重掷
              [再来一次（随机）][未复现模式][复位位置][收起]
```

**胶囊的位置**：默认贴在**发送键正上方**；按住可以拖到屏幕任意位置，位置会被记住
（`localStorage` 的 `dsh-brake-pedal.pos`）；**双击**胶囊、或点面板里的「复位位置」，
都会回到发送键上方。找不到发送键时（比如空会话）落回视口右下角，不会跑到屏幕外。

## 免责声明（重要）

这是一个**开发者自嘲性质的虚构段子**，不是安全评测、不是产品评价、也不是事实陈述。

- 弹窗里那份《情况说明》是**原创的官僚体文本**，不是任何真实声明、公告或回应的引用或改写。
- 它**不指向任何真实企业、品牌、产品或事件**；界面里不出现任何厂商名。
- 面板上的"踏板力""断裂脚次""断口形态"全部是**表演用数字**（其中"踏板力"由会话事实推导，
  界面上标注为推导值）。它们不构成任何技术结论。
- 断裂位置由**确定性伪随机**决定（种子 = 会话 id + 自检次数），所以它只是"看起来随机"，
  不具备任何统计或评测意义。

如果你要在公开场合展示它，请连带这句一起展示：**这是个段子，别当数据看。**

## 三条设计规矩

1. **从不拦截真实停止动作。** 这个插件没有接管 Stop 按钮，也做不到。所谓"6 脚"
   只是浮层上的表演；真实停止只有一次，且由你亲手按下（「挂 P 挡（停止会话）」）。
   任何时候按真实的 `停止` / `Esc Esc` 都能立刻停。
2. **数字不编。** 面板上的"踏板力"是从宿主给的硬事实**推导**出来的：会话起始时间、
   已运行时长、日志体积。界面上明确标注"推导值"。取不到事实时整场标注"演示数据"，
   不会假装是真的。
3. **烂了就消失。** 任何一环失败（slot 注入失败、路由 404、渲染报错）都只写一条
   console 记录，界面保持原样——一个段子不该弄坏界面。

## 随机是怎么随机的

```js
BREAK_ODDS = [0.12, 0.26, 0.24, 0.16, 0.10, 0.12]
//  第2脚   第3脚  第4脚  第5脚  第6脚   未复现
```

种子 = `会话 id + 第几次自检`，走 mulberry32。于是：

- **同一个会话里第一次点开，结果固定**——演示前可以先摇一次，不用现场赌运气；
- **换个会话就换一套**——不同人看到的断点不一样；
- **点「再来一次」才重掷**——想看别的结局随时能看。

这比"每次真随机"更适合演示：既保留惊喜，又不会让关键的那一脚掉链子。

## 「挂 P 挡」到底做了什么

它找不到中断会话的插件 API（Stop 是 shell 的**只读固定动作**），所以只能在 DOM 里
找那个**真实的停止按钮**并按下它，而且找得很保守：

- 先只在编辑器（`contenteditable` / `textarea`）所在的容器里找，最多向上 5 层；
- 按钮名字必须精确等于 `停止` 或 `Stop`；
- 必须可见且未 disabled；
- 找不到就如实说"未找到制动踏板"，绝不去猜别的按钮。

宿主半边只读会话日志文件，只提供 `GET`，写方法一律 405。

## 安装

三种方式，任选一种。**装完都必须重启 DeepSeek Harness**（插件页的「重启」按钮，或关掉再打开），再刷新页面。

**① 从 GitHub 装（装的是整个仓库，含视频工具链）**
在 DSH 的「插件 → 添加插件」里输入：

```
github:zhanshenovo/dsh-brake-pedal
```

**② 克隆后本地装**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/zhanshenovo/dsh-brake-pedal.git
cd dsh-brake-pedal
node tools/install.mjs              # 装进 desktop profile
node tools/install.mjs --profile web
```

它做三件事（和市场安装一致）：`dependencies` 加 `link:<本包>`、`dsh.profile.bundles`
加包名、`node_modules` 建 junction。改 `package.json` 前备份成
`package.json.bak-brake-pedal`。脚本按自身位置解析路径，所以克隆到哪都行。

**③ 本地 tarball（GitHub 连不上时用）**

从 [Releases](https://github.com/zhanshenovo/dsh-brake-pedal/releases) 下载
`dsh-brake-pedal-0.2.0.tgz`（约 23 KB，只有运行时文件），在「添加插件」里填它的**绝对路径**：

```
D:\Downloads\dsh-brake-pedal-0.2.0.tgz
```

> 为什么需要第 ③ 条：插件市场的文档明确写了，镜像只代理 registry 包与依赖，
> **不代理 GitHub 仓库本身** —— 所以大陆网络下 `github:` 那条路可能连不上，
> 而切换 npmmirror 也救不了它。

## 卸载

```bash
node tools/uninstall.mjs
```

## 自检

```bash
node test/smoke.mjs
```

会照宿主的方式加载客户端 bundle（`__ModuleLoader__` 外壳）、用最小 React shim 渲染
一帧（含 StrictMode 二次调用回归项、深浅两套主题）、验证 `shell.overlay` 注册、
并用**真实的会话存储**跑一遍 facts 路由（真实 `createdAt` / `elapsedMs` / `logBytes`，
以及 POST → 405），最后覆盖录制开关（锁定生效 / 越界拒绝 / `noBreak` 透传 / 无配置不加锁）。

## 录制与宣传视频

```bash
# 锁死断点（录制用，刷新即生效，画面无痕）
#   DevTools: localStorage.setItem('dsh-brake-pedal.lock', '3')  // 或 'none'

# 逐帧渲染演示视频（无头 Edge + ffmpeg → MP4）
node tools/video/render.mjs                     # 竖版 1080x1920
node tools/video/render.mjs --w 1920 --h 1080   # 横版

# 封面图
python tools/make-covers.py
```

- `tools/video/timeline.mjs` 是**唯一时间轴**：视频帧和 SRT 字幕都从它生成，不会对不上。
- `tools/video/scene.html` 是场景页，暴露 `window.__seek(state)`；页面自己不做动画，
  所有状态由渲染器驱动，所以同一份时间轴永远渲出同一个视频。
- 渲染器走 CDP 逐帧截图（`Page.captureScreenshot`），不是录屏——NG 一帧只重渲一帧。
- `ffmpeg` 通过 `FFMPEG` 环境变量指定；没有就退化成 PATH 上的 `ffmpeg`。

材料清单、分镜脚本、旁白稿、发布文案与合规红线见 [VIDEO.md](VIDEO.md)。

字段：`source`（`host` / `partial` / `none` / `error`）、`sessionId`、`matched`
（`exact` / `latest`）、`cwd`、`createdAt`、`elapsedMs`、`logBytes`、`logMtimeMs`。

主题：所有配色走宿主的 `--dsw-alias-*` 令牌，缺失时按 `data-theme` / 背景亮度
在浅色与深色两套兜底色之间选，并跟随主题切换。

错误只写 console，不抛给宿主。

# dsh-rulefile-check — Rule pack self-check against the citation discipline and severity ceilings

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-rulefile-check` reads one rule pack — the pack header plus one row per rule — and checks that pack against the citation discipline its plugin family enforces: that every rule id is unique within the pack, that both basis fields are filled in, that no excerpt is shorter than the minimum length, that every source is written as an http(s) link, that a rule whose basis kind is `derived-from-principle` or `institutional-configuration` carries a severity, that the check kind is one the engine supports, and that the pack header declares its name, plugin and version.

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-rulefile-check: real output over its RF-001 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-rulefile-check/main/docs/assets/dsh-rulefile-check-demo.png)

Real output from this plugin over its own `RF-001` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| The same rule id appears on two rules in the pack. | `RF-001` reports the repeated id, because a duplicate makes `issue.id` point at two different rules and the hit can no longer be traced back. Comparison ignores whitespace. It can only see one pack at a time: it does not compare two packs with each other or look anything up in a register. |
| A rule carries only `document` and says nothing about the clause. | `RF-002` checks that at least one of the two basis fields is filled in, so a rule whose `document` is present passes. It does not judge whether the cited clause really exists or whether it relates to the rule. |
| The excerpt is a one-sentence description of the clause rather than a quotation. | `RF-003` requires the excerpt to exist and to be at least eight characters long. Length is necessary, not sufficient: a twenty-character description is still not a quotation, and this rule cannot tell the difference — it does not compare the excerpt against the original clause. |
| The source reads `某某网站` instead of a link. | `RF-004` reports it, because the source field has to look like an http(s) link. It checks the form only: it does not visit the link, does not tell you whether the link works, and does not tell you whether the page really contains the clause being cited. |
| A rule derived from a principle is filed as `error`. | `RF-005` confirms that a rule whose basis kind is `derived-from-principle` or `institutional-configuration` states a severity at all. Whether that severity actually respects the ceiling is enforced by the loader, which rejects such a pack outright with `strongest permitted severity`; this check only covers the field being present and cannot replace the loader. |
| The pack writes a `check.kind` the engine does not know — and does it declare its `packName` and `version`? | `RF-006` reports the unknown `check.kind`, because such a rule is silently not executed. Its list of supported kinds ships empty, since which kinds exist depends on the engine version, so an unconfigured pack puts that rule in `skipped` instead of passing it; it only compares against the list you supply. `RF-007` checks the header for `packName`, `plugin` and `version` together, because without them you cannot tell which plugin a pack belongs to, or which revision, when you swap it in. Neither rule verifies that the declared values match the plugin actually in use. |

## Standards it follows

This rule pack cites no public standard: every rule's basis is the plugin family's own self-imposed citation discipline, its engine contract and its pack contract, so the entries below name the family's internal contracts rather than any statute or national standard.

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 本插件家族的条款引用纪律（自定纪律，非国家标准） | 无编号（本规则库自定） | RF-001, RF-002, RF-003, RF-004, RF-005 |
| 本插件家族的检查引擎契约（自定纪律，非国家标准） | 无编号（本规则库自定） | RF-006 |
| 本插件家族的规则库契约（自定纪律，非国家标准） | 无编号（本规则库自定） | RF-007 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks a **规则库** (a rule pack) for the citation discipline this plugin family
enforces — that rule ids are unique, that every basis field is present, that an excerpt has real length, that a
source is a link, that a derived or locally configured basis carries a severity, that the check kind is one the
engine supports, and that the pack declares its name, plugin and version.

> ### ⚠️ This checks form, not content — and it says so
>
> **The discipline being checked is self-imposed, not a national standard.** "An excerpt must be a verbatim
> quotation" and "a principle-derived check may not be an `error`" are rules this plugin family enforces in
> `shared/ruleset.ts`; their basis is the general principle of intellectual honesty — never dress a description
> up as a quotation, never dress an inference up as a requirement — **not any statute or standard**. Every
> rule's `basis` says exactly that, which is why every rule here is `warn` or `info`.
>
> **It cannot tell whether a citation is apt.** It checks that fields are filled, that an excerpt is long
> enough, that a source *looks like* a link, and that a severity is stated. It will happily pass a rule that
> cites **a real but irrelevant clause** — that is the documented limit of a form check, and it is why
> automated checking never replaces a human read-through.
>
> Two rules deserve a note. `RF-003`'s floor of eight characters is the ledger-side echo of the load-time guard
> — but **length is necessary, not sufficient**: a twenty-character *description* is still not a quotation, and
> this plugin cannot tell the difference. And `RF-005` can only confirm a severity field is present: whether a
> severity actually respects the ceiling is enforced by the loader, which rejects a violating pack outright with
> `strongest permitted severity`. `RF-006`'s kind vocabulary ships **empty**, because which kinds an engine
> supports depends on the engine version — hard-coding this family's own list would mean editing this plugin
> every time the engine gains a kind.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.1`. `engines.dsh` is deliberately not declared: it has no reader and cannot reject a host |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native`, `ptc` and `both`; for a whole rule pack use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `rulefile_check` tool. It reads one rule inventory — the pack header plus one row per rule —
applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RF-001` | rule ids are unique | warn | self-imposed discipline |
| `RF-002` | basis fields are present | warn | self-imposed discipline |
| `RF-003` | the excerpt has real length | warn | self-imposed discipline |
| `RF-004` | the source is a link | warn | self-imposed discipline |
| `RF-005` | a derived basis carries a severity | warn | self-imposed discipline |
| `RF-006` | the check kind is supported (off by default) | warn | engine contract |
| `RF-007` | the pack declares name, plugin and version | warn | pack contract |

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-rulefile-check
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-rulefile-check'
```

## Configuration

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rulesFile` | string | `rules/rulefile-check.yaml` | Rule-pack path, relative to the package root |
| `disabledRules` | string[] | `[]` | Rule ids to stop running; each appears in `skipped` |
| `onlyRules` | string[] | `[]` | Run only these rule ids; empty runs every rule |
| `skipNotes` | string | `""` | Note appended to every `skipped` reason |
| `timeoutMs` | number | `120000` | Cooperative tool timeout budget |

# dsh-hazplan-check — HAZOP worksheet element completeness and deviation derivation consistency check

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)

`dsh-hazplan-check` reads one HAZOP worksheet — rows keyed by the sheet's own column names, in Chinese or English, plus an optional header naming the 分析对象 — and checks that same sheet's completeness and internal traceability: that every row fills the fields your template requires (`偏差` and `原因` by default), that each row records its `节点`, that `引导词` come from the standard's tables 1 and 2 or from the list the study declared beforehand, that each row shows which element its deviation came from, that `风险等级` come from your own risk vocabulary, that the sheet names its analysis subject, and that every `偏差` is literally the `工艺参数` read through its `引导词`; a check that cannot run for want of a column is reported in `skipped` rather than passing silently.

## What it looks like

![Terminal demo of dsh-hazplan-check: real output over its HZ-004 fixture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-hazplan-check/main/docs/assets/dsh-hazplan-check-demo.png)

Real output from this plugin over its own `HZ-004` test fixture — not a mock-up. The rule pack ships no invented quotations, so a finding names both the clause it applied and the fact that the clause text was not obtained.

## What it answers

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| A row records the deviation but leaves the cause blank. Is that reported? | Yes. `HZ-001` requires the fields every row must fill; shipped unset, it falls back to the pair the clause itself names, `偏差` and `原因`, so a blank `原因` is a gap on its own. It checks that the column is filled, not that the problem list is complete or the cause technically sound. |
| Three rows carry no node at all. Does the check say anything, and does it judge how the nodes were divided? | `HZ-002` reports those rows together and lists their row numbers, because a record without nodes cannot produce the node list the clause asks for. It checks only that `节点` is filled; it does not judge whether the node granularity is right, since clause 4.2 gives no criterion for it, and it does not decide whether any node was left unanalysed. |
| Our study wrote 相逆 in the `引导词` column. Will that be flagged? | `HZ-003` reports it as a guide word outside the list: the standard's own wording is 「相反」, not 相逆, and tables 1 and 2 supply 无/多/少/伴随/部分/相反/异常 and 早/晚/先/后. The finding is a prompt rather than a verdict, because a guide word the study defined and archived before the analysis is permitted — which is why the rule sits at `warn`. A deployment can declare its own list instead, and then only words outside that list are reported. |
| The `偏差` column reads 无流量, while `工艺参数` says 温度 and `引导词` says 无. Is that caught? | `HZ-007` reports the row when the written `偏差` does not contain the `工艺参数` read through its `引导词` in either word order; blanks and the usual separators (for example `+`, `、`, `/`, `-`, `—`, `的`, `：`) are ignored, so 流量无, 流量 + 无 and 无流量 all agree. It runs only when all three columns are present — otherwise it appears in `skipped` — and a hit means a likely copy-paste artefact, not that the deviation is technically wrong. |
| The `风险等级` column is filled with 中, but we never configured a risk vocabulary. What comes back? | `HZ-005` reports itself in `skipped`, not as a pass: the standard fixes no risk-level scale, so the levels have to come from your own risk criteria and the shipped list is empty. Once levels are configured it only checks that the value is in the list, not whether the rating is correct, and its severity is capped at `info`. |
| The worksheet has no line naming the unit it analyses. Is that a gap? | `HZ-006` reports it once, at the top level: without an analysis subject the conclusions cannot be traced back to the boundary that was analysed. The header list it rests on comes from an informative appendix — a suggestion, not a requirement — so the rule stays at `warn`, and `requireHeader: false` turns it off for sheets that legitimately carry none. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《危险与可操作性分析（HAZOP分析）应用指南》 | GB/T 35320-2017 | HZ-001, HZ-002, HZ-003, HZ-004, HZ-005, HZ-006, HZ-007 |
| 《风险管理 风险评估技术》 | GB/T 27921-2023 | HZ-005 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks one **HAZOP worksheet** for what a sheet can be held to — that every row
records the analysis content your template requires, that each 偏差 actually follows from the 工艺参数 and
引导词 beside it, that risk levels come from your own vocabulary, that every node has rows, and that
recommendations carry their closure fields. It does **not** judge whether the causes are complete, whether
the consequences are analysed far enough, whether the safeguards are adequate, or whether a risk rating is
correct. **Those four judgements are the study team's, and they are where HAZOP's value lies.**

> ### ⚠️ Nothing here is `error`, and the clause wording is why
>
> **GB/T 35320-2017《危险与可操作性分析（HAZOP分析）应用指南》** is in force (published and effective
> 2017-12-29, identical to IEC 61882:2001), and its clause text was obtained verbatim.
>
> **The standard is a *recommended* one (the number carries "/T"), and every clause this pack cites uses
> 宜 — "should" — not 应.** That applies to the two clauses an earlier version of this pack rated as
> `error`: **6.6.4** reads 「每一个危险和可操作性性问题都**宜**作为单项记录」 and **6.6.3** opens
> 「HAZOP 分析输出**宜**包括：」. **A recommendation cannot support an error rating**, so both rules are
> now `warn` and **this plugin reports no error at all** — consistent with how the family treats every
> other recommended standard. A test pins this so a later edit cannot quietly re-escalate one.
>
> **Everything else is capped at `warn` or `info`, for three reasons the pack records:**
>
> 1. **Appendix A.2 — the one place a column list appears — is a 资料性附录.** Its wording is "表列的标题
>    **可为**以下各项", it adds "**也可记录**其他信息", and it says outright that "工作表的版面设计**各有不同**".
>    **There is no mandatory column list**, so a missing column can only ever be a suggestion.
> 2. **Clause 4.2 gives no criterion for node granularity.** It says the size of a node "取决于系统的
>    复杂性和危险的严重程度" and nothing quantitative follows. This plugin **does not** judge node size.
> 3. **The standard fixes no risk-level scale.** 6.5 mentions a risk matrix as useful and defers the method
>    to IEC 60300-3-9; GB/T 27921-2023's matrix description is likewise informative. Levels must come from
>    your own risk criteria, so the vocabulary ships **empty**.
>
> Two further honesty notes are in the pack. The guide-word vocabulary uses the standard's own wording —
> **「相反」, not the colloquial "相逆"** — and combines table 1 with table 2; a custom guide word is
> **not** non-compliant, because 6.4.3 permits one "只要在分析开始前进行了定义". And **SH/T 3240-2025**
> (the petrochemical HAZOP specification, in force 2025-11-01) had only its identity, status and glossary
> verified — **its clause text was not obtained, so this pack cites none of it**.
>
> The four judgements this plugin does not make: whether the causes are complete, whether the consequences
> are analysed far enough, whether the safeguards are adequate, whether a risk rating is correct.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.1`. `engines.dsh` is deliberately not declared: it has no reader and cannot reject a host |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native`, `ptc` and `both`; for several worksheets use `ptc` |

Registers the `hazplan_check` tool. It reads one worksheet — rows keyed by the sheet's own column names,
in Chinese or English — applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis |

| `HZ-001` | every problem is its own row, with its cause | warn | 6.6.4 |
| `HZ-002` | every analysed node is recorded on
